title: Senior Customer Experience Program Manager
description:
**Overview**
Capacity Operations Team within Azure Fleet Platform is responsible for connecting customer demand with infrastructure supply across Microsoft's global cloud footprint. The team enables reliable, scalable, and predictable cloud capacity for Azure and other Microsoft cloud services by driving capacity planning, allocation, risk management, and optimization.
  
  
Working closely with customers, engineering, and infrastructure teams, the Capacity Team develops the frameworks, processes, and systems required to deliver an exceptional capacity experience. The team focuses on forecasting demand, mitigating capacity risks, improving utilization, and ensuring customers can successfully deploy and scale their workloads in the Microsoft Cloud. Through data-driven insights, automation, and operational excellence, the Capacity Team helps ensure Microsoft's cloud capacity is available where and when customers need it most.
  
  
We are looking for a passionate and knowledgeable Senior Program Manager to join the Capacity Operations team. The Capacity Operations team is responsible for delivering the best capacity customer experience by ensuring an optimal and reliable platform, world-class customer support, and scalable and compliant operations process. This role collaborates with multiple stakeholders, including engineering, customer owners, service owners, 24x7 support vendors to drive innovation for operational support.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Track overall support effectiveness and health, analyzing customer satisfaction and quality data.
* Address support process, data and system gaps impacting the customer.
* Monitor key operation metrics and drive operation process improvements.
* Provide visibility to process and system issues, collaborating with engineering/product/business teams to drive improvements, automation, and efficiency.
* Provide visibility to platform capacity reliability issues and collaborate with platform teams to eliminate customer failures as it relates to capacity.
* Technical advisor/escalation for issues outside of the vendor operations knowledge and capability.
* Collaborate across a diverse set of business stakeholders, including the Azure engineering team, to design new deployment and platform capabilities.
* Facilitate industry-standard Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for premium customers

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND (5-8 years)experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

+ Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 7+ years of technical and business experience in the following or related areas: engineering, program management, capacity management, capacity optimization, program management, cloud capacity management.
* Azure Platform or Operations within a cloud service architecture, deployment and configuration.
* Deep understanding of cloud services, usage scenarios and implementations. Experience working in or with cloud engineering teams preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, synthesize complex issues/scenarios into easy-to-understand concepts and drive quick customer resolution and influence the long-term success plan.

  .

Experience with enterprise applications, B2B SaaS products, UK-based clients, complex integrations, and PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or Scrum Master certifications.

title: Solar project manager - Megawatt scale
company: TRUZON SOLAR - Suntek Energy Systems Private Limited -
description:
**Company Description**
TRUZON SOLAR – Suntek Energy Systems Private Limited – operates in the renewable energy sector with a focus on solar power projects at megawatt scale. The organization delivers end-to-end solutions, from project planning and design to installation and commissioning. It emphasizes reliable execution, safety, and compliance with industry standards to ensure high-performance solar plants. Team members collaborate across engineering, procurement, and construction functions to deliver projects on schedule and within budget.

**Role Description**
The Solar Project Manager – Megawatt Scale will oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale solar projects at the Hyderabad site. This full-time, on-site role includes coordinating project schedules, managing resources, and supervising construction and installation activities to ensure timely completion and quality standards. The role involves liaising with engineering, procurement, logistics, and inspection teams, tracking project progress, and resolving issues that may affect timelines or costs. The Solar Project Manager will review technical documentation, monitor contractor performance, enforce safety and regulatory compliance, and prepare regular status reports for internal and external stakeholders. The position also requires close coordination with suppliers and vendors to expedite materials, manage logistics, and support commissioning and handover of solar plants.

**TECHNO COMMERCIAL EXPERIENCE PREFERRED**

**Qualifications**

* Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience with expeditor and expediting activities to ensure timely delivery of equipment and materials.
* Knowledge of inspection processes and quality control for solar plant construction and installation.
* Competence in logistics management related to large-scale construction or energy projects.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related technical field; advanced certifications (e.g., PMP) are an advantage.
* Proven experience managing utility-scale or megawatt-scale solar projects or similar infrastructure projects.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and make data-driven decisions under time constraints.
* Familiarity with relevant safety standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices in renewable energy.

title: Vice President, Project Management Lead
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
15
  
  
**The Team**
The Portfolio Management team drives enterprise-wide strategic agendas with cross-functional authority and visibility. The team partners closely with senior business leaders to bring structure, rigor, strategic clarity, and integrated oversight to the organization’s most critical decisions and initiatives. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, financial performance, and operational execution, the team shapes prioritization, resource allocation, governance, and delivery across a complex global organization.
  
  
**The Role**
The Vice President, Project Management Lead is a senior enterprise leader accountable for the end-to-end governance and execution of a portfolio of complex strategic programs, with a particular focus on M&A, integrations, separations, and enterprise transformation. The role establishes the delivery architecture, decision forums, operating cadence, and performance transparency required to move initiatives from strategy through execution and value realization.
  
  
Working across business units, corporate functions, workstream leaders, transaction owners, external advisors, and suppliers, the Vice President creates alignment where authority is distributed, anticipates enterprise-level risks, and enables timely executive decisions. The role is expected to combine strategic judgment, financial and commercial acumen, rigorous program leadership, and the presence to influence C-suite and Executive Committee stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Enterprise Portfolio and Program Leadership

+ Own enterprise portfolio and project management for priority M&A and strategic transformation initiatives, from initial mobilization and planning through execution, Day 1 readiness, stabilization, and value realization.
+ Design the end-to-end program structure, including scope, outcomes, workstreams, governance, decision rights, integrated plans, milestones, deliverables, critical paths, dependencies, resourcing assumptions, and escalation protocols.
+ Translate enterprise strategy and transaction objectives into executable roadmaps with clear accountabilities, measurable outcomes, and transparent progress against commitments.
+ Lead multiple interconnected initiatives as an integrated portfolio, balancing strategic value, capacity, risk, timing, cost, and organizational readiness.
+ Provide direct leadership and strategic support to the applicable Project Management Office lead, workstream PMs, and functional delivery teams, establishing consistent standards and ways of working.

* Governance and Executive Decision Support

+ Establish and chair effective governance routines, including executive steering committees, portfolio reviews, transaction management forums, workstream reviews, and risk and readiness sessions.
+ Clarify decision rights and escalation paths; maintain a disciplined record of critical decisions, assumptions, dependencies, open issues, and executive actions.
+ Prepare concise, decision-oriented materials for C-suite and Executive Committee audiences, including portfolio dashboards, investment scorecards, readiness views, risk and dependency analyses, and recommendations.
+ Synthesize complex inputs across functions and workstreams into a coherent enterprise narrative that highlights choices, trade-offs, implications, and required decisions.
+ Ensure governance is proportionate to program complexity and enables pace without compromising control, accountability, or quality.

* M&A, Integration and Separation Execution

+ Develop and manage the integrated transaction plan, including milestones, deliverables, critical paths, Day 1 readiness, integration or separation priorities, transition activities, and post-close stabilization.
+ Coordinate critical cross-functional workstreams, which may include Transition Service Agreements, operating model design, technology and data separation, revenue reconciliation, finance, people, legal, compliance, communications, commercial readiness, and customer continuity.
+ Drive scope clarity across each workstream, explicitly defining what is in scope, out of scope, deferred, dependent on another decision, or subject to transitional arrangements.
+ Connect transaction strategy to operational execution, ensuring interdependencies are visible and that functional plans converge into an integrated enterprise outcome.
+ Partner with transaction owners and external advisors to maintain pace, resolve ambiguity, and adapt plans as deal assumptions or business conditions evolve.

* Financial Oversight and Value Realization

+ Partner with Finance and business leaders to build and maintain the integrated financial view of the portfolio, including approved investment, transaction-related costs, synergies, dis-synergies, ongoing run-rate impacts, and value capture.
+ Establish benefit-realization disciplines that connect business cases to named owners, baselines, timing, milestones, performance measures, and executive reporting.
+ Challenge financial assumptions and delivery forecasts, identify variance drivers, and ensure corrective actions are defined when value, cost, or timing moves off plan.
+ Enable prioritization and resource-allocation decisions through transparent analysis of strategic value, financial return, capacity constraints, execution risk, and opportunity cost.

* Risk, Dependency and Readiness Management

+ Own the enterprise view of program risk, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, with particular focus on cross-workstream impacts that may not be visible within individual functions.
+ Anticipate execution barriers and decision bottlenecks; develop practical mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans before they threaten critical milestones.
+ Define readiness criteria and evidence-based assessments for major milestones, including Day 1, cutover, launch, close, transition exit, and stabilization.
+ Escalate material risks with clear context, business implications, options, and recommendations rather than reporting status alone.
+ Ensure lessons learned are translated into stronger portfolio standards, reusable playbooks, and improved enterprise delivery capability.

* Stakeholder, Supplier and Team Leadership

+ Influence and integrate senior leaders and delivery teams across a highly matrixed, global environment, frequently without direct or formal authority.
+ Build trusted relationships with workstream leads, transaction owners, functional executives, external advisors, and suppliers while maintaining constructive challenge and accountability.
+ Set clear expectations for delivery quality, communication, issue resolution, and executive engagement across internal teams and third parties.
+ Lead, coach, and develop project and portfolio management talent; create clarity of roles, delegate effectively, and build a high-performing culture focused on outcomes and enterprise value.
+ Model inclusive leadership, sound judgment, resilience, and calm execution in high-pressure and confidential environments.

* Portfolio Management Standards and Continuous Improvement

+ Design and embed scalable portfolio-management standards, stage gates, prioritization models, templates, reporting disciplines, and benefit-realization practices.
+ Use appropriate delivery methods, including predictive, Agile, SAFe, and hybrid approaches, based on the nature and risk profile of the initiative.
+ Promote high-quality portfolio data and practical use of tools and analytics to improve transparency, forecasting, scenario planning, and executive decision-making.
+ Act as an enterprise subject matter expert, applying external practices and internal lessons to strengthen the organization’s ability to execute complex change.

**Compensation/Benefits Information:**
(This section is only applicable to US candidates)
  
  
S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $176,300 to $314,600. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.
  
  
In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan.
  
  
This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
**Basic Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Technology, or another relevant discipline.
* An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise program management, portfolio management, strategic planning, transformation, transaction execution, or related disciplines within a large-scale, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated leadership of complex, cross-functional programs with material strategic, financial, operational, technology, customer, or organizational impact.
* Direct experience supporting M&A integration, separation, carve-out, joint venture, or major enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Proven ability to design and operate portfolio governance, including stage gates, prioritization, integrated planning, executive steering, risk management, readiness, and benefit-realization tracking.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including business-case development, ROI analysis, budget oversight, forecast challenge, synergy tracking, and value-realization reporting.
* Executive presence and a proven record of presenting portfolio insights, strategic choices, and recommendations to C-suite and senior leadership audiences.
* Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries, reconcile competing priorities, and create accountability where reporting lines are distributed.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex issues and tailor the message across functions, levels, and cultures.
* Demonstrated discretion and judgment when handling confidential transaction, financial, people, customer, and organizational information.
* We require all external candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, ordinarily at the nearest S&P Global office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP), Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP), PgMP, or an equivalent recognized certification.
* Experience applying Agile, SAFe, or hybrid portfolio management methods in a large enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience with portfolio management platforms such as Planview, Clarity PPM, ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management, or Microsoft Project Online.
* Proficiency with portfolio analytics and visualization tools, including Power BI or Tableau, to build executive-grade reporting and scenario views.
* Experience in financial data, information services, financial services, technology-enabled services, or capital markets environments.
* Experience working across geographies and time zones and leading programs with significant regulatory, data, technology, supplier, or change-management dependencies.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Strategic orientation: connects enterprise priorities, transaction objectives, and portfolio choices to practical execution.
* Enterprise judgment: sees across functions, identifies second-order impacts, and makes balanced recommendations amid complexity and ambiguity.
* Execution discipline: creates pace, clarity, accountability, and follow-through across multiple senior stakeholders and workstreams.
* Constructive influence: challenges assumptions respectfully, resolves conflict, and aligns leaders around enterprise outcomes.
* Talent leadership: builds capability, sets a high bar, delegates effectively, and creates an inclusive environment in which teams can perform.
* Adaptability and resilience: pivots as facts change while preserving strategic intent, decision quality, and delivery confidence.

**Measures of Success**

* Critical milestones and enterprise commitments are delivered with clear ownership, evidence-based readiness, and timely escalation.
* Executive forums receive accurate, concise, decision-ready information and can act quickly on material choices and trade-offs.
* Cross-functional risks and dependencies are surfaced early and resolved before they materially affect value, timing, customer continuity, or operational stability.
* Portfolio investment, transaction costs, synergies, and benefits are transparent and connected to accountable owners and delivery plans.
* Program teams and partners operate through consistent standards, strong collaboration, and a shared focus on enterprise outcomes.

title: TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
description:
**Job Description:**
TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
  
  

* Location: PAN India
* Number of Positions: 2
* Experience Required: 8–14 Years
* Work Mode: Hybrid

**Job Summary: (P3/P4)**
We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the MES PASX tower (v3.3.x) across programs, ensuring platform stability, scalability and compliance in cloudbased AKS (Azure Kubernetes Services) environments.
* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.
* Ensure to Coordinate on rollouts and system upgrades for PASX application.
* Own MES Service Delivery Operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and adherence to SLAs.
* Govern 2ndlevel support operations for PASX, Azure, Kubernetes, and MES integrations.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change and Release Management processes in line with ITIL.
* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.
* Own and govern MES integrations with Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 systems including SAP ERP, OSI PI, LIMS & Kepware/OPC.
* Ensure robust design, monitoring and support of DCS adapters, services and interfaces.
* Drive troubleshooting for complex crosssystem issues spanning MES, DCS, ERP, and shopfloor automation.
* Establish governance for MES PASX Users & Rights, Control Data & Profiles, Terminals, Printing, and Reporting, Production Units, WMS Master Data, Service & system configurations.
* Ensure data consistency, audit readiness, and alignment with validated system requirements.
* Ensure MES solutions comply with CSV, SDLC, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP and GAMP requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with vendors such as Körber, Microsoft and system integrators.
* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.
* Provide technical and functional leadership to MES engineers and support teams.
* Mentor team members on PASX functionality, cloud/K8s concepts, validation and integrations.
* Drive proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence within the MES tower.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization and performance optimization within MES operations.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-M&A-Senior Consultant-MO
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - Mergers & Acquisition – I&D MO – Senior Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
We guide M&A initiatives for companies to help expand and accelerate revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model, or capital model. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
  
  

* 1. Develop client deliverables and documentation:
* Identify and select the most relevant set of tools/techniques to meet client requirements such as business case development, financial modeling, and analysis, etc.
* Analyze and interpret project data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations based on the result of the specific outputs.
* Use analytics to build strategic insights for the client.
* Define project standards, methodologies, and execute process improvement initiatives.
* 2. Engage in client interaction:
* Conduct client interviews to verify and validate assumptions, hypothesis, and analysis.
* Participate in workshops and training sessions.
* Synthesize and present insights and recommendations.
* Develop and maintain working relationships with client counterparts.
* 3. Participate in engagement management including:
* Own and manage specific work threads.
* Develop plans for components of engagements.
* Coordinate activities between different work threads.
* Identify and help manage changes in scope.
* Manage and mentor junior resources.

**The Team:**
The M&A team bring deep industry experience, rigorous analytical capabilities, and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients' most complex business problems. Our operational capabilities address the unique issues faced by manufacturing organizations, service businesses and infrastructure operations. These are combined with capabilities in finance, performance management and business restructuring. Our teams take the lead on delivering all aspects of the people side of transactions to our clients. We leverage commercial awareness and professional expertise, along with using the skills and expertise of others, to deliver the best possible experience and outcomes for our clients.
  
  
Capabilities of an M&A I&D Finance & Supply Chain practitioner will include the following:
  
  

* Advising clients on separating/carving out a business unit for divestiture and integrating newly acquired target with buyer’s organization with focus on the Finance and / or Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) workstreams.
* Preparing for Day-One (legal ownership transfer) / Day-Two (focus shifts from deal execution to operational transition / TSA exit) planning, business continuity planning, synergy identification / capture and commercial/ operational due diligence with focus on Finance and / or Operations workstreams.
* Preparing and executing Legal Entity Readiness, Finance Function / Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) Integration & Carve-Out, Transformation planning, Contracts review, Sourcing Strategy Revamp.
* Mapping and documenting current state and future state processes with a focus on Finance Operating Model and / or Operations Operating Model.
* Understanding the end-to-end finance processes such as Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Close-Consolidate, Taxation etc.
* Conducting contract metadata extraction, contract separation, supplier negotiation Support, operational benchmarking, supply chain ops cost baselining etc.
* Analyzing financial statements and large financial and non-financial data sets.

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* MBA is mandatory

+ 3-5 years of relevant experience for Senior Consultants

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Consulting Background
* M&A advisory experience
* Program/Project Management office experience
* Investment banking experience on the sell/ buy side
* Industry M&A strategy experience
* Specific functional knowledge in areas of Finance, Operations, Procurement etc.
* Demonstrated experience in financial statement and operations analytics

**Education:**
MBA is mandatory

Bengaluru/ Hyderabad/Pune

title: Senior PMO Analyst
description:
**About Flutter Entertainment**
Flutter Entertainment is the world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator with 13.9 million Average Monthly Players worldwide and an annual revenue of $14 Bn in 2024. We have a portfolio of iconic brands, including Paddy Power, Betfair, FanDuel, PokerStars, Junglee Games and Sportsbet.
  
  
As a pioneering force in the industry, Flutter is at the forefront of technological innovation, offering seamless digital experiences to millions of customers worldwide. With a commitment to responsible gaming and a focus on customer-first strategies, Flutter leverages its scale, diverse offerings, and data-driven insights to deliver entertainment while ensuring the highest safety and compliance standards. Its dynamic approach to global growth has positioned Flutter as a dominant player in established and emerging markets, pushing the boundaries of the entertainment experience.
  
  
Flutter Entertainment is listed on both the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE). In 2024, we were recognized in TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies under the 'Pioneers' category—a testament to our innovation and impact. Our ambition is to transform global gaming and betting to deliver long-term growth and a positive, sustainable future for our sector. Together, we are Changing the Game.
  
  
**FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA**
Our office, located in the heart of Hi-Tech City in Hyderabad, is the Global Capability Center for Flutter Entertainment. Now home to 900+ talented colleagues, we are driving the future of entertainment across critical areas like Technology, Infosec, Procurement, Customer, and HR Operations.
  
  
We are committed to crafting impactful solutions for all our brands and divisions to power Flutter's incredible growth and global impact. Our portfolio of world-class brands, global scale, and challenger mindset presents a powerful combination.
  
  
We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future and the global and local scale to achieve them. \
  
  
**Role Summary**
As our organization continues to expand across the globe, we are seeking an experienced Portfolio Manager to lead our People Change and Transformation Portfolio within Group HR Operations.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire landscape of HR projects and programmes, ensuring they align with our strategic goals and deliver maximum business value. This role will maintain a strong and collaborative global network and act as a senior leader in the delivery of the Group HR Operations Change strategy. To drive success, the role will need to strategically prioritize investments, influence executive stakeholders, and foster collaboration without authority across various Divisions and Brands in our global federated model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Working in close partnership with the PMO Manager, Project Managers, and global HR leadership, you will be responsible for the health, direction, and success of the transformation portfolio. Your primary focus will be:
  
  

* Strategic Alignment & Roadmap: Directing the overall programme roadmap, ensuring the entire portfolio of projects seamlessly aligns with broader organisational goals and the Group HR Operations & Transformation strategy.
* Demand & Prioritization: Supporting the intake of new initiatives, evaluating business cases, and prioritising investments across the Global HR Ops community based on strategic value, risk, and organizational capacity.
* Portfolio Governance: Partnering with the PMO to enforce a robust governance framework for all implementations, providing executive-level visibility into portfolio health, financial performance, and cross-project dependencies.
* Resource & Capacity Strategy: Providing strategic oversight of resource allocation across our federated model, ensuring teams across different Divisions and Brands are aligned to the highest-priority initiatives without being over-leveraged.
* Benefits Realisation: Establishing frameworks to track and measure the successful execution of projects, ensuring they not only enhance overall delivery efficiency but also realise their intended ROI and transformational goals.

**Skills & Experience**
**Experience & Knowledge:**

* Extensive Portfolio/Programme Experience: Significant track record in Portfolio Management, Senior Programme Management, or PMO Leadership, specifically guiding large-scale HR, People Systems, or Organizational Transformation portfolios.
* Global & Federated Expertise: Deep experience operating at a strategic level within a large, highly matrixed, or federated organization, balancing centralized strategy with decentralized execution.
* Financial & Commercial Acumen: Strong experience in portfolio financial management, budget allocation, business case development, and ROI tracking.
* Governance Design: Proven ability to design and implement portfolio-level governance structures, stage-gating processes, and executive reporting dashboards.

**Core Competencies**

* Executive Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-suite and senior leadership, drive strategic consensus, and manage conflicting priorities across different brands.
* Influencing Without Authority: The ability to steer global teams, secure resource commitments, and foster deep collaboration across autonomous divisions where you lack direct reporting lines.
* Strategic & Visionary Thinking: The ability to look beyond individual projects to see the "big picture," identifying macro-level risks and opportunities for synergy across the global network.

**Desirable Qualifications**

* Recognised Portfolio Management certification (e.g., PMI-PfMP, MoP) or advanced Programme Management certification (e.g., MSP, PgMP).
* Advanced expertise in enterprise Portfolio and Project Management (PPM) tools (e.g., Smartsheets, JIRA)

**Benefits We Offer**

* Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling.
* Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs.
* Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents.
* Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness.
* Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals.
* Free Meals, Cab Allowance, and a Home Office Setup Allowance.
* Employer PF Contribution, gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance.
* Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares.
* Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections.
* Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards.

**WHY CHOOSE US**
Flutter is an equal-opportunity employer and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. Our message to colleagues and stakeholders is clear: everyone is welcome, and every voice matters. We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India

**Business Relationship Partner**
within the IT and Digital Services (IDS) department plays an important role in bridging the gap between technology and business objectives. * Build strong network and relationships within the business functional teams and/or value streams, understand the business objectives and work to identify Minimal Viable Products to validate business hypothesis statements to ensure value is created.
* Communicate effectively to ensure the successful implementation of the most valuable investments, recognizing that not all initiatives may proceed.
* Identify opportunities to adopt existing technology or identify opportunities for new innovation that still align with larger strategic objectives by collaborating with the Enterprise Architecture team.
* Develop a knowledge of the business units or value streams long-term goals and objectives while creating awareness within IDS of strategic business outcomes
* Contribute to the development of IDS and BRM strategies that support business goals and objectives by collaborating with enterprise architecture.
* Work closely with enterprise architecture to develop and maintain multi-year technology capability roadmaps to support the business plan and business capability development
* Work closely with PMO to ensure a healthy and well-managed initiative portfolio and align to Lean Portfolio Management best practices.
* Responsible for gathering cost base for initiatives and building high quality and reliable business cases leveraging Proof of Concepts and Minimum Viable Products to validate hypothesis statements.
* Communicate with all stakeholders to ensure the adoption of initiatives, be actively involved in ensuring the value is measured and recorded, and identifying and measuring leading indicators for each initiative
* Partner with the delivery teams to execute the investment portfolio, focus on business value instead of solutions.
* Collaborate with other business partners and business relationship managers to identify cross-functional opportunities and challenges
* Constructively work within the wider IDS team to ensure business knowledge is cascaded to the delivery teams. Promote the value of IDS and engage positively to ensure appropriate recognition.

**You Are Meant For This Job If**

* Recognized University Degree in IT or technology related subject or proven relevant experience

* 6 to 8 years experience within IT / Software Services / Technology related discipline
* Excellent awareness of IT market & technology changes. Ideally within the Energy industry.
* Change management facilitation and ability to guide and influence acceptance of new processes and use of technology. This includes the people side of change to influence a sponsor coalition and employee managers
* Ability to balance user, stakeholder and technical needs within budgets and demanding timelines
* Business analytical skills (numerical, analytical and critical thinking skills)

Strategy Development

title: Program Manager I, Flex Advocacy Operations
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Flex program uses independent drivers—called delivery partners—to deliver to our customers. Through the Amazon Flex app, drivers sign up for the program, schedule pickup times, are guided during routes with the navigation system, and more.
  
  
As the Amazon Flex Program Manager, you will be responsible for the strategy and initiatives aimed at improving the quality and efficiency of the deliveries carried out by the program. To achieve your goals, you'll work with diverse areas of the organization, including technology, operations, and marketing. A successful program manager will work to enhance the experience of hundreds of drivers, both within operations and when carrying out delivery routes, through data analysis, identifying obstacles and problem spots, and implementing effective and well-defined standards. These improvements must be balanced with business needs and take into account key operational metrics. Effective stakeholder management skills are essential to balance these competing priorities and delivering effective solutions for our customers and drivers.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Support long-term strategic planning to improve quality and efficiency.
  
  

* Work closely with the areas of finance, marketing, capacity management, operations, engineering, and program management on process improvement and launch initiatives.
* Develop, implement, and oversee reports, ensuring clear visibility of project milestones and performance.
* Effectively influence stakeholders through collaboration and effective prioritization.
* Be responsible for key performance indicators and work closely with stakeholders to understand everyday opportunities and challenges in order to implement short and long-term solutions.
* Monitor the execution of projects and ensure that the delivery is at the appropriate quality level and in compliance with the expected deadline.
* Navigate and resolve ambiguities by applying creative problem solving skills.
* Identify and mitigate risks, preventing them from becoming larger problems.

**About The Team**
Amazon Flex's Advocacy Operations (AO) team is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Amazon Flex programs and initiatives worldwide. As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for defining and executing the program roadmap for the Advocacy Operations, translating strategic goals into structured programs, aligning stakeholders, and driving initiatives to completion across a complex, multi-marketplace landscape.
  
  
You will own programs end to end, shaping the charter and success metrics, building mechanisms and roadmaps, managing dependencies and risks, and reporting progress to senior leadership. Throughout this process you will drive continuous innovation and improvement to deliver fast, easy, and rich functionality that supports a best-in-class Delivery Partner (DP) and customer experience. A critical part of this role is working across teams and marketplaces. You will partner with Operations, Analytics, Tech/Product, Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders, and coordinate with regional teams across worldwide Flex-enabled marketplaces (US, CA, UK, IN, JP, AU, SG, MX, BR), to align priorities, drive consistent execution, and land programs that scale globally while respecting local nuances. You will lead through influence rather than direct authority aligned on shared goals across DP lifecycle, bulk communications, compliance workflows, and programmatic support.
  
  
You will play a pivotal role in defining and delivering strategic automation initiatives, identifying opportunities to build long-term, scalable solutions that eliminate manual work without negatively impacting the DP experience. You will establish the mechanisms, standards, and reporting cadences that keep programs on track and give leadership clear visibility into progress, risks, and outcomes.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Knowledge of SQL

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams

You will direct multiple HCM streams, own the commercial outcome, build long-term client partnerships, and grow the next generation of Workday leaders in a fast-growing global consulting firm.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As Workday HCM Functional Consulting Manager, you oversee the delivery of multiple HCM streams or a mid-sized portfolio of client engagements. You are accountable for governance, client engagement, financial performance and people leadership. You work with Workday Leads, Solution Architects and client executives to deliver excellent, profitable outcomes and long-term partnerships, and you coach the leaders who will come after you.
  
  
What success looks like
  
  

* You direct multiple HCM streams or projects, balancing delivery, financials and risk.
* Client executives trust you for portfolio-level advice and direction.
* Your engagements land on scope, budget and timeline and hit profitability targets.
* You mentor and grow Workday Leads and senior consultants into future leaders.
* Your client relationships lead to renewals, expansions and long-term partnerships.

***Delivery***

* Oversee multi-stream Workday engagements, keeping functional, technical and integration tracks aligned.
* Define delivery frameworks and oversee project charters, governance plans and risk frameworks.
* Sponsor cutover planning and adoption at portfolio level.
* Provide executive delivery oversight on high-profile issues and escalations.

***Client engagement***

* Partner with client senior managers and executives to shape and monitor HCM roadmaps.
* Lead executive-level governance sessions and quarterly business reviews.
* Manage client escalations and drive resolution diplomatically.
* Identify opportunities for further transformation work.

* Align solutions and delivery approaches with the client's strategic objectives.
* Promote continuous improvement and efficiency across delivery.
* Drive adoption of newer Workday capabilities (Extend, Prism, Automation) where they add value.

* Allocate resources across engagements, balancing utilisation, growth needs and delivery demands.
* Mentor Workday Leads so they can take on larger portfolios.
* Coordinate with Sales, Solutions and Data practices to keep delivery efficient across practices.
* Build a collaborative, high-performance culture across teams.

***Commercial and quality management***

* Own P&L responsibility for your assigned portfolio or engagements.
* Track portfolio KPIs: margin, utilisation and client satisfaction.
* Apply governance and audit standards consistently.
* Capture lessons learned and apply them across the practice.

**Requirements**

* Extensive hands-on Workday HCM Functional Consulting experience, with a record of leading multi-stream or multi-project delivery.
* Proven track record delivering Workday HCM implementations across multiple modules, including post-go-live support.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery financials, such as P&L, margin and utilisation, in a consulting environment.
* Experience advising senior client stakeholders and executives, including leading governance forums and managing escalations.
* Experience managing, coaching and developing consultants and leads, including offshore teams.
* Commercial awareness: scope and change control, identifying expansion opportunities, and supporting renewals.
* A confident decision-maker and strong communicator who holds up under pressure.
* Passionate about team development and growing within the Workday ecosystem.

Everyone who joins our team is treated as a trusted member of the team, not a number. Ultimately your success is our success, so we invest in our People heavily. Here are the top reasons to join us:

At
**Mivada**
we believe that when you bring technology and the right people together, there's no limit to what you can achieve.

**Job Title: VP Client Relationship Servicing(CRS)**
CIB COO delivers strategic execution for the CIB businesses across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing throughout the customer lifecycle, and delivering safe growth supported by non-financial risk expertise, we collaborate across the global businesses and global functions to get it done.
  
  
Client Authorities & Confirmation Services (CACS) is part of the CIB CRS supporting CIB business by handling customer servicing requests across two journeys – Client Authorities and Audit Confirmation Services.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day operations leadership, the role holder is the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys - a critical, dual-mandate accountability that combines run-the-bank operations leadership with change-the-bank delivery ownership. This includes supporting the deployment of global technology solutions, working hand-in-hand with the Transformation function on requirements definition and testing, and directly shaping the future-state operating and technology architecture for CACS.
  
  
The role holder is equally accountable for the end-to-end client experience across CACS journeys: owning the process from first touch to completion, removing handoffs and delay between teams, and driving a continuous reduction in service SLAs/turnaround times - so clients experience a single, fast, joined-up service rather than a series of disconnected steps.
  
  
The role holder will oversee the general operations of the function including, but not limited to, financial planning/resource management, governance frameworks, digital implementation/adoption, performance management (OKRs, KPIs, SLAs), and stakeholder engagement, whilst additionally leading on ad-hoc initiatives as they arise to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of the function’s strategy and desired client outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the end-to-end client experience for Audit Confirmations and Mandates/Authorities journeys, acting as the single point of accountability across the full process rather than for individual process steps. Redesign and simplify the CACS operating model to minimise handoffs and touchpoints between teams, reducing cycle time, rework and risk of error at each handover. Use client feedback, complaints and journey/turnaround-time analytics to identify friction points in the end-to-end process and prioritise fixes accordingly.
* Own and drive delivery of Client Authorities & Confirmation Services, objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned to CIB CRS priorities. Act as a primary point of contact and coordinator for relevant CIB Servicing Business Stakeholders and partner teams supporting CIB customers. Partner with business stakeholders to shape and agree the service proposition, including management information, service performance, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Act as the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys, owning the CACS-side accountability for translating business and client needs into deliverable, adopted technology outcomes. Drive the digital change agenda to improve customer experience, reduce operational effort across the end-to-end customer journey, and support and/or lead delivery of strategic tooling and automation initiatives (e.g., digital workflow and AI-enabled solutions) to enable the future-state servicing architecture and its adoption.
* Partner closely with the global Transformation function throughout the delivery lifecycle — defining and prioritising business requirements, validating solution design against operational reality, and sequencing releases against CACS servicing priorities.
* Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CACS-impacting releases: design test scenarios, coordinate subject-matter-expert testers from the operations team, triage and track defects, and provide formal sign-off ahead of go-live. Track and report transformation milestones, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation to CIB CRS leadership, ensuring the CACS journey transformation stays aligned to global programme timelines. Champion change adoption within the CACS team — ensuring readiness, training, communication and embedding of new tools and ways of working through go-live and hypercare.
* Provide leadership across a diverse, multi-location and/or virtual team environment, driving performance to global standards in a matrix structure. Act as the primary representative for Client Authorities & Confirmation Services for the relevant value stream and stakeholders. Build a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, pace and accountability, ensuring teams understand priorities, processes and expected outcomes. Lead, coach, and develop a large team of specialists, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Proven ability to run a large, multi-market teams across geographies and operating effectively across cultures and diverse working environments. Comfortable partnering with technology/ transformation teams to shape and adopt new tools – doesn’t need to run the transformation just needs to engage credibly and hold the CACS team accountable for adoption.
* Track record of client-centric decision-making prioritising client outcome over internal convenience. Demonstrable communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and drive alignment between operations, technology and client-facing audiences.
* Strong commercial mindset, including financial management capability and business acumen. Proven leadership and team management skills, with a focus on developing and motivating team members and experience in managing large, virtual teams. A natural go getter who moves things forward rather than escalating and waiting.
* Energised by ambiguity and comfortable running BAU, people, transformation agendas in parallel. Dedicated to being an early adopter of new technology and nurturing and environment where teams are excited to pilot new ways of working and technologies in the pursuit of sustainable improvements. Comfortable operating at the intersection of operations and technology, translating business needs into clear, testable requirements. Client-first mindset — instinctively thinks in terms of the client's end-to-end experience rather than individual internal process steps.
* Resilient under competing priorities and reprioritises on their own rather than needing structure imposed direction. CIB CRS / Servicing Operations leadership and regional/country teams. CIB CRS – Global and Regional Leads. Product partners and product teams (Trade, GPS, Credit) supporting CIB clients. Global Transformation and Technology delivery teams (product owners, business analysts, engineering) supporting servicing transformation and tooling. Control functions and key partners as required to support safe, compliant servicing delivery

**Your Responsibilities**

Capability Design and Governance Alignment- Contribute customer, product, delivery, and adoption perspectives to service and feature design.

* Align delivery with approved observability standards, technology controls, operational-readiness expectations, and applicable risk, compliance, and audit requirements.

People and Squad Leadership- Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, including a Scrum Master and assigned developers.

title: Release Manager - SAP Platform [T500-30227]
description:
**About Costco Wholesale:**

Costco Wholesale is a multi-billion-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries. They provide a wide selection of quality merchandise, plus the convenience of specialty departments and exclusive member services, all designed to make shopping a pleasurable experience for their members.

**About Costco Wholesale India:**

At Costco Wholesale India, we foster a collaborative space, working to support Costco Wholesale in developing innovative solutions that improve members’ experiences and make employees’ jobs easier. Our employees play a key role in driving and delivering innovation to establish IT as a core competitive advantage for Costco Wholesale.

**Position: Release Manager - SAP Platform**

**Position Summary:**

Release Managers are responsible for the release lifecycle. This includes the planning, scheduling, coordinating, and overall management of the software build process through the different stages within Costco's delivery lifecycle. Release Managers are responsible for creating detailed integrated release plans across several products and dependencies, for improving the software build process, and for optimizing the release pipeline. Release Managers build and maintain relationships with stakeholders, team members, and peers and are responsible for communicating release expectations and statuses across value streams, program stakeholders, and impacted users.

The SAP Platform Release Manager manages and orchestrates the cross-organizational efforts required to introduce applications, infrastructure, and middleware changes into both the non-production and production environments. The SAP Platform Release Manager is responsible for ensuring all capabilities required to package changes for delivery to users are in place, while maintaining the integrity and availability of the existing system. The SAP Platform Release Manager is responsible for setting and communicating release expectations across all involved teams and impacted users.

**Job Duties/Essential Functions:**

* Manages, organizes, and directs work for building and maintaining software, and infrastructure releases for their promotion through a series of non-production SAP landscapes, and leading to a production environment deployment.
* Manages, organizes, and directs releases that comprise of cross-functional teams, and a multitude of interrelated and independent application and/or infrastructure changes.
* Manages and drives deployment risk mitigation practices (i.e., back out/contingency planning) for the duration of the release cycle to ensure an organized and successful deployment.
* Develops and stewards the Release Management process, along with establishing specific standards to govern the process.
* Creates deployment plans in smart sheets, and ensures dependencies are identified and managed accordingly.
* Coordinates/consumes production releases, support packs, retro-fits, and changes from all projects within the program landscape.
* Ensures strategies are developed for effectively managing change across the solution landscape and platform.
* Establishes and communicates release expectations, milestones, and release activity progress across all involved teams.
* Provides reports for and across all involved teams.
* Develops and maintains a release management discipline based on experience, best practices, and proven methodologies.
* Facilitates planning and documentation of rollback strategies, hypercare support, and handoff to production support teams.
* Facilitates the execution of mock and production cutovers.
* Conducts release readiness reviews, kick-offs, deployment planning meetings, and Go/No-Go meetings.
* Creates and owns a lessons learned document and drives change to continually improve the release process.
* Assures appropriate change management processes are followed for all required technical changes (e.g., patching, OSS notes) and have been applied to all appropriate environments.
* Coordinates with various teams to manage release scheduling for all in scope applications and maintains the master release schedule. Proactively plans system patching and application upgrades/enhancements to minimize release impact and risk.
* Communicates and coordinates with all stakeholders to ensure the required training and/or communication is provided to the affected user community (Service Desk, OCM, Business, IT).
* Documents to ensure that approved entrance/exit criteria artifacts required for production deployment are in place.
* Documents pre and post-deployment issue resolution within defined SLAs.
* Identifies and resolves problems often anticipating issues before they occur or before they grow; develops and evaluates options and implements solutions.
* Partners with Project Manager(s) on development release strategy and deployment plans.
* Regular and reliable workplace attendance at your assigned location.

**Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery:**

* Computer, phone, printer, copier, fax

**Non-Essential Functions:**

* Assists in other areas of the department as necessary.
* Assists in other areas of the company as necessary.

**Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery:**

* Same as essential functions

**Experience, Skills, Education & Licenses/Certifications:**

**Required:**

* Master’s or Engineering Degree in Computer Science (or equivalent technical field) as explicitly required to understand complex SAP software architectures, technical dependencies, and integration environments.
* 5+ Years of Dedicated Software Release Management: Proven experience planning, scheduling, orchestrating, and executing enterprise software builds and cutovers across complex, multi-tiered non-production and production landscapes.
* Hands-on Cutover & Deployment Execution: Proven track record of leading mock cutovers, live production cutovers, hypercare support, and Go/No-Go readiness reviews.
* Risk Mitigation & Incident Management: Hands-on experience developing rollback/contingency strategies, enforcing entrance/exit criteria, and leading rapid pre- and post-deployment issue resolutions within defined SLAs.
* Direct SAP Project Lifecycle Experience: Deep understanding of SAP-specific deployment practices, including SAP Transport Management System (TMS), ChaRM, dual-landscape maintenance (retrofit processes), system patching, and OSS Notes application.
* SAP Finance Domain Familiarity: Working familiarity with SAP Finance modules to evaluate release risks, business impacts, and cutover sequencing specifically tailored to financial period-ends and high-availability retail financial operations.

**Job Description:**
**Curriculum Operations Senior Associate**
Position Summary
  
  
The Curriculum Operations Senior Associate (India) works as part of the Audit Learning Strategy team, and closely with the Learning Design team, business unit subject matter experts, and other Development & Performance team members to support the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Audit learning curriculum.
  
  
This individual serves as a key operational partner responsible for executing curriculum management processes, coordinating learning asset updates, and ensuring learning content remains current, compliant, and accessible. The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, project coordination capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across a large and complex curriculum portfolio.
  
  
The Curriculum Operations Senior Associate plays a critical role in supporting Audit learning initiatives by managing curriculum and learning design lifecycle activities, coordinating annual content reviews, maintaining learning assets, supporting live learning programs, and ensuring compliance with firm and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Learning Design Lifecycle
  
  

* Partner directly with the design team to manage eLearning lifecycle activities, monitoring progress against established timelines and ensuring work advances in alignment with the team’s priorities.
* Maintain tracking tools to ensure eLearning portfolio and pipeline remain current and aligned with business priorities.
* Execute recurring curriculum management processes, including coordinating course updates, deactivations, closedowns, conversions, and archive activities.
* Coordinate annual review activities by initiating review cycles, tracking progress, communicating with subject matter experts, and documenting required changes.
* Validate course updates, assessments, answer keys, and supporting materials prior to publication.
* Manage eLearning session uploads and updates within learning systems and associated platforms.
* Support the administration of non-CPE learning content, including recording management, SCORM conversions, and learning playlists.
* Ensure curriculum materials are accurate, accessible, organized, and aligned with established standards.

Compliance Assurance
  
  

* Ensure compliance with and documentation of NASBA, AICPA, and internal Crowe standards.
* Coordinate technical reviews and required approvals with subject matter experts and stakeholders.
* Conduct compliance quality assurance reviews of learning materials, review and final exam questions, and supporting resources.
* Maintain documentation supporting compliance and curriculum governance processes.

Learning Program Support
  
  

* Maintain and update participant-facing materials, including agendas, surveys, and resource pages.
* Maintain and update SharePoint sites and learning resource repositories.
* Support Audit learning program preparation and post-event activities.
* Conduct testing and support quality reviews of learning sites, course environments, and learner experiences.
* Coordinate with learning delivery, design, and technology teams to support successful program execution.

Project Coordination and Operational Support
  
  

* Coordinate curriculum management activities across multiple concurrent projects and initiatives.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, and action plans.
* Partner with internal learning teams, external vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Escalate risks, delays, or issues that may impact project timelines or learner experience.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to streamline curriculum management processes and improve operational efficiency.

Stakeholder Communication and Collaboration
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with Audit subject matter experts.
* Communicate eLearning project status, upcoming deadlines, review requirements, and curriculum updates to stakeholders.
* Coordinate with learning strategy, design, technology, and program delivery teams to support curriculum initiatives.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong curriculum management and learning operations experience.
* Excellent organizational and project coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience maintaining complex learning portfolios and curriculum records.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams.
* Ability to support learning projects and assets with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to develop and edit content according to specific clients’ needs.
* Commitment to process improvement and operational excellence.
* Working knowledge of instructional design principles and eLearning technologies, such as Articulate 360, and an interest in expanding hands-on design and development capabilities.
* Proficiency in using project management tools, such as Microsoft Office applications and SharePoint, to track and communicate project status, issues, and risk.
* Experience with SharePoint and Microsoft Office applications, from design, formatting, and functionality lens to create elevated learner experiences.

**General Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in learning and development, curriculum administration, learning operations, program coordination, or related fields.
* Experience supporting large-scale learning curricula, eLearning or learning programs.
* Experience with the practical application of instructional design and adult learning theory to help guide and support our design team to deliver visually compelling solutions and provide a rewarding experience for the learner.
* Experience working in a professional services environment preferred.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and managing multiple stakeholders.
* Experience with Microsoft Office applications, SharePoint, project management tools, and learning technologies.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

description:

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. **Description**
**Position Summary:**
The Senior Electrical Engineering Manager will provide technical and people leadership for the PCBA Center of Excellence in Hyderabad. This role requires strong hands-on experience in electrical and PCBA product development, ideally in complex or regulated products such as scientific instruments, diagnostics, or medical devices.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead the technical evaluation and implementation of design improvements, cost-optimization opportunities, and product lifecycle changes while ensuring that performance, quality, reliability, compliance, and manufacturability requirements are met.
  
  
The role will also strengthen the CoE's technical capabilities, engineering governance, and ability to partner effectively with R&D, site engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
  
  
**What you will do:**
**Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership and deep expertise in electrical and embedded systems design, including power electronics, motor control, precision analog, RF, and embedded systems, to review, challenge, and validate PCBA design and VAVE opportunities.
* Review and guide system- and board-level architectures, design changes, and component selection.
* Apply end-to-end electrical and PCBA product-development experience to assess product architecture, technical risk, design changes, and verification and validation requirements.
* Lead technical trade-off analyses across performance, cost, risk, reliability, and manufacturability.
* Partner with R&D and site engineering teams to convert technical concepts into robust, validated, and executable design solutions.
* Ensure disciplined engineering practices, including simulation, analysis, structured design reviews, and appropriate technical documentation.

**Value Engineering and Cost Productivity**

* Lead the identification, evaluation, and execution of PCBA value-engineering opportunities.
* Build and manage a pipeline of cost and design-improvement initiatives across sites and suppliers.
* Review and challenge internal and external proposals to ensure technical and business viability.
* Drive alternate-component and alternate-design assessments for cost reduction, supply continuity, and lifecycle improvement.
* Ensure VAVE opportunities are supported by appropriate technical analysis, risk assessment, verification, validation, and implementation planning.
* Ensure that proposed changes meet performance, quality, regulatory, reliability, and manufacturability requirements.

**Governance and Operational Excellence**

* Establish technical governance, standardized workflows, review criteria, decision points, ownership, and documentation requirements for evaluating, approving, validating, and implementing PCBA design and VAVE opportunities.
* Improve productivity and execution by clarifying expectations, reducing rework, and driving consistent engineering practices across the CoE.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as a key interface among the PCBA CoE, R&D, site engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
