title: Senior Manager, Data & Integrations
description:
**Job Description**
**Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations**
**Summary/Objective**
The Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations is the people leader and delivery owner for isolved's India-based data and integrations personnel. This role is fluent across both sides of the house: on the data side, this person needs to operate at the same architectural depth expected of isolved's Principal Data Architect, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling, data lineage, integrity, and governance, alongside hands-on fluency in Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch; and on the integrations side (system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, with deep API understanding, source and target schema design, master data management, and golden record configuration and management). This person owns hiring, coaching, and performance management for all India personnel on the data and integrations teams, and partners closely with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones so that the India team operates as a fully integrated extension of isolved's global data and integrations organization.
  
  
**Core Job Duties**

* Serve as the primary people leader for all India-based personnel on the data and integrations teams, spanning data platform, data engineering, and integration automation disciplines.
* Conduct 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to support the growth of the India team.
* Hire, onboard, and build a high-performing, collaborative India-based data and integrations organization.
* Set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, and address performance issues effectively.
* Partner with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones.
* Ensure consistent standards, practices, and quality bar between the India and U.S. data and integrations teams.
* Own delivery of system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, including source and target schema design and mapping between isolved and its ecosystem of ERP, CRM, and partner systems.
* Own master data management and golden record configuration and management practices for the India team's scope of work, applying matching, deduplication, and survivorship standards.
* Maintain deep, working knowledge of APIs, including how to design, secure, and structure them for reliable, scalable, automated execution.
* Oversee data platform and analytics engineering work in India, including administration and support of Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch.
* Own data architecture standards for the India team's scope of work, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views, in partnership with the Principal Data Architect.
* Own data lineage, integrity, and cleanliness standards for India-delivered data work, and ensure the team applies data governance and cataloging practices (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation) consistently with global standards.
* Apply data quality and testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests) to catch and resolve data issues before they reach downstream consumers.
* Ensure the India team's data pipeline work spans the full lifecycle, from ingestion through transformation, storage, and downstream consumption, including batch and, where appropriate, real-time/streaming patterns.
* Factor data lifecycle, retention, archival, and storage/compute cost optimization into architecture and delivery decisions.
* Maintain expert-level fluency in SQL and strong hands-on fluency in PySpark, sufficient to review, guide, and, when needed, directly contribute to complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Track and balance capacity and workload across the India team, coordinating handoffs and shared work with U.S. shifts to keep delivery continuous across time zones.
* Represent the India team in global roadmap, planning, and prioritization discussions, bringing India-specific context and constraints into those conversations.
* Serve as an escalation point for production data and integration issues originating from or affecting the India team, coordinating incident response with U.S. counterparts as needed.
* Promote adoption of AI-assisted development and automation tools, and establish metrics to improve engineering productivity and delivery reliability.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, security, integrations, and analytics stakeholders in both India and the U.S. to ensure platform effectiveness and data integrity.

**Job Complexity**
Works on issues of significant scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including cross-regional business and operational considerations. Establishes objectives and work plans for the India data and integrations organization, and exercises judgment in adapting global standards and priorities to local execution. Erroneous decisions or judgment could result in delays in schedules and may impact the overall success of the function. Develops and administers schedules, staffing plans, and performance requirements for the India team; may have budget responsibilities.
  
  
**Interaction**
Frequently interacts with senior management, functional peer group managers, and cross-regional counterparts in the U.S. and India, normally involving matters between functional areas, regions, or business units. Regularly leads a cooperative effort among India and U.S. team members to align on priorities, execution, and planning across time zones.
  
  
**Supervision**
Manages the coordination of the activities of the India data and integrations organization, with responsibility for results, including costs, methods, and staffing. Understands management practices, particularly around professional development and cross-regional team coordination, and is skilled at handling difficult management situations independently.
  
  
**Experience**
Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of direct experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or integration engineering, with 4+ years of people management experience, including experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
  
  

* 8-10+ years of professional experience spanning both data engineering/data platform work and systems integration work.
* 4+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Proven experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams, ideally coordinating with U.S.-based counterparts across time zones.
* Well-versed in both the data side of the house (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch) and the integrations side of the house (system-to-system data integrations, ideally with Workato).
* Principal-level depth on the data architecture side: strong understanding of medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views.
* Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with PySpark, sufficient to guide and review complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e.g., Microsoft Purview) and data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests).
* Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse platform and Airflow or equivalent tooling for pipeline orchestration.
* Experience with data sharing technologies and patterns (e.g., Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing), including the governance and access considerations they require.
* Understanding of data lifecycle management, retention/archival policies, and storage/compute cost optimization.
* Deep understanding of APIs, including designing, securing, and structuring them for reliable, automated execution.
* Strong understanding of source and target schema design and mapping for system-to-system integrations.
* Experience with master data management and golden record configuration and management, including matching, deduplication, and survivorship logic.
* Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently address complex, cross-regional challenges.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across geographies, time zones, and cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to translate global priorities and standards into local execution plans.
* Preferred Qualifications:

+ Direct hands-on experience with Workato
+ Experience with Parabola.io or comparable low-code automation tools
+ Familiarity with streaming/real-time data technologies (e.g., Kafka, Event Hubs) as a complement to batch pipeline experience
+ Hands-on experience with big data ecosystem services such as Hadoop, Hive, HBase, YARN, and Spark
+ Professional services or customer-facing implementation experience
+ Experience operating in a follow-the-sun or globally distributed delivery model

**Position Details**
**Physical Demands:**
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  
  
**Travel Required:**
Yes, up to 15% travel may be required, including periodic travel to the U.S. for team and stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Work Authorization:**
Employee must be legally authorized to work in India.
  
  
**FLSA Classification:**
Exempt
  
  
**Location:**
India (Hybrid/Remote)

* Support program governance: milestone planning, dependency mapping, critical path tracking, and risk management.

**Collaboration & Growth (5%)**

* Share knowledge and delivery practices with peers and project leads.

title: Manager/Sr. Manager, Engineering - AI Platform
description:
We are looking for a Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering for our AI Platform team. Someone who can take ownership of a fast-growing, high-visibility team building the agentic foundation for SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how AI agents get built, governed, and shipped across the company.
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features.
  
  
The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs.
  
  
You will partner closely with the Product Manager for AI Platform to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
**Team leadership and development**

* Lead and grow the AI Platform team, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
* Develop individual engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, and honest feedback
* Hire and onboard new engineers into an already fast-moving workstream as scope grows

**Delivery and operations**

* Own delivery of the AI Platform roadmap: production readiness for Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo, the Agent Development Stack, evaluation/trust/safety/guardrails, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP for SCD APIs
* Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health, keeping delivery and engagement strong
* Remove blockers before they slow the team down, and hold a high bar on security, compliance, and operational readiness

**Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration**

* Partner with the Product Manager to translate product strategy into an executable engineering plan
* Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks
* Collaborate across Product Development, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders

**Strategy and growth**

* Help shape SimCorp's agentic platform strategy as scope expands beyond today's capabilities
* Anticipate where the team needs to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
* Bring an informed point of view on responsible, safe, and governed AI agent development

**What We Value**
**Ownership and independence**
You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through.
  
  
**Management experience**
You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement.
  
  
**Technical grounding in AI and platform engineering**
You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with agent orchestration, LLM-based systems, APIs, and the trust/safety layer around them. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off.
  
  
**Communication clarity**
You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums.
  
  
**Result orientation and a growth mindset**
You focus on outcomes, not just activity, and drive your own growth and your team's.
  
  
**Distributed team experience and empathy**
Leading a distributed team takes clear communication, inclusive practices, and genuine attention to people's wellbeing. Experience with Scandinavian or European teams, and comfort with remote work, is a plus.
  
  
**Structured thinking in ambiguous situations**
AI technology and the team's scope are still evolving. You create clarity, manage capacity with discipline, and align with stakeholders without escalating every decision.
  
  
**Collaborative by default**
You know when to align, when to decide, and when to push back - and do all three constructively, fitting naturally with how we work
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.

IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.

Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.

**Role**

We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-impact programmes across multiple engineering teams. This senior role is the critical connective layer between engineering, product, architecture, and leadership. responsible for resolving cross-team dependencies, driving delivery of intricate technical projects, and ensuring predictable, high-quality outcomes at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency combined with exceptional programme management skills, and thrives in navigating ambiguity across distributed, multi-disciplinary teams within a regulated fintech environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cross-Team Dependency & Complex Delivery Management**

* Own and drive resolution of cross-team technical dependencies across 8–12+ engineering squads
* Establish and maintain programme-level dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths
* Lead planning and execution of complex, multi-team deliveries spanning months or multiple quarters
* Identify inter-team blockers early and orchestrate timely resolution with engineering leads and architects
* Coordinate integration milestones, shared API contracts, and platform-level dependencies across squads

**Delivery & Release Governance**

* Define and enforce delivery governance frameworks for large-scale technical programmes
* Ensure production readiness through structured release checkpoints, go/no-go criteria, and sign-off processes
* Oversee end-to-end release management across parallel workstreams, coordinating across QA, DevOps, and Platform teams
* Monitor programme health, critical path, and execution risks; escalate proactively to leadership
* Drive standardization of release and deployment governance across the engineering organization

**Technical Programme Leadership**

* Partner with Engineering Leads, Principal Engineers, and Architects to translate technical strategy into actionable delivery plans
* Lead structured programme ceremonies: dependency syncs, architecture reviews, cross-team planning, and programme-level retrospectives
* Maintain and evolve Agile and hybrid delivery frameworks tailored to programme complexity and team maturity

title: Technical Content Manager
description:
**About WPP Production**
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
  
  
**About WPP**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
  
  
**A hybrid working model**
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around three days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
**What does a Technical Content Manager do at WPP Production?**
The Content Management organization at WPP Productions is responsible for publishing creative assets, experiences, and critical digital content to our client websites and other platforms across the globe. A
**Technical Content Manager**
reports to the Head of Content Management and works closely with both the Content Management organization and external teams to examine processes and systems in order to encourage standardization and identify potential for improvement, and ensure client interactive deliverables are completed accurately and on time. This includes ownership of the content management and publishing operations in support of our client’s product launches and other digital marketing programs, including setting up and managing page structure and content in a CMS (content management system).
  
  
Core responsibilities of a Technical Program Manager include monitoring and analyzing current processes and system features/bugs from the point of view of the Interactive Content Management team. This role produces recommendations for process and system improvements where possible; disseminates information to internal and external teams when applicable; performs some day-to-day content management tasks; facilitates cross-functional collaboration across the Marcom organization; and maintains full knowledge of an ever-changing set of tools and processes.The Technical Program Manager also actively elevates the efficiency, accuracy, and consistency of the Interactive Content Management team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the content management approach to workflow and toolsets
* Work with the CM and producer teams to identify gaps in workflow and toolsets
* Make recommendations for improvements to workflow and toolsets
* Work across functional stakeholder groups to define use cases, functional requirements, and enhancements for content management platforms.
* Represent content management in platform/workflow strategic initiatives, e.g. user acceptance testing, side projects to explore new workflows or tools.
* Manage builds of content management platforms, including testing and training other team members
* Act as a source of truth for the content management team with regards to process, workflow, systems, and tools
* Create documentation and training materials for assigned CMS and publishing platforms
* Work with the content management and developer teams to standardize page structures and agree upon project approaches
* Maintain complete understanding of complexities of CMS and other internal tools
* Troubleshoot system issues as a part of the first line of defense
* Contribute to the evolution of internal platforms and processes by providing feedback on toolsets, UI, best practices, and workflow optimization
* Own documentation initiatives for applicable projects, including creating new documentation, updating old documentation, organizing the team wiki, and disseminating that information to the team for both day-to-day and training needs
* Collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external teams
* Actively balance the work of monitoring and analyzing system issues, organizing and prioritizing feedback, documenting issues and solutions, making contributions to project work, and standardizing approach and best practices for the content management team in a fast-paced, ever-evolving work environment

**Requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher; preferably with a focus on marketing, design, or communication
* 5+ years experience working on web production teams
* Mastery of Adobe Experience Manager or other CMS
* Knowledge of HTML, XML, JSON, and enterprise CMS a plus
* Experience with localization and managing content for a global audience, using a CMS
* Deep knowledge of how content management and other related system processes work
* Record of troubleshooting and diagnosing CMS issues, and communicating those issues to both technical and non-technical personnel
* Experience in building out new or proprietary CMS
* Demonstrated success in business process improvement and re-engineering
* Proven ability to manage ambiguity effectively
* Experience creating and managing internal tools a plus
* Excellent communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to work with others in an unpredictable environment
* Flexible schedule to deal with rapidly-changing, time-constrained launch schedules
* High degree of ownership and accountability
* Able to balance and prioritize multiple projects and assignments
* Highly detail-oriented, organized, and patient
* Familiarity with Git and Typescript a plus
* Experience working with third party agencies, interfacing with client

**Why work here:**
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
  
  
**Inclusion and Impact**
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
**Data**
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
  
  
**Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.**

title: SAP Upgrade Planning-Deputy Director
description:
**Overview**
The size and complexity of our SAP landscape with 20+ SAP products & 800+ instances, combined with multiple deadlines for patching / versioning & end of life and deep dependencies across strategic programs—make SAP Upgrades a mission‑critical function.
  
  
Over the next 5+ years, we will have to efficiently run all the large business critical upgrades with 100% efficiency & no disruption to business – factoring in the deeply integrated global landscape.
  
  
The upgrade planning manager is a strategic role which develops and maintains the PepsiCo SAP multi year upgrade strategy in collaboration with SAP and PepsiCo teams
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Primary
  
  

* 'Own the multi-year SAP upgrade roadmap across all PepsiCo platforms, markets and regions
* Prioritize upgrade initiatives based on risk, business value, innovation, and SAP support deadlines
* Identify and resolve cross-program dependencies and conflicts before execution begins
* Align with SAP/vendor roadmaps, licensing changes, and product lifecycle milestone
* Develop AOP plans including funding, resources, environments, and governance approvals
* Maintain and promote a single source of truth at the system ID level in the applications' inventory

Shared
  
  

* Partner with Infrastructure and Cloud teams to align upgrade roadmaps with hosting capacity, environment strategy, and platform modernization plans
* Partner with Functional/DSO teams and Product Owners to prioritize upgrades based on business value, risk, and operational calendars
* Partner with Testing teams to estimate effort and reserve test windows, environments, and long-range regression capacity for upcoming releases
* Partner with SAP/Vendors and Architecture teams to assess dependencies, product lifecycle changes, and required remediation actions-
* Partner with Modernization team ensuring there is a wholistic view of the global SAP roadmap and north start which includes not only Upgrades but also modernization re-platform applications

Decision Rights
  
  

* Approve and maintain the multi-year SAP upgrade roadmap, sequencing, and prioritization of initiatives
* Decide go/no-go for entering execution based on readiness, dependencies, funding, and resource availability
* Decide whether upgrades priorities should be changed, accelerated or deferred based on risk and business priorities

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in SAP programs, ERP transformations, or enterprise technology strategy-Proven experience building multi-year roadmaps for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, cloud, and adjacent platforms
* Strong knowledge of SAP product lifecycle, maintenance deadlines, licensing, and vendor governance
* Experience managing cross-functional dependencies across infrastructure, security, data, testing, and business teams
* Executive presence with ability to influence senior leadership, secure funding, and drive prioritization decisions

title: Local Project Coordinator
description:

* Attend project meetings and support consultants and host organizations in staying aligned on SOW objectives and deliverables.
* Support program monitoring, documentation, expense tracking, and final narrative and financial reporting as requested.

**Logistics and on-ground coordination**

* Support sourcing, coordination, and negotiation of accommodation, transportation, meeting venues, and other local services as required.
* Coordinate program launch and closing events, including venue, suppliers, participant communications, and run-of-show logistics.
* Prepare practical Hyderabad orientation materials and local guidance for visiting SAP consultants.
* Support arrival orientation, local movement, stakeholder meetings, and project-related travel arrangements.
* Act as an accessible on-ground logistical resource and troubleshoot issues promptly.
* Coordinate with PYXERA Global staff on local safety and security arrangements and escalate concerns promptly.

**Qualifications**

* Based in Hyderabad, with strong local networks and familiarity with the city and its social impact ecosystem.
* Degree in project management, development, sustainability, nonprofit management, communications, event management or a related field.
* Approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience preferred, including project coordination and stakeholder management.
* Ability to assess organizational needs and contribute to gap analysis, SWOT analysis, and consulting SOW development.
* Experience with nonprofits, social enterprises, cross-cultural teams, and/or skills-based volunteering is highly desirable.
* Excellent written and spoken English; Telugu and/or Hindi language skills are advantageous.
* Strong organizational, communication, facilitation, service orientation, and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and collaborating with a geographically distributed team.

**Consultancy terms and selection**

The engagement will be contracted on a project basis, with the scope, expected deliverables, level of effort, payment terms, and precise duration agreed before commencement.

Fees will be agreed in Indian rupees, taking account of the proposed rate, relevant experience, and project needs.

**Shortlisted candidates will be invited to at least two rounds of interviews and are expected to come prepared with their proposed daily consulting rate (INR) for the assignment.**

**How to apply**

Please email a cover letter, résumé, three professional references, and your proposed daily consulting rate to
**ConsultingOpportunities@PyxeraGlobal.org**
with the subject line “
**Hyderabad – Local Project Coordinator – SAP Global Social Sabbatical**
.”

**Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.**
PYXERA Global may consider successful consultants for future assignments.

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering Senior
description:

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead the design, development, and delivery of full-stack web applications using Python and Angular / React.
* Drive architecture decisions and technical solution design for data automation tools.

* Establish coding standards, best practices, and engineering excellence across the Data Tools team.
* Own end-to-end delivery of assigned projects, ensuring quality, timeliness, and alignment with Schwab Data standards.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Create and deliver presentations and demos to senior leadership, project sponsors, and technical peers.
* Support project planning, estimation, and delivery timelines.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product owners, QA, and DevOps.
* Partner with U.S.-based Data Tools team to ensure alignment, knowledge transfer, and consistent delivery quality.

**Operational Excellence**

* Implement scalable, compliant, and AI-assisted delivery frameworks tailored for a regulated financial services environment, driving faster time-to-market and improved engineering efficiency.
* Drive intelligent automation, retrospectives, and service reviews using AI-enabled insights to deliver measurable quality improvements and operational efficiencies.
* Ensure adherence to Schwab’s privacy, security, and regulatory standards while embedding automation and controls to proactively manage risk and compliance.
* Optimize team capacity and delivery performance through agile methodologies, data-driven decision-making, and planning to maximize productivity and throughput.

**Required Qualifications**
**Technical Expertise and Educational Requirements**

* Minimum 12 years of hands-on experience in software development with a focus on building tools and applications.

* Proven experience designing technical solutions and presenting them to architects for review and approval.

**Skills And Attributes**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills with ability to proactively provide creative solutions.
* Ability to clearly present complex technical ideas to senior leaders and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders.
* Execution focus: proven ability to operationalize strategy and deliver high-impact outcomes.
* Talent builder: experienced in coaching and developing high-performing teams.
* Strategic mindset: ability to translate team goals into actionable delivery plans and measurable results.
* Architects advanced processes to manage risks and regulate modifications per policy.
* Uncovers complex phenomena through sophisticated data analysis.
* Establishes robust processes to create, secure, and monitor data pipelines and stores.
* Optimizes processes for effective data asset governance.
* Leverages robust models and diagrams to convey data requirements.
* Develops QA processes that confirm compliance and ensure operational reliability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Refines strategies and workflows to ensure adaptability in evolving circumstances.

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

title: Program Manager - Technology
description:
**Company Description**

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**

**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Deputy / Assistant Manager (Government Partnership)
description:
**Job Title: Deputy / Assistant Manager (Government Partnership)**

**Location: Hyderabad, Telangana**

**Travel: As per the project need**

**Position Overview:**

This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with the Dept of School Education, Samagra Shiksha, Telangana Skill Education component as part of a dedicated Project Management Unit (PMU). The Assistant/ Deputy Manager will lead school based skill education reforms across the state, working directly with senior bureaucrats (including IAS officers) on Skill Education strengthening, managing co-ordination between National & State level Institutions in Education & Skilling domain, policy implementation & Tech & Data based governance improvement. Based in Hyderabad, the role combines strategic exposure, scale based execution and high-impact work in India’s skilling & education ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Govt & Stakeholder Engagement

* State & Central Ministry: Facilitate co-ordination between State School Education dept (Samagra Shiksha) & other Central institutions: Ministry of Education, NCVET, PSSCIVE, SSCs etc under established State & Centre channel for Samagra Shiksha based Skill Education delivery in schools
* Inter-State Depts: Facilitate coordination between Dept of School Education (Samagra Shiksha), SCERT, State Board, Dept of Skill Development & other relevant departments for School based Skill Education delivery support

2.School based Skill Education Delivery Facilitation at State Level

* Skill Education Delivery as per Scheme & Policy: Facilitate Skill Education delivery in Govt Schools at Scale in alignment with CSSVSE scheme, NEP-NCF mandate & State Vision for Skill Education for thousands of schools (Grade 6-12)
* Facilitate design & delivery of System setup in Schools: e.g-Skill lab setup in Schools, Skill Education Books delivery, Internships for School Students, AI integration in Skill Education curriculum etc
* Facilitate sufficient govt budget allocation to Skill Education in coordination with State School Education dept & Ministry of Education

3. Teacher Onboarding, Capacity Building

* Vocational Teacher Onboarding Facilitation: Support onboarding and management of vocational training partners (VTPs) & Vocational Teachers/ Trainers (VTs).
* Training: Coordinate Vocational/ Skill Education teacher training, Training of Trainers (ToT) and master trainer development.
* Support development of training resources and capacity-building systems.

4.Tech & Data Based Governance Improvement- Monitoring

* Facilitate effective monitoring through State based Monitoring platform; Monthly District & VTP review meeting; keeping IAS/State officers updated on progress through data & reports
* Prepare progress reports and analytical presentations for program reviews
* Facilitate large data collection from govt schools, analytics & outcome reporting to IAS & other senior officials for timely decision making around Skill Education

5. Drive Student Outcome

* Facilitate Students Internships (Grade 11-12), Career Counselling, Job Fairs, Higher Education pathways by planning & designing intervention at the State level
* Facilitate delivery of the same in schools as per State budget & program allocation

6. Team Management-PMU

* Manage PMU Team at State level
* Guide & Mentor all PMU team members of the State

7. PMU Operations & Government Coordination

* Support day-to-day functioning of the Skill/Vocational Education PMU at Samagra Shiksha, School Education Dept
* Coordinate with senior officers, including IAS and State Services officers, for meetings, reviews, and follow-ups
* Prepare briefing notes, presentations, concept notes, and action trackers for senior bureaucrat/IAS leadership
* Track meeting outcomes, decisions, and implementation timelines

8. Reporting & Documentation

* Prepare periodic progress reports, and presentations
* Maintain records of PMU activities, meetings, and outputs
* Ensure professional communication between Lend A Hand India and Government counterparts

9. Support to all LAHI’s Projects in Telangana: Need based support to other LAHI’s projects in Andhra Pradesh (SCERT, State Board, Skill Development Dept)

**About Lend A Hand India :**
Lend A Hand India (LAHI) is a leading national Think Tank/Non Profit Organisation with over 20 years of experience in strengthening India’s skill and vocational education ecosystem. LAHI works closely with 20+ State and UT governments through long-term partnerships, providing technical advisory and Project Management Unit (PMU) support to drive systemic reforms. In Telangana, LAHI partners with the Dept of School Education, Samagra Shiksha to support large-scale improvements in school based Skill Education (6-12) delivery. Currently, In 20+ States 22,000+ schools and 25 lakh + students are supported by LAHI through 300+ team members working Pan-India.

**Our Mission**

Equip School Students to Maximise Their Potential Through Skill Education

**Our Approach**

* Direct implementation in schools
* Partnership with central-state governments to define, and scale policy
* Building of Centres of Excellence that act as lighthouses for innovation
* Resource organisation for the skilling ecosystem

**Our Knowledge in Action**

Through the design & execution of innovative models from training centres, innovation hubs to mobile outreach initiatives, LAHI’s innovative knowledge resource drives both grassroots learning and systemic transformation across India. With 250+ LAHI staff embedded in state education systems across 20+ states, we provide technical and project management support, enabling governments to translate policy into action.

**Our Reach**

LAHI’s current scale of work includes -

* 20+ States and UTs
* 15000+ Schools
* 15 Lakh+ Students
* 250+ Team Members

**What Truly Sets a Career at Lend A Hand India Apart –**

* **Work as a Systems Architect, not just an Implementer:**

* **Experience the thrill of scale with depth:**
  See your ideas and efforts replicated across thousands of schools, impacting millions of students in a measurable way.
* **Master Complex Collaboration:**
  Gain unparalleled experience navigating and synergizing the worlds of government, corporate CSR, and community.
* **Career with a Tangible Legacy:**
  Your work directly creates skilled professionals, confident entrepreneurs, and a stronger national economy.
* **Investment in you:**
  We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive support & robust benefits and a culture that actively champions your professional development and holistic well-being.

**Minimum Experience:**

* Overall experience of 5-10+ years in Education & Govt PMU Management
* Prior experience of Education/Skill Development
* Prior experience of working with State level Senior bureaucrats/ IAS (preferred)
* Experience of relevant fellowship desirable (Education/Skilling: Gandhi, TFI, MGNF etc)
* Prior experience working with State or Central Government departments preferred

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Public Policy, Education, Management, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Relevant fellowships (e.g., MGNF, Gandhi Fellowship, TFI, etc.) will be an added advantage

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Language: Excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & Telugu
* Team management: Experience of Managing team, Ability to lead State PMU and manage/guide team members who are part of PMU
* Technical Skills: Experience of developing strategy & documentation for IAS/State level Govt officials use: State level presentations for Senior Bureaucrats; Policy/Guideline Drafts; Notesheets; Concept Notes, SOPs; tender work-technical support etc
* Ability to manage Govt projects at State level (notesheets, tender work-technical support, desk research work, orientation to senior officials about project details)
* Strong Expertise in Technical project writing work & data analytics-Report writing (Word, PPT) & large datasets analysis using excel
* Proficient in drafting official letters, note sheets, proposals, concept notes, SOPs, making presentations etc. (preferred)
* Proficient in large data analytics (excel & google sheet based) & presenting the findings via great visual presentation & report to senior officials
* Good understanding of India’s School Education system
* Ability to work in a government system with professionalism, discretion, and persistence
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills especially with Senior Bureaucrats/ Senior partners/management
* Proficient in communicating ideas, strategy to State level Senior Govt. officers
* High proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Personal Attributes:**

* Detail-oriented, proactive, and solution-focused
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

title: Director of Delivery Assurance
description:

* Manage end-to-end production of print materials, including scientific journals, medical education modules, calendars, brochures, booklets, newsletters, certificates, conference materials, and other marketing collaterals.
* Understand production briefs, artwork, quantities, dimensions, paper specifications, finishing requirements, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure all print jobs are executed according to approved specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor production schedules and proactively address delays or operational challenges.
* Vendor & Printer Management
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and maintain relationships with printing vendors, paper suppliers, binding units, packaging vendors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate with printers at every stage, from quotation and proof approval to production, inspection, dispatch, and delivery.
* Obtain competitive quotations from multiple vendors and assess them based on cost, quality, reliability, and turnaround time.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms to achieve cost efficiencies.
* Maintain an updated vendor database, including capabilities, pricing, turnaround times, and performance records.
* Knowledge of Paper & Print Specifications
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of paper types, grades, GSM, thickness, texture, opacity, and suitability for different print applications.
* Understand printing methods, including offset and digital printing, as well as lamination, UV coating, binding, folding, die-cutting, and other finishing techniques.
* Interpret technical specifications accurately, including dimensions, colour requirements, page counts, cover materials, binding styles, and packaging instructions.
* Verify that the paper and materials used by vendors match the approved specifications.
* Identify material substitutions or specification deviations before production and obtain approval wherever required.
* Costing & Budget Control
* Prepare and evaluate print production estimates and quotations.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure competitive pricing without compromising quality.
* Compare actual production costs against approved budgets and identify opportunities for savings.
* Track cost variations arising from changes in quantities, paper specifications, artwork, finishing, or delivery requirements.
* Ensure all commercial commitments and additional costs are documented and approved.
* Quality Control & Inspection
* Inspect samples, colour proofs, paper quality, print alignment, colour consistency, binding, finishing, and overall workmanship.
* Ensure the final output matches the approved artwork, specifications, sample, and purchase order.
* Identify defects such as incorrect GSM, colour variations, misprints, poor binding, damaged copies, and quantity shortages.
* Coordinate corrective actions, reprints, replacements, or vendor claims wherever necessary.
* Ensure that only approved, quality-checked materials are dispatched to clients or designated locations.
* Delivery & Logistics Coordination
* Ensure timely delivery of all print materials to clients, offices, warehouses, event venues, and other designated locations.
* Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners for dispatch schedules, packaging, transportation, and delivery tracking.
* Monitor committed delivery dates and escalate potential delays well in advance.
* Verify delivered quantities against purchase orders and dispatch records.
* Ensure appropriate packaging, labelling, carton identification, and shipment documentation for every delivery.
* Documentation & Reporting
* Maintain complete documentation for every print job, including:

+ Production briefs and approved specifications.
+ Vendor quotations and cost comparisons.
+ Purchase orders and work orders.
+ Artwork and proof approvals.
+ Paper specifications and quality inspection reports.
+ Delivery challans, e-way bills wherever applicable, invoices, and dispatch records.
+ Delivery confirmations, shortage reports, and quality-related claims.

* Maintain a production tracker covering job status, vendor, quantities, costs, deadlines, and delivery status.
* Provide regular updates to management and internal teams on production progress, delays, costs, and pending deliveries.
* Ensure records are accurate, traceable, and readily available for audits and financial reconciliation.
* Internal Coordination
* Work closely with client servicing, medical education, design, accounts, procurement, and operations teams.
* Clarify technical requirements before releasing jobs to printers.
* Ensure approved artwork, specifications, quantities, and delivery instructions are communicated clearly to vendors.
* Coordinate invoice verification against purchase orders, agreed pricing, and actual deliveries.
* Take ownership of production-related issues and ensure timely resolution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Printing Technology, Print Production, Graphic Arts, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant experience in print production, commercial printing, publishing, or production operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of paper quality, GSM, printing processes, binding, finishing, and packaging.
* Proven experience in vendor coordination, quotation evaluation, and cost negotiation.
* Strong understanding of production planning, quality control, inventory, and delivery management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and documentation, with the ability to maintain production trackers and cost comparison sheets.
* Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple jobs simultaneously.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time delivery rate of print jobs.
* Adherence to approved print specifications and quality standards.
* Cost savings achieved through vendor negotiations.
* Reduction in printing errors, reprints, wastage, and material shortages.
* Accuracy and completeness of production documentation.
* Vendor performance and responsiveness.
* Timely resolution of production and delivery issues.
* Adherence to approved budgets and purchase order values.

description:

The CTS Product Management team is looking for a dynamic Senior Product Specialist to join our Deep Sector Team to contribute to the expansion of Deep Sector Feeds in FactSet Fundamentals. Deep Sector is an initiative where FactSet collects new content, improves existing collection efforts in fundamentals, as well as develops new reports and functionality across 9 sectors: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance and Healthcare.
  
  
In this role, you will be expected to gain a comprehensive understanding of CTS products and delivery technologies, to be a key contributor to defining and expanding the product packages available, and to enhance and add features that provide connectivity, scalability, and enhanced usability. You will work closely with a broadly distributed group of Content, Product, Strategy, Sales & Support, Engineering, and Quality Assurance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Insights**
– Derives insights to support product bets
  
  

* Regularly gathers, Analyzes, and interprets feedback directly from clients and prospects to understand their problems and the gaps in our solutions and in the marketplace.
* Participates in product discovery. Proactively identifies the market and validates the opportunity to prove whether a solution is valuable, viable, feasible and usable before developing it.
* Contributes to defining the metrics that will measure product outcomes.

**Strategy**
– Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results
  
  

* Performs research and analysis that contributes to the product vision, strategic framework and roadmap.

**Execution**
– Delivers on product outcomes
  
  

* Serves as SME on the quality and nuances of the product. Knows the top issues and how to troubleshoot them. Serves as an internal resource to educate junior team members and support help desk on troubleshooting and best practices.
* Supports Product Managers by prioritizing issues that are critical to fix in order to improve the customer experience. Defines the problem space correctly and experiment with potential solutions before suggesting a specific fix.
* Adept at separating bugs from user error and stability issues. Escalates issues to Engineering appropriately.
* Assists to clearly define user needs and acceptance criteria with development teams. Helps to prioritize needs and provides clarity for iterating on solutions.
* Prioritizes the instrumentation and reporting of key product metrics.
* Is exposed to Agile principles and best practices.

**Leadership**
– Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes
  
  

* Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech/MCA or BBA/MBA. A combination of tech and finance would be ideal, although not mandatory.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy and roadmap
* Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
description:

You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery—from concept through detailed and construction design.

* Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables

+ Equipment sizing & selection
+ Mechanical design calculations
+ Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
+ P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
+ Mechanical data sheets and specifications

* Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design.
* Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements.
* Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews.

+ Project Responsibility Matrix
+ Basis of Design
+ Overall Design Programme
+ Schedule of Deliverables
+ Design Risk Register
+ Design Change Register

* Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications.
* Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling.
* Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability.
* Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation.

**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**

* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto

* Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
* Confident, approachable leader with strong client‑facing presence.
* Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication.
* Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‑quality mechanical design solutions.
* Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner.
* Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation.
* Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects.

* Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for

+ Water/wastewater pump stations
+ WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
+ Chemical dosing systems
+ Sludge handling systems
+ High‑lift/low‑lift pumping systems
+ Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc.)

* Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis.
* Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‑Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation.
* Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‑enabled environment.
* Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications.
* Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations.
* Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment.
* Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans.
* Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset.
* Strong interest in digital delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of mechanical workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field is advantageous

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large, complex water/wastewater facilities and pumping systems.
* Exposure to brownfield upgrades, shutdown/staging, and commissioning planning.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.

To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists.
