title: IT&D Manager, Smart Execution
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded IT&D Manager to lead the Smart Execution capabilities of the Sales Execution platform globally. The primary role is to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and the technology teams, owning the roadmap of the solution and manage the on-going deployment and adoption within the markets. The ultimate objective is to deliver insights which create value and drive business forward in the space of route-to-market, in-store execution and sales excellence, whilst ensuring synergy, cost effectiveness and appropriate levels of data governance.
  
  
This candidate will need to demonstrate an effective communication and delivery skillset and collaborate confidently with mid-senior levels of the organisation. We are looking for someone who can innovate, with the ability to encourage performance and motivate peers and the wider organisation to embrace advanced data & analytics capabilities.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Capability Management
  
  

* Define and own the feature roadmap for the Smart Execution capabilities, including RTM, Routing, In-store Execution and Order Recommendations
* Gather and translate business requirements from commercial and sales teams into technical user stories and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize backlogs and make decisions aligned to the business value
* Partner with the technology teams, data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and application developers to deliver the capabilities
* Manage the full technology lifecycle — from discovery and design through build, testing, and deployment
* Drive adoption of the Smart Execution capabilities across Sales (Retail Management, Key Account Management), Trade Marketing and Customer Supply, ensuring tools are effectively utilized to achieve business objectives
* Monitor usage and identify opportunities for improvement and enhancement
* Utilize a deep understanding of FMCG categories and external data to inform development and deployment strategies
* Work closely with other teams within Sales Execution Platform for a seamless integration of AI within existing workflows
* Manage vendor relationships, including implementation partners

Stakeholder Engagement:
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders of capabilities managed, building and maintaining strong relationships, and driving adoption
* Manage and communicate Roadmaps, providing details of delivery timelines, training and deployment to regional and market users
* Collaborate with and provide expertise and support to market teams, developing action plans based on analytical insights, refine processes and unlock new capabilities

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  
  

* Partner with Global and Regional commercial teams to develop analytics best practices, maintain and deliver these in the markets in alignment with the IT operating model
* Work with other Global IT&D Managers within the Sales Execution team to ensure alignment and leveraging the synergies between teams
* Ensure alignment of the technical delivery with the Reckitt’s data analytics platform - Trinity data architecture standards, patterns and principles. Align changes where necessary
* Implement solutions aligned to global IT&D enterprise architecture frameworks

The experience we're looking for
  
  
6-8+ years in business analysis, data science consulting or IT Management (with exposure to AI Product Management)
  
  

* Proven experience in designing, deploying and adopting analytical tools within commercial teams
* Experience in working with the Sales functions
* Preferred experience for role:
* FMCG / Consumer Goods experience preferred
* Previous hand-on Data Science experience preferred
* Exposure to Modern Trade and/or Pharmacy/OTC sales channels

The skills for success
  
  

* Technical Skills
* Familiarity with Sales Execution solutions or platforms
* Familiarity with Azure tech stack and Microsoft Power Platforms
* Ability to guide AI model development, managing trade-offs between data availability, model accuracy and business value delivered
* Ability to evaluate model performance and translate model outputs into business insights to drive stakeholder buy-in
* Designing experiments to measure value delivered and inferring/extrapolating results
* Delivering end-to-end ad hoc analyses including scoping, problem translation, solution design and insights generation
* Awareness of impact of solution architecture and solution design choices on infrastructure requirements
* Ability to write or review functional specifications
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and cross-functional team collaboration

Business Acumen
  
  

* Strong grasp of Sales Execution levers: execution compliance, on-shelf availability, MSL, share of shelf etc.
* Ability to translate commercial strategy and processes into design and decisions

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent stakeholder management across senior commercial and IT leadership
* Strong communication — able to speak both “business” and “tech”
* Analytical mindset with comfort around large datasets

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Senior Program Specialist
description:
**Description**
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Senior Program Specialist is an individual contributor role. This position is responsible for supporting execution of business operations and administrative management of USP’s Verification Programs. The role drives coordination of projects, tools, and processes that support market development to drive customer engagement, support internal and external communications, and enhance visibility into program activities against key success metrics. Key responsibilities also include preparation and distribution of internal reports, lead and prospect management, client relationship management (CRM), data and reporting optimization, and performance metric tracking. In addition, the position contributes to broader program operations and continuous improvement initiatives that support the growth of USP’s Verification Programs.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Senior Program Specialist Has The Following Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Verification staff and other stakeholders to coordinate and facilitate project activities, including but not limited to:
* Tracking and reporting on marketing and business performance
* Scheduling of project meetings and production of supporting materials
* Business action item and records management
* Develop and organize reports and business management processes to drive customer oversight and excellence using USP tools (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo, Tableau, etc.)
* Manage projects and tools aimed at driving visibility and accountability for program performance related to existing and new customers
* Assist in revenue, pricing and invoice tracking to ensure accuracy and timely reporting
* Track data from multiple sources, provide data entry for various systems to support tracking of customer status such as products, documents, and timelines.
* Develop reports and queries for systems supporting customer pipeline management
* Assist in preparation of reporting documents and presentations by assigned deadlines
* Actively contribute to Verification Program projects and initiatives
* Assist in capturing customer call reports and action items within CRM platform
* Facilitate communications and group interactions through interpersonal and tool-based skills to achieve project goals
* Work with management and coworkers to develop, improve, and standardize project-related processes
* Support cross-departmental and cross-divisional activities, as related to assigned projects
* Recognize and escalate issues that potentially require upper management awareness and input
* Secure services as needed from other departmental, divisional, and organizational groups
* Help with special projects upon request
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Required Skills And Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Minimum of five years of relevant professional experience with a combination of relevant project management skills and/or scientific background.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work across teams in a matrixed environment
* Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and efficiently manage multiple projects
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Advanced computer competence (MS Office, MS Teams, MS Project, Sharepoint, Copilot, etc.)
* Experience with business, sales and marketing platforms (e.g. Tableau) and CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo)
* Demonstrated ability to mobilize stakeholders towards results
* Demonstrated initiative and resourcefulness with good judgement about what can work and when additional support is needed
* High comfort with navigating through ambiguity and change
* Strong time management skills
* Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and team-building skills
* Excellent critical thinking and critical thinking skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent presentation and reporting skills

**Additional Desired Competencies**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or relevant professional experience
* Self-motivated and results-oriented
* Demonstrated ability to mobilize stakeholders towards results
* Demonstrated initiative and resourcefulness with good judgement about what can work and when additional support is needed
* High comfort with navigating through ambiguity and change
* Knowledge of USP products and services
* Experience with certification or audit programs
* Able to work flexible hours when needed in collaboration with global teams

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
None, this is an individual contributor role.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate’s skill set, experience, qualifications, equity, and other job-related reasons.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

Project Management
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

Product Development, system development, Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, Process Automisation, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Vendor Management, Outstanding Communication, stakeholder engagement, Digital Strategy, Product Solution Architecture, Cyber Security Strategy, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Portfolio Management, Data Governance, Product Compliance, Media Analytics, advertising, Consumer Engagement, Market Value, Market Chain, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.

Hyderabad, India (Hybrid – 3 days in office)

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world’s unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.

Join us in Hyderabad and help shape the future of intelligent, AI-ready data management.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Nasuni is hiring a
**Software Engineering Manager – Cloud Services**
to lead the team responsible for building and operating cloud-native services that strengthen our platform’s ransomware detection and data protection capabilities.
  
  
These services process large volumes of system data, prepare it for machine learning workflows, and integrate detection capabilities into production systems that help enterprises protect and recover critical file data.

**hands-on engineering leader**
who combines:
  
  

* strong Python and distributed systems experience
* AWS cloud architecture expertise
* the ability to lead engineers and deliver reliable cloud services

This role focuses on
**engineering leadership and delivery execution**
, not cybersecurity research or machine learning model development.

* Own delivery of cloud-native services supporting ransomware detection infrastructure.

* Partner with Product, Security, Cloud Platform, and SRE teams.

**technically engaged**

**team leadership, delivery predictability, and system reliability**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of software engineers building cloud-native services within Nasuni’s Cloud Services platform.
* Design and evolve Python-based services that collect and process system data used for ransomware detection workflows.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* 2+ years of direct engineering management experience.
* Strong Python development experience in production systems.
* Hands-on experience designing or operating AWS-based distributed systems.
* Experience building scalable backend services or data-processing systems.
* Experience leading Agile software development teams.
* Ability to understand complex system data flows and architect improvements across services.

* Experience building data pipelines that support machine learning workflows.
* Experience integrating ML-driven detection capabilities into production systems.
* Familiarity with AWS S3 and object storage architectures.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Experience working in security, ransomware protection, or data protection domains.
* Familiarity with file systems or SMB protocols.

**Ideal Qualifications**

* Experience building anomaly detection or security telemetry systems.
* Experience operating high-availability SaaS infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical engagement with team leadership.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development productivity.

**Experience Guidelines**

* 8–15 years total software engineering experience
* 2–5 years engineering management experience
* 3+ years AWS production system experience

**Why Work at Nasuni – Hyderabad?**
**Benefits**
As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers
**competitive benefits**
designed to support every stage of your life and career:
  
  

* Competitive compensation programs

description:

.**

The

will play an important role in supporting Micron's Structured Data Access Control (sDAC) program and related data governance initiatives. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical thinking with process improvement, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and project execution skills. Working closely with technical and business teams, they will transform complex governance processes into actionable insights and help drive continuous improvements across access management and governance workflows.
  
  
This position supports both day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives, helping advance governance modernization, workflow automation, and user experience improvements across the organization.

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Structured Data Access Control (SDAC) process and related governance workflows along with the knowledge of Role Based Access Control (RBAC) and data security management for integration.
* Define, document and improve business processes, requirements, workflows, operating procedures, governance standards, user guidance, training material and communications.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and efficiency improvements.
* Leveraging AI powered tools and other technologies to improve analysis, research, and productivity.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive with a positive attitude, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams across geographical and organizational cultures and to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting data governance, access management, and IAM governance programs, with familiarity in RBAC concepts.
* Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) or Oracle Database role and direct access permissions.
* Knowledge of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies. PMP, Scrum, Agile, or Business Analysis certifications are a plus.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflow design and automation, Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (SharePoint, Planner, Power Automate), and Power BI data modeling and advanced visualization techniques.

title: Critical Projects Manager, Critical Projects Implementation
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team in Amazon Data Services, India is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within live data centers in India. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager in AWS to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers in India. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities in India.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system.
  
  
The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.
  
  
If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* 4+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
* 3+ years of vendor management experience
* Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of construction or project management experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Manager, Data Center Facilities Development
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager, Data Center Facility Development leads the planning, governance, and execution of data center construction and development projects in India. The role is accountable for programme, cost, risk, quality, safety, contractor performance, commissioning readiness, and handover across new builds, expansions, retrofits, and other critical infrastructure workstreams.
  
  
Working closely with internal partners and external providers, the role aligns construction delivery with design, network, operations, commissioning, real estate, and business requirements. The Senior Manager also directly manages and develops project and construction professionals, establishes consistent delivery practices, and drives timely resolution of issues that could affect project milestones or operational readiness.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Project & Program Delivery Leadership

Lead end-to-end delivery of assigned construction projects, including new builds, expansions, retrofits, and customer-driven delivery.
  
  
Own integrated delivery plans, milestones, readiness gates, and recovery actions to meet business commitments such as Early Access, RFS, energisation, network readiness, and customer turn-up.
  
  
Provide timely, fact-based project reporting and escalate material risks, decisions, and constraints to regional leadership.
  
  

* Project Governance & Controls

Implement disciplined project controls across schedule, cost, risk, dependencies, change control, QA/QC, commissioning readiness, and handover.
  
  
Maintain accurate forecasts, critical-path plans, risk registers, issue logs, and action trackers; intervene early to remove constraints and protect delivery milestones.
  
  
Partner with PMO, Contracts, QS, and Procurement on commercial discipline, change management, claims exposure, and contractor performance.
  
  

* Cross-Functional & Partner Management

Coordinate closely with Design, Network, Commissioning, Operations, Real Estate/Facilities Development, and external delivery partners to ensure plans and readiness criteria are aligned.
  
  
Act as a senior day-to-day point of contact for contractors, consultants, colocation partners, customers, and internal stakeholders during delivery.
  
  
Build productive working relationships across diverse technical and non-technical stakeholder groups, resolving issues with clarity and pace.
  
  

* Safety, Quality & Operational Readiness

Champion a safety-first culture and ensure delivery activities comply with applicable site, company, and local regulatory requirements.
  
  
Drive quality assurance, inspections, defect management, system completion, commissioning readiness, and handover activities.
  
  
Ensure construction handover is complete, orderly, and suitable for transition into commissioning and operations.
  
  

* People Leadership & Capability Building

Directly manage, coach, and develop Construction Managers, Project Managers, and/or project controls personnel, setting clear expectations and supporting performance growth.
  
  
Plan team capacity and resource allocation to meet the local delivery pipeline and changing business priorities.
  
  
Embed consistent delivery practices, templates, reporting rhythms, and lessons learned across the team.
  
  
Success Measures (KPIs)
  
  
Delivery performance: milestone attainment, schedule trend stability, critical-path reliability, and approved-budget performance.
  
  
Safety: incident performance, audit outcomes, and demonstrable safety leadership.
  
  
Quality & readiness: defect closure, commissioning-readiness gates, and handover-pack completeness.
  
  
Governance: accurate forecasting, on-time reporting, effective escalation, and timely decision resolution.
  
  
People leadership: team capability growth, resource readiness, engagement, and consistent adoption of delivery practices.
  
  
**Required Experience & Qualifications**
8-10 years of construction, project delivery, or program delivery experience, ideally in mission-critical environments such as data centers, critical infrastructure, industrial, pharma, aviation, utilities, or similarly complex developments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing people, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing capability, and allocating team resources.
  
  
Proven experience delivering multiple construction projects or workstreams from design coordination through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
  
  
Strong understanding of project controls, scheduling, cost management, construction risk, change control, and contractor management.
  
  
Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and to travel domestically as business needs require.
  
  
**Preferred**
Experience delivering data center, critical-facility, or other mission-critical construction programs.
  
  
Knowledge of commissioning frameworks, readiness gating, and operational handover requirements.
  
  
Experience working with colocation, partner-delivery, or integrated network/customer dependencies.
  
  
Relevant degree or professional qualification in construction management, engineering, project management, quantity surveying, or a related field.
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
Hands-on construction delivery leadership with a strong execution focus.
  
  
People management, coaching, performance leadership, and team capacity planning.
  
  
Program governance, schedule discipline, and project-controls capability; familiarity with P6 and/or MS Project is beneficial.
  
  
Strong risk, dependency, escalation, and issue-resolution management.
  
  
Clear written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural collaboration.
  
  
Safety and quality leadership, with a continuous-improvement mindset.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

title: Manager, Information Systems
description:

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.

The ideal candidate has strong leadership experience in technology-driven manufacturing or regulated environments, combined with knowledge of software delivery, product management, organizational transformation, and global team leadership.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. title: Sr Associate Benefits
description:
**ABOUT AMGEN**
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
  
  
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Translate approved regional and global benefits strategies into implementation activities, operational processes, and deliverables across assigned markets.

* Coordinate implementation of approved benefit design changes and new initiatives.

**Program Management & Operations**

* Coordinate defined benefits projects and workstreams, establish timelines and priorities, track milestones, identify risks, and escalate issues requiring broader decisions.
* Analyse operational issues of moderate complexity, evaluate alternatives using established policies and precedents, recommend solutions, and coordinate implementation of agreed actions.

* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service requirements, deliverables, and timelines.
* Investigate service issues, coordinate corrective actions, and escalate significant risks as appropriate.

* Support procurements, contract renewals, implementations, transitions, and third-party risk management activities.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Maintain benefits documentation, process records, governance materials, and audit evidence.
* Identify potential compliance, control, or operational risks and coordinate appropriate remediation activities.
* Support regulatory change implementation by coordinating operational updates and stakeholder actions.
* Support internal and external audits through data collection, documentation, and issue resolution activities.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Analyse benefits cost, utilization, participation, employee experience, and vendor performance data.
* Interpret trends and translate findings into actionable recommendations for Benefits Managers and stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance metrics.
* Support program evaluation, benchmarking activities, and business case development.
* Prepare analyses and insights for leadership reviews, governance forums, and stakeholder decision-making.

**Employee Experience & Communications**

* Partner with Benefits Operations and Communications teams to deliver benefits education and engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate communication activities related to benefit changes, annual enrolment, and employee awareness campaigns.
* Review benefits materials for operational accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Use employee feedback, service metrics, and operational insights to identify opportunities to enhance the employee experience.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Establish effective working relationships with HR Operations, Finance, Legal, Procurement, brokers, vendors, and regional stakeholders.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities to support timely and accurate benefits delivery.
* Facilitate issue resolution and alignment across stakeholders involved in benefits operations and projects.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Typically, 5+ years of experience in benefits, total rewards, HR operations, or a related field.
* Experience administering or coordinating employee benefits programs.
* Experience working with benefits vendors, consultants, brokers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including interpretation of benefits and operational data.
* Knowledge of benefits governance, compliance requirements, and operational controls.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and exercise judgment within established policies and procedures.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting benefits programs across multiple countries or regions.

title: Construction Manager, Data Center Facilities Development
description:
**Job Description**
The Construction Manager – AI Data Center Infrastructure will provide day-to-day, on-site leadership for the delivery of data center construction projects in Hyderabad. Working closely with project management, design, procurement, commissioning, operations teams, and delivery partners, the role will oversee construction execution across civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, security, and life-safety systems.
  
  
The position is accountable for maintaining safe site operations, monitoring quality and progress, managing contractor performance, coordinating interfaces, and resolving construction issues in a timely manner. The Construction Manager will ensure work is delivered in accordance with approved designs, specifications, local regulatory requirements, and project schedules, while supporting a smooth transition through testing, commissioning, and handover.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Construction Manager AI Data Center Infrastructure Hyderabad India
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India (site-based role)
  
  
Travel: As required for project delivery
  
  
Experience: 7+ years in data center or mission-critical construction delivery
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are hiring a Construction Manager to lead on-site execution of AI data center infrastructure construction in Hyderabad, India. The role is based at the project site and is responsible for safe, compliant, high-quality delivery across multiple contractors and specialist vendors. It focuses on disciplined control of site works, construction processes, quality, commissioning readiness, and handover in live or new-build data center environments.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Lead on-site construction delivery for AI and high-density infrastructure, including base build and fit-out readiness, power, cooling, containment, and enabling works.
  
  
Manage contractors and vendors across CSA, MEP, controls and BMS, fire, security, and specialist packages.
  
  
Drive construction workflows including RFIs, submittals, ITPs, inspections, NCRs, punch lists, progressive turnover, and closeout.
  
  
Coordinate sequencing and interfaces across trades to protect milestones and remove site constraints quickly.
  
  
Own site readiness and logistics, including access control, permits, RAMS, workface planning, and cleanliness or controlled-environment requirements.
  
  
Drive commissioning readiness with commissioning and operations teams, including test readiness, evidence packs, redlines and as-builts, and turnover requirements.
  
  
Maintain a strong daily and weekly reporting cadence covering progress, look-aheads, constraints, risks, and escalation items.
  
  
What we are looking for
  
  
Proven experience delivering data center construction and/or mission-critical infrastructure in a site leadership role.
  
  
Strong understanding of MEP and critical-systems construction, including construction-to-commissioning handover.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple contractors in high-pressure, high-dependency environments.
  
  
Strong QA and QC discipline, including documentation capability for ITPs, inspections, NCRs, and closeout.
  
  
Competency with project and document-control platforms such as Aconex, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or similar, plus solid MS Office skills.
  
  
Ability to work full-time from the Hyderabad project site and travel domestically as required.
  
  
**Preferred**
Experience supporting high-density or AI-ready data center infrastructure, including tight power and cooling constraints, accelerated fit-outs, and compressed commissioning windows.
  
  
Relevant construction or engineering qualification and safety leadership credentials.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

description:

We are the preferred choice of 950+ global enterprises to manage their 3 million+ employees across 130+ countries.
  
  
Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Adani Wilmar, DLF, Crisil, CRED, JG Summit Group, Cebu Pacific Air, Nivea, and more.
  
  
The vision of Darwinbox is to build a world-class product company from Asia, backed by marquee global investors including Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, TCV, KKR, Peak XV and Microsoft.
  
  
Manager - Integration Solutioning & Technical Leadership (US Shift)
  
  
Department: Integrations
  
  
Reports To: Senior Manager / Director
  
  
Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid) - working with clients primarily in North America
  
  
Shift: US Shift (aligned to US business hours, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM IST)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Experience: 6-10 years
  
  
Team Size Managed: 2-4 Technical Consultants (US-shift and cross-region)
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on Manager to lead Integrations for a portfolio of US-based clients, working in the US shift. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Consultants responsible for integration solutioning and development — owning technical direction, guiding solution design, and ensuring high-quality delivery of new and enhanced integration interfaces. You will be the primary integrations point of contact for client leadership during US business hours, drive periodic leadership connects through demos and meetups, and step in hands-on to help the team solve complex issues on integration interfaces when needed. Our team already uses AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, you will deepen and scale this practice across the team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* 1. Lead and manage a team of 2-4 Technical Consultants — set priorities, plan capacity, run performance reviews, hire and develop talent, mentor on solutioning, and drive accountability for integration outcomes.
* 2. Own integration solutioning end to end — translate client requirements and change requests into robust designs (APIs, file-based flows, middleware patterns) and guide the team through build and delivery.
* 3. Lead and review the solutioning work done by Technical Consultants — ensure code quality, reusability, maintainability, and alignment with platform and integration standards.
* 4. Act as the technical lead for key integration engagements — drive architecture decisions, design reviews, and complex solutioning discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.
* 5. Drive client leadership connects with US clients through demos and meetups, in their time zone — showcase integration capabilities, walk through solution approaches, align on roadmap priorities, and strengthen executive-level confidence in delivery.
* 6. Own escalations and production issues on integration interfaces during US hours — debug failures, unblock consultants on complex interface problems, restore stable data flows, and communicate status to client stakeholders.
* 7. Stay hands-on with Python and integration tooling to review, guide, and when required , contribute to builds and troubleshooting on integration interfaces.
* 8. Build on the team's existing use of AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, strengthen AI-assisted design, coding, review, and documentation practices so the team delivers faster with consistent quality.
* 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions.
* 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software.
* Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) — including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes.
* Strong hands-on programming ability in Python — comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code.
* Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes.
* Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments.
* Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions.
* Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis.
* A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e.g., LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team.
* Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution.

Good to Have
  
  

* JavaScript experience — a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work.
* Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products.
* Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools).

title: Project Manager (PMO)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Project Manager to own delivery execution across our technology teams. You take the prioritized backlog and make delivery happen planning and tracking the work, running the sprint process, keeping Jira clean, coordinating the people, and acting as the tech team's face to business stakeholders.

This is a pure project management and delivery role. You are the person who keeps everyone aligned, unblocked, and on schedule, and who represents the technical team's status and constraints clearly to the business.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery planning & tracking

·      Take the prioritized backlog and turn it into an executable sprint / release plan.

·      Track progress against timelines, milestones, and commitments; keep delivery on schedule.

·      Manage risks, dependencies, and blockers proactively surface slippage early with options.

Jira & project tooling management

·      Own Jira day to day boards, workflows, sprint setup, ticket hygiene, and accurate status.

·      Ensure every task moves through its states cleanly, and nothing stalls silently.

·      Maintain dashboards and delivery reports as a single source of truth for status.

People & team management

·      Coordinate developers and QA across workstreams; manage capacity, allocation, and follow-ups.

·      Keep the team unblocked and accountable; drive tasks to completion.

·      Run the sprint ceremonies planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

Stakeholder communication (tech team's face to business)

·      Represent the technical team to business stakeholders communicate delivery status, timelines, and technical constraints in terms the business can act on.

·      Manage expectations on scope, timelines, and change; negotiate when capacity is tight.

Quality & release

·      Ensure testing and release readiness are planned in advance, not left to the last day.

·      Coordinate deployments and releases with Engineering and QA.

Process & governance

·      Establish and continuously improve lightweight delivery processes suited to a fast-moving company.

Required Qualifications

·      Strong hands-on experience with Agile and day-to-day Jira management.

·      Proven track record coordinating cross-functional teams and managing people to deliver on time.

·      Solid understanding of the software delivery lifecycle enough to hold credible conversations with engineers and QA and to explain constraints to the business.

·      Excellent written and verbal communication.

Core Skills

·      Delivery planning, scheduling, and tracking.

·      Jira administration, sprint management, and delivery reporting.

·      People and team coordination; driving accountability.

·      Risk, dependency, and blocker management.

·      Stakeholder management and clear status communication.

·      Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Emotional Intelligence & Behavioural Competencies

· A two-way bridge, and a balanced advocate. You carry the tech team's status and constraints to business stakeholders, and business context back to the team representing both sides fairly. You do not consistently push the pressure onto one side; you find the trade-off that works for the goal.

· Composed under pressure. When timelines, scope, and expectations collide, you stay calm and solution focused. You absorb pressure and convert it into clear next steps, rather than passing panic down to the team or frustration up to stakeholders.

· Empathetic, and a genuine listener. You understand the real concerns behind what each side is saying the business's urgency and the team's constraints and you listen before you react.

· A positive, ownership-driven attitude. Proactive, accountable, dependable, and humble. You bring solutions, not just problems — and people trust you because both sides feel genuinely heard.

· Resilient and adaptable. You stay steady and constructive through changing priorities and tight cycles.

Nice to Have

· Experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment.

title: Engineering Manager - Mechanical

The role is responsible for people leadership, technical and project oversight, resource planning, capability development, and delivery of product development and sustaining engineering initiatives. The manager will collaborate with global business and cross-functional partners to align priorities, strengthen engineering ownership, and ensure predictable delivery of high-quality engineering solutions.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**About ZoTok**
ZoTok is an AI-powered conversational commerce platform that turns WhatsApp into a business automation engine. We help brands, manufacturers, distributors, and retailers streamline their order-to-cash processes using AI and WhatsApp Business. We are building India's first Network CRM for conversational commerce, powered by Agentic AI, with 2,000+ demos delivered in the last 6 months alone.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to own customer implementations from signed deal to go-live. You'll be the bridge between our clients and our engineering team, translating business requirements into technical delivery and making sure every rollout lands on time.
  
  
This role needs someone who can talk APIs and integrations with our developers in the morning and walk a client's leadership through a project plan in the afternoon. Every client runs a different ERP, process and distribution model. Your job is to understand it, plan for it, and deliver.
  
  
**The Basics**
**Experience:**
6–10 years, with at least 3 years in technical project or delivery management
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad - Office Based, 5 days WFO
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own delivery: Plan and run client implementation projects end to end, covering scope, timelines, resources, risks and go-live.
* Lead client conversations: Act as the main point of contact for clients during delivery. Run kick-offs, requirement workshops, status reviews and escalations with business and IT stakeholders.
* Translate requirements: Convert client business processes into clear technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team.
* Manage integrations: Coordinate integrations with client ERPs, accounting and distributor systems, and the WhatsApp Business API. Understand data flows well enough to spot problems before they reach production.
* Work with engineering: Partner with developers, QA and Product on sprint planning, prioritization and release readiness. Keep delivery on track without losing quality.
* Manage change: Handle scope changes, trade-offs and expectations transparently, and keep leadership updated on project health.
* Improve the process: Build repeatable implementation playbooks, documentation and checklists so every rollout gets faster.

**What Matters More Than The Resume**

* Technical Depth: You can hold your own with engineers on architecture, APIs and data, and you know when an estimate doesn't add up.
* Client Presence: You are calm and credible in front of clients, from IT teams to business owners, especially when things go wrong.
* Clarity: You write crisp plans, specs and status updates that nobody has to read twice.
* Ownership: You treat a client's go-live as your own deadline. You don't wait to be told, you drive.

**Essential Skills**

* Experience: 6–10 years in software delivery, with at least 3 years managing technical projects for external clients.
* Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of SaaS products, REST APIs, integrations, databases and the software development lifecycle. A hands-on engineering background is a strong plus.
* Client Interaction: Proven experience managing client stakeholders, requirement gathering, demos and escalations.
* Project Management: Agile/Scrum delivery, sprint planning and tools such as Jira or similar.
* Plus: Experience with ERP integrations (SAP, Tally or others), B2B SaaS implementations, supply chain or distribution, or WhatsApp/AI products. PMP or Scrum certification is an advantage.

**Why Join ZoTok**
At ZoTok, you'll work at the intersection of AI, WhatsApp and supply-chain commerce, a category-defining product in a $1 trillion+ General Trade market. You'll own delivery for real customers, work directly with engineering and leadership with minimal corporate layers, and see the impact of every go-live.
  
  
Fast-growing startup. Real ownership. A niche product with tremendous demand. Join us and be part of something truly extraordinary.

With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Job Description – Senior Project Manager / Lead Business Analyst
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager with strong Lead Business Analyst capabilities to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from discovery through implementation. This hybrid role combines end-to-end project delivery, stakeholder leadership, business analysis, requirements management, and operational readiness. The ideal candidate will translate business needs into actionable solutions while maintaining clear governance across scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, quality, and outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Project and Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Lead projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, implementation, transition, and closure.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, resource plans, dependencies, and delivery schedules using Agile, Scrum, hybrid, or predictive approaches as appropriate.
* Establish project governance, success measures, reporting cadence, decision paths, and escalation mechanisms.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, vendors, and third-party dependencies.
* Maintain RAID and decision logs; drive owners to timely resolution and communicate impacts, options, and recommendations.
* Prepare concise status reports, dashboards, steering committee materials, and executive updates.
* Plan and facilitate workshops, stand-ups, working sessions, governance meetings, and retrospectives.
* Coordinate testing, release readiness, change management, training, communications, and operational handover.
* Support service desk and IT service management initiatives, including Problem Management, Major Incident Management, and vendor coordination.

Business Analysis Leadership
  
  

* Lead discovery and requirements elicitation with business, technology, operations, and vendor stakeholders.
* Translate business objectives into clear business requirements, functional and non-functional requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability artifacts.
* Analyze current-state processes, identify gaps and root causes, and define practical future-state solutions.
* Prioritize requirements and product backlogs in partnership with business owners, product leaders, architects, and delivery teams.
* Facilitate requirement walkthroughs, solution reviews, and decision-making sessions; secure stakeholder validation and approval.
* Maintain end-to-end requirements traceability and manage requirement changes, impacts, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Partner with technical teams to ensure solution designs meet business, operational, security, compliance, and support needs.
* Support test planning, test scenario development, defect triage, user acceptance testing, and business sign-off.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, standardization, and measurable business value.

Stakeholder and Team Leadership
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with sponsors, business leaders, subject-matter experts, delivery teams, support functions, and external partners.
* Communicate complex information clearly to both executive and technical audiences.
* Drive alignment, ownership, and timely decisions across cross-functional teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* Mentor project team members and business analysts, reinforce delivery discipline, and promote continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Extensive experience leading enterprise technology or business transformation projects in a Senior Project Manager, Program Manager, or equivalent role.
* Demonstrated experience performing Lead Business Analyst responsibilities on complex, cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of project governance, Agile and Scrum practices, requirements management, process analysis, change control, and testing lifecycles.
* Experience with service desk or help desk environments, IT service management processes, ServiceNow, major incidents, problem management, and third-party vendor management.
* Excellent facilitation, negotiation, analytical thinking, documentation, executive communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, ambiguity, and interdependent workstreams while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, CBAP, CCBA, or comparable certification.
* Experience with organizational change management, operational readiness, process improvement, or regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams and working with senior business and technology stakeholders.

Tools and Platforms
  
  
ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Box, Webex, and comparable project portfolio, collaboration, requirements, and reporting tools.

* Manage incoming supplier catalogs, catalog subscriptions, catalog content updates, approver assignment checks, and catalog administration activities.
* Investigate catalog data issues, connectivity defects, price/content mismatches, transaction failures, and catalog escalations.
* Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, AMS, master data, Ariba support, and internal business owners.
* Document standard operating procedures, configuration decisions, and lessons learned for repeatable catalog enablement.

**Testing, Deployment & Go-Live Support**

* Define and execute catalog test scenarios, UAT plans, transaction validation, supplier connectivity checks, and go-live readiness validation.
* Coordinate test profiles, buyer / requester validation, issue tracking, defect closure, and deployment support.
* Support hypercare during launch and ensure operational handover to support teams after stabilization.
* Ensure catalog changes align with procurement channels, preferred supplier strategy, and business controls.

**Catalog Adoption, Reporting & Governance**

* Drive catalog utilization, preferred supplier adoption, and spend reallocation toward approved catalog suppliers.
* Track and report catalog adoption KPIs, productivity metrics, supplier performance, catalog utilization, and spend analytics.
* Support contract expiration tracking, supplier contract alignment, and coordination with category managers.
* Create user training materials, quick reference guides, supplier communications, and adoption campaigns.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, IT, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* 4+ years of experience in procurement operations, SAP Ariba catalog enablement, supplier enablement, P2P, eProcurement, or catalog administration.
* Practical understanding of SAP Ariba catalog processes, PunchOut, CIF / hosted catalogs, supplier onboarding, UAT, and catalog troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master-data stakeholders.
* Strong Excel / reporting, issue-resolution, stakeholder management, documentation, and project-tracking skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a global procurement CoE or shared-services model supporting multi-region catalog deployment.
* Knowledge of supplier master data, contract data, Ariba Network, Guided Buying, buying channels, and preferred supplier governance.
* Exposure to catalog analytics, spend leakage reduction, compliance monitoring, and adoption dashboards.
* Lean Six Sigma, SAP Ariba certification, project management, or Agile exposure preferred.
* Ability to translate catalog gaps into process fixes, training interventions, and adoption improvement plans.

**Success Measures / KPIs**

* Increased catalog utilization and preferred supplier adoption.
* On-time catalog implementations with effective testing, go-live readiness, and hypercare completion.
* Reduced catalog errors, escalations, non-catalog buying, and supplier transaction defects.
* Improved visibility through adoption reporting, spend analytics, and implementation trackers.
* Stronger alignment between catalog coverage, supplier strategy, contracts, and procurement channels.

* Business requesters and approvers across global regions

title: Director, PMO - Supply Chain Execution
description:

* Drive PMO excellence by mentoring Project Managers, establishing robust implementation and deal review frameworks, and ensuring successful system deployments, operational readiness, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Partner with executive leadership to optimize project portfolios, enhance delivery efficiency, and leverage AI-driven technologies to improve implementation quality, operational performance, and business outcomes.

**What You'll Do**

* Execution Solutions Domain Expertise: Bring deep, hands-on experience architecting and delivering large-scale supply chain execution implementations—including Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), warehouse automation, last-mile logistics, and distribution network optimization. Leverage this domain expertise to set delivery standards, mentor Project Managers on execution best practices, and ensure our methodology aligns with how complex WMS/TMS transformations are implemented.

Show evidence of managing complex technology integrations, navigating regional operational differences, and adapting delivery approaches to ensure go-live success and operational stability across geographies.

Provide coaching on technical depth, system configuration, operational readiness, data migration, and post-implementation support. Build a high-performing PM community with strong capability in warehouse and transportation technology.

Develop frameworks that factor in execution system complexity, regional operational nuances, team capacity, technology readiness, and deployment risk. Own the rigor and quality of pre-engagement assessments.

Streamline processes, governance structures, methodology frameworks, and decision-making. Create standardized yet flexible playbooks for WMS/TMS implementations. Simplify how PMs work, enabling them to focus on delivery value.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Partner directly with C-suite and senior leadership across regions to align PMO strategy with business growth objectives. Provide strategic guidance on portfolio decisions, resource allocation, and delivery capacity. Lead executive steering committee meetings and QBRs with clarity and data-driven insights on implementation health and business impact.
* AI-Powered Technology Initiatives: Lead the adoption of AI and advanced technology to transform PMO operations—from intelligent project planning, AI-assisted change management, automated issue detection, to AI-driven performance analytics and insights. Build a forward-thinking PMO that leverages Claude, Copilot, and similar platforms to improve delivery quality and team productivity.

Experience & Domain Expertise
  
  

* 12–15+ years of hands-on Project Management experience, with strong focus on supply chain execution solutions, WMS implementations, TMS deployments, and warehouse operations transformation.

* Deep expertise with leading WMS/TMS platforms (SAP, Oracle, Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, JDA, etc.) and warehouse automation technologies.
* Strong understanding of data migration, system integration, and enterprise architecture in execution systems.
* Deep working knowledge of PSA/resource management platforms and CRM/Salesforce systems.

* Practical, hands-on experience leveraging AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise) for process automation, analysis, and optimization.

Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex implementation challenges into actionable PMO priorities and scalable frameworks.
* Exceptional stakeholder management—comfortable influencing C-suite executives, regional leaders, and complex technical/operational teams.

* Entrepreneurial mindset with passion for modernizing operations using AI, automation, and continuous improvement.
