title: Program Manager III, Service Delivery Standard Work
description:
**Description**
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. Our team enables Amazon CS’ frontline teams to deliver seamless, consistent, convenient, and delightful customer service to all our customers (including our consumers, businesses, and drivers) across every interaction.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to serve as the Service Delivery organization’s single threaded leader for CS Security. This role is responsible for owning the relationships with CS Security teams and the charter to empower associates whilst safeguarding customer data. You closely partner with CS Security in identifying and mitigating information security risks across all Customer Service systems, data, people, assets, and capabilities. The role consults and executes CS Security's strategy from the evolution of customer and agent authentication, creation and enforcement of security policy, to development of multi-layer security from servers to devices.
  
  

* An ideal candidate will combine product management depth in customer service operations or security with a demonstrated ability to implement AI-driven automation and modern project management tooling across distributed teams.
* You will partner with CS Security and Tech teams to define and design the end-to-end experience of associate and frontline leaders when security guardrails are applied. You will evaluate and improve existing tooling and processes and support the creation of new tech and AI driven solutions, consistently enhancing associate experiences and empowering our teams. You will work backward from security risks and associate pain points to design solutions and processes and define product requirements. Partnering with CS Security, engineering, operations, and stakeholder teams you will deliver solutions at scale. You will balance short-term tactical improvements with long-term strategic bets to continuously raise the bar on the associate experience and empowerment.
* The ideal candidate combines strong product and program management capabilities, business acumen in operations and/or security and deep associate empathy. You are equally comfortable diving into data and anecdotes to identify opportunities, writing PRFAQs, vision docs and BRDs, and influencing without authority to align cross-functional teams on a shared vision. You thrive in ambiguity, are biased toward action, and have a track record of delivering products that meet their customers’ needs. Disrupting the status quo by challenging mental models, organizational focus, and technology will be part of your day to day.

This role can be located in Hyderabad.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end CS Security partnership for Service Delivery
* Own the security-related strategy and associate empowerment charter for Service Delivery
* Lead strategic planning processes, working with leaders across the organization to set goals, define priorities, and allocate resources.
* Write product requirements (PRFAQs, vision docs, BRDs, user stories) working backward from customer needs for both new launches and existing experience improvements.
* Collaborate with CS Security and Tech to influence strategy, drive prioritization, create operational plans, roadmaps and vision docs
* Define and own success metrics and KPIs; use data to measure success and ongoing portfolio health, informing roadmap prioritization
* Define and own framework and mechanisms as Service Delivery's single CS Security POC
* Translate associate and frontline leadership insights, data signals, and business requirements into actionable security process and product improvements and scalable solutions.
* Partner with CS Security, Tech, data science, and operations teams to deliver CS Security solutions features from concept through launch and iteration.
* Influence and align senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on direction and strategy through compelling narratives and data-driven recommendations
* Apply analytical rigor to frame trade-offs and enable leaders to make well-informed decisions.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience owning global programs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

title: Principal Program Manager, Ship With Amazon
description:
**Description**
Amazon, a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, Washington, is the global leader in e-commerce. Since Amazon started in 1995, we have significantly expanded our product offerings, international sites, and worldwide network of fulfillment and customer service centers.
  
  
It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our growing team in Amazon Shipping (SWA) organization! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make SWA experience for our shippers seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by product innovation, technology led business excellence, passionate about learning and should view every customer interaction as an opportunity to create an exceptional experience. You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment.
  
  
You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You have expertise in managing programs that span multiple VP organizations, operating independently in highly ambiguous environments where both the problem and the solution are undefined. You are a strategic thinker who connects technical improvements to business outcomes.
  
  
You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer. People trust and respect you and they like to work with you. You are eager to pioneer new experiences, putting the customer first and challenging conventional wisdom.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are seeking an innovative, intellectually curious, results-oriented Principal Program Manager to drive broad cross-organizational, cross-regional, critical programs and charter level portfolios in our organization. The Principal PM will operate with complete autonomy and will be in charge of handling all aspects of technical projects within the SWA organization such as Shipper support, Billing & Payment, Claims and Delivery experience domains.
  
  
As a Principal Program Manager, you will
  
  

* Own and drive complex programs and portfolio, stakeholder relationship, program governance, and end-to-end program lifecycle.
* Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, evaluate options and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role. You should also have the ability to coach, and mentor individuals; build a strong cross-functional organization. Be a champion of operational excellence and establish team metrics for that excellence; including a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvement. Represent the technical organization and evangelize the work to senior leadership. Raise the bar on program management excellence, show thought leadership, and communicate well to different audiences.
* Collaborate and influence team members, product, engineering leaders and work with development teams and other business groups, and presenting projects to senior leadership on a regular basis. This includes building relationships and identifying with stakeholders across the organization.
* Compile, manage, and report on project and portfolio level metrics, post launch adoption, and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements
* This position requires the ability to operate in ambiguous situations and think outside the box when our customers’ problems may not always have clear solutions. It also requires backbone to lead upward as it will drive program adoption with senior leadership and customers while demonstrating empathy in responding to evolving customer needs.
* Build consensus across VP organizations through effective narratives and presentations, representing complex operational and technical trade-offs clearly
* Manage executive-level escalations with excellent judgment, balancing operational constraints with business priorities
* Establish and own success metrics that connect operational and technical improvements to business outcomes
* Create mechanisms for continuous visibility and proactive risk identification and represent team in Monthly, Quarterly business reviews to translate operational metrics into business impact for executive audiences
* Quantify the business impact of product features, technical improvements and communicate ROI to leadership
* Team Development & Community Building, Drive knowledge sharing, build knowledge artifacts
* Amplify impact by creating and optimizing critical mechanisms that enable teams to deliver independently
* Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and knowledge sharing
* Raise the bar for program management excellence across Amazon Shipping
* Streamline processes and drive adoption of best practices across multiple organizations
* Use Generative AI for data analysis, generating insights on technical and business metrics, risks, dependencies and program status management

**You'll Collaborate Closely With**

* Product Management teams defining capabilities and roadmaps, status
* Commercial teams driving enterprise shipper adoption and delivery SLAs
* Engineering organizations building support, claims, billing/payments and delivery tracking platforms
* Operations teams supporting global shipping networks
* Principal Engineers and Architects on technical decisions
* VP-level leadership across multiple organizations

The right candidate will possess a strong product/program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading large programs for software product development, and will have a good technology exposure. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done.
  
  
A day in the life

* 10+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 10+ years of program or project management experience
* 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience

* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data and customer insights to drive decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience understanding needs of business and end customers and translating them into right solutions
* Demonstrated ability to build mechanisms that scale across multiple products, teams, or organizations.
* Experience working across product, engineering, operations and business in a large-scale technology environment.
* Experience delivering high impact projects within scope, time, budget and quality
* Leveraging GenAI for SDLC acceleration and actionable insights

title: Manager Program Manager, Relay Operations Center Quality and Customer Experience, North America
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the execution backbone of North America's middle-mile transportation network—managing tens of millions of loads annually across a vast asset base. As we deploy an ambitious automation program that will fundamentally transform how carriers and drivers interact with our network, we need a results-driven Program Manager to ensure that speed never comes at the cost of experience.
  
  
You will lead quality improvement cycles, drive customer experience (CX) metric adoption, and partner with operations, technology, and training teams to deliver measurable improvements in carrier and driver experience across NA ROC operations. This role requires you to think big, dive deep, and balance strategic planning with hands-on program execution.
  
  
As Program Manager, ROC Quality & Customer Experience, you will serve as a strategic advisor to internal and external stakeholders while driving the adoption and engagement of ROC's quality and CX programs. You will be responsible for developing long-term OP planning inputs, contributing to the three-year vision, and building strategic roadmaps for quality and training. In addition to long-term strategic planning, you will partner closely with operations, workforce planning, learning partners, and technology teams to operationalize and deliver improvement initiatives at mid-term horizons.
  
  
You will lead a diverse team across various levels and capabilities—program managers, quality analysts, and business analysts—to drive results for NA Transportation Operations. You will set and drive a culture of defect reduction through continuous improvement cycles, maintaining accountability across multiple business units to deliver large-scale, high-visibility projects. It is an exciting role where you will interact with Sr. Leaders (Directors and VPs) from different organizations across NA.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
CX Metrics & Quality Improvement
  
  

* Own execution and continuous improvement of core CX metrics — TTR, PRR, FCR, and Repeat Rate — across automated and human-handled interactions
* Drive quality defect reduction through closed-loop cycles: defect detection → root cause analysis → SOP update → training content → effectiveness validation
* Support deployment of AI-powered quality monitoring (Contact Lens) to expand audit coverage and identify tone, clarity, and soft-skill gaps across voice transactions

Training & Operational Effectiveness
  
  

* Partner with L&D and workforce planning teams to operationalize training plans addressing quality gaps and automation readiness
* Develop strategic roadmaps for quality and training, including OP planning inputs and three-year vision contributions
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that reduce defect rates through structured coaching frameworks and SOP standardization

Voice of Customer & Carrier Advocacy
  
  
Drive the Anecdotes Program — intake, 5-why investigation, closed-loop resolution, and systemic prevention of recurring carrier issues
  
  

* Partner with Relay Product, TTS, and Middle Mile teams to translate carrier feedback into actionable program improvements and roadmap priorities

Automation CX Readiness
  
  

* Conduct pre-launch CX impact assessments and 30/60/90-day post-launch audits for automation deployments, ensuring quality parity between automated and manual processes
* Own case transfer governance and routing optimization, reducing unnecessary handoffs and improving first-contact resolution

Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  
  

* Present quality and CX insights in WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs to Director and Sr. leadership audiences, translating data into prioritized action plans
* Lead a diverse team of program managers, quality analysts, and business analysts; partner cross-functionally with TTS Engineering, Relay Product, WFM, L&D, and PXT

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning reviewing CX metrics dashboards and preparing a narrative update for a leadership review. By mid-morning, you are in a working session with Relay Product and Middle Mile partners, aligning on carrier feedback themes and roadmap priorities. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and review a quality audit proposal they have drafted. Later, you facilitate a post-launch CX readiness review for a recent automation deployment, diving into the details to ensure quality parity. You close the day by reviewing defect reduction trends across your portfolio and adjusting training plans with your Learning and Development partners.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

title: Transformation Program Lead
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 Your role
   

  

 The Transformation Program Lead is a high\-impact, execution\-focused role at the heart of our operational transformation agenda. Sitting within the Transformation Office, this individual acts as the on\-the\-ground engine of change owing the end\-to\-end delivery of discrete process transformation initiatives, from diagnostic and design through to implementation and BAU handover.
   

  

 This is not a strategy\-only role. We are looking for someone who can think like a consultant and execute like an operator — structuring complex problems with rigor, driving workstreams to resolution, and embedding sustainable change that outlasts their tenure on any given initiative.
   

  

 In this role you will partner with our Global Process Owners, operational teams in our global Client Delivery Centers, Product and Technology, as well as leaders across Client Delivery and in our Lines of Business to define and execute our plans, in a regulated, client\-centric, and compliance\-minded environment.
   

  

**The Ideal Candidate**
 You are organised, analytical, and motivated by tangible outcomes. You are comfortable working through complexity and ambiguity, and you take ownership of your workstreams without needing to be micromanaged. You communicate clearly and confidently with a range of stakeholders, from operations analysts to mid\-senior leadership, and you take pride in delivering work to a high standard. You are eager to grow your program delivery and problem\-solving capabilities, and you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where your contribution is visible and valued.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

**Program Delivery \& Execution**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned transformation workstreams, managing tasks, timelines, milestones, risks, and dependencies
* Develop and maintain detailed workstream plans, ensuring activities are logically sequenced and progressing on track
* Contribute to a culture of accountability and pace, proactively flagging blockers and helping to resolve them
* Maintain thorough documentation of processes, decisions, and outcomes throughout the engagement lifecycle


**Problem\-Solving \& Issue Resolution**
* Apply structured problem\-solving techniques to analyze complex operational challenges — breaking down issues, gathering and interpreting data, and forming clear recommendations
* Proactively identify risks and issues within your workstreams and escalate with proposed mitigations
* Exercise sound judgement to manage competing priorities and maintain delivery momentum


**Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Build effective working relationships with business, operations, and technology counterparts across assigned initiatives
* Prepare clear and well\-structured workstream updates, status reports, and risk logs for review by senior program leads and leadership
* Support the facilitation of working group meetings, workshops, and stakeholder sessions, ensuring actions and decisions are captured and followed up


**Team Contribution \& Development**
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance and support to Business Analysts on the team, helping to structure their work and maintain quality standards
* Act as a collaborative and constructive team member, sharing knowledge and contributing to a positive team culture
* Continue to develop your own skills in program delivery, problem structuring, and stakeholder engagement


**Change Management \& BAU Handover**
* Assist in the design and documentation of target operating models, processes, controls, and performance metrics to sustain new ways of working
* Support BAU teams in preparing for handover, contributing to training materials, process documentation, and transition planning
* Participate in structured handover activities at program close, ensuring continuity and a clean transition to business\-as\-usual


**Essential**
 Skills \& Experience Required
   

  

* 5–8 years of professional experience, with a solid track record in program or project management, business analysis, process improvement, or management consulting
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver structured workstreams within complex, cross\-functional programs
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to interpret data, identify issues, and develop clear, actionable recommendations
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience preparing written updates and facilitating working group sessions
* Well\-organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams concurrently
* A proactive, self\-starting approach with a strong sense of personal ownership and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, or AI\-assisted workflows)

* Prior exposure to a Transformation Office or similar centre of excellence
* Familiarity with change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci, Kotter) and/or project management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, PMP)
* Undergraduate degree from a leading institution; postgraduate qualification an advantage


 What we offer
   

  

* A high\-visibility, high\-impact role at the centre of the firm's transformation agenda
* Exposure to a breadth of strategic initiatives across the business
* A clear career pathway into senior transformation leadership, change, or operations roles
* The opportunity to build and shape a best\-in\-class Transformation Office capability
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


**Monthly base salary**

title: Senior Manager - Control Tower
description:
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Control Tower** 




**Location: Hyderabad** 




  





**About Gamlaa Bioscapes** 




 Gamlaa Bioscapes (https://gamlaa.com/) is India’s leading integrated biophilic solutions company, creating refined, nature\-led environments across workplaces, commercial, hospitality and premium spaces. We combine design, horticulture, execution and long\-term maintenance to transform spaces into living environments that elevate wellbeing and everyday experiences.
 



  





 Our vision is to make biophilic design an essential part of the built environment—creating spaces that are healthier, more human and meaningfully connected to nature. Today, Gamlaa is powered by 1,500\+ people, serving 1,250\+ enterprise clients, delivering 5,800\+ projects and managing 100Mn\+ sq. ft. across India. We’re building a team that brings curiosity, ownership and craftsmanship to breathe life into spaces.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Senior Manager \- Control Tower will lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, and commercial control to ensure timely, cost\-effective, and quality delivery of projects. The role requires strong leadership across project teams, vendors, internal functions, and customers, with a strong focus on risk mitigation, contract compliance, and operational excellence.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead multiple projects from planning to completion while ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, cost, and quality parameters.
* Manage project teams including Project Managers, Engineers, and site execution teams across regions.
* Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, legal teams, and internal stakeholders for smooth project delivery.
* Prepare and review project schedules, resource plans, recovery plans, and progress reports.
* Track project milestones, identify delays, and implement corrective and rescue actions.
* Oversee subcontractor management, vendor coordination, procurement follow\-up, and post\-order execution.
* Handle contract administration, project\-related notices, closure documentation, EOT claims, and cost claims.
* Support warranty, DLP, and O\&M phases as required.
* Review BOQs, estimates, technical specifications, and commercial proposals.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, quality standards, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular review meetings and present project status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership.
* Maintain MIS dashboards, documentation, and reporting for all active projects.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of client satisfaction.
* Mentor junior project staff and drive cross\-functional collaboration and process improvement.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
* Postgraduate qualification in Project Engineering, Project Management, or Construction Management preferred.
* Strong background in project execution, planning, and site coordination.
* Required Experience
* 8–12\+ years of experience in project management, planning, and execution.
* Proven experience in leading multi\-location or multi\-project operations.
* Strong exposure to project planning, subcontractor management, billing, vendor management, and contract administration.
* Experience in handling EOT, claims, recovery planning, and stakeholder negotiations.



**Desired Skills** 



* Project planning and scheduling.
* Cross\-functional coordination.
* Contract management and claim handling.
* Vendor and subcontractor management.
* Resource forecasting and allocation.
* Cost control and budget tracking.
* Risk assessment and mitigation.
* MIS reporting and documentation.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Working knowledge of Primavera P6, SAP, and project reporting tools.

title: Business Systems Analysis Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities?
   

  

 Join our DTCC family, and you’ll grow your expertise and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll seek challenges with flexibility and patience, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life.
   

  

**Why You Love This Job**
 You will be part of the Enterprise Product \& Platform Engineering (EPPE) organization, responsible for providing centralized, independent infrastructure testing and quality assurance services. This role focuses on driving infrastructure testing delivery, governance, and coordination across projects, ensuring improved system stability, compliance, and release readiness.
   

  

 The Lead Business Systems Analyst will act as a delivery lead/project coordinator for infrastructure testing, managing backlog execution, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and reporting.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Infrastructure Testing Delivery \& Coordination
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end infrastructure testing delivery across multiple concurrent programs and releases
* Coordinate testing activities aligned with application and infrastructure release plans
* Act as the primary liaison between Infrastructure Engineering, Application Teams, and Test teams
* Ensure test readiness across environments (build validation, baseline validation, integration readiness)
* Track and manage dependencies, risks, and testing milestones


 Agile Delivery \& Work Management
   

  

* Drive JIRA\-based Agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban) including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization
* Manage and monitor story progress, defect tracking, and test execution status
* Ensure clear definition of acceptance criteria, test scope, and Definition of Done (DoD)
* Facilitate daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder updates
* Optimize workflow efficiency and reduce delivery bottlenecks


 Resource Planning \& Workload Management
   

  

* Plan and allocate resources based on priority, complexity, and delivery timelines
* Monitor utilization across onshore/offshore teams
* Balance competing priorities across multiple initiatives
* Identify capacity gaps and escalate proactively


 Metrics, Reporting \& Leadership Communication
   

  

* Prepare executive\-level dashboards, metrics, and status reports
* Provide insights on: \- Test coverage
* Automation progress
* Defects and quality trends
* Delivery risks and timelines
* Present program updates to Director\-level and senior stakeholders
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making using tools such as Power BI / dashboards


 Process, Governance \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure adherence to EPPE testing standards, governance, and audit requirements
* Identify process gaps and drive improvements through automation and standardization
* Implement controls for traceability, test coverage, and compliance validation
* Support audit readiness and documentation standards


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Product Management, Infrastructure Engineering, Application Development teams
* Communicate risks, blockers, and status clearly and proactively
* Influence outcomes without direct authority


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience)


 Talents Needed for Success
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in Business Systems Analysis, Infrastructure Testing, or Delivery/Program Coordination roles
* Familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, Power BI, automation pipelines
* Strong experience in Agile delivery models (Scrum/Kanban)
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA (backlog, workflows, reporting)
* Experience working in infrastructure or platform environments (cloud/on\-prem)
* Strong understanding of risk, compliance, and audit expectations
* Proactively identifies and mitigates delivery risks
* Good understanding of the role of automation in various SDLCs (e.g. agile, scrum, waterfall) and mentor, train and coach resources.
* Ability to work on multiple work streams concurrently in a fast\-paced environment with extreme multi\-tasking and context switching.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior, Tax Services**
 Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and help clients improve cross\-border trade operations through Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) solutions. This role focuses on leading end\-to\-end GTM programs, including solution design, compliance controls, integrations, and governance. You will help translate global trade policy into scalable Oracle GTM configurations, workflows, and operating processes that support compliant and efficient trade execution. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, compliance, and business transformation in a complex global environment.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior, Tax Services on the Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Own the Oracle GTM workstream across discovery, design, build, test, deploy, and hypercare, and manage day\-to\-day priorities, dependencies, delivery quality, scope, RAID, estimates, and status reporting.
* Define end\-to\-end trade architecture across Oracle GTM and connected enterprise systems, and translate policy and regulatory requirements into enforceable controls, workflows, and audit\-ready traceability.
* Lead Oracle GTM solution design and oversight across restricted party screening, sanctions and export controls, classification, origin, valuation, license management, free trade agreement and preference programs, documentation, landed cost, and exception handling.
* Lead integration design, trade master data governance, reconciliation, monitoring, and control evidence across ERP, OMS, WMS, TMS, PIM, PLM, and external providers.
* Own testing strategy, user acceptance testing, cutover planning, hypercare, training materials, operating model design, governance cadence, and KPI alignment.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Oracle and global trade transformation teams help organizations improve trade compliance, customs readiness, and cross\-border operations through technology\-enabled solutions. The team works across compliance, supply chain, finance, legal, and technology stakeholders to design scalable operating models, controls, and integrations that support accuracy, efficiency, and auditability. Professionals in this area support complex transformation programs involving Oracle GTM, connected enterprise platforms, data governance, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 8\-12\+ years of experience in global trade or compliance technology delivery, including 3\-6\+ years in Oracle Global Trade Management implementation leadership.
* Experience leading at least one full lifecycle Oracle Global Trade Management implementation or major transformation.
* Experience with restricted party screening, sanctions or embargo controls, import or export compliance, export controls, Harmonized System or Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification, country of origin, valuation, licensing controls, or free trade agreement and preference concepts.
* Experience translating legal or compliance policy into system rules, workflows, and measurable controls.
* Experience with estimates, RAID management, quality gates, and executive\-ready status communication.
* Experience with integration design across APIs, flat files, middleware, mapping, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation.
* Experience leading data migration, data conversion, and validation activities.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Working knowledge of Oracle ERP, supply chain management, Oracle Transportation Management, or Oracle Integration Cloud.
* SQL or data analysis capability.
* Experience with broker or filing provider integrations and customs data handoff patterns.
* Experience building global templates with localized compliance extensions.
* Experience supporting audit requirements, control evidence, and traceability.
* Prior consulting lead experience across multi\-client or multi\-program delivery.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. **Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization.  We Connect is a Hyderabad\-based event management company delivering corporate events, exhibitions, brand activations, seminars, promotions, sports events and other experiential projects.

 We are looking for hands\-on Event Production Managers to support the planning and execution of events from preparation through completion. The role involves coordinating with vendors, fabricators, internal teams and venues to ensure that event requirements are delivered on time and as planned.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Coordinate production requirements for events, exhibitions and activations.
* Work with fabricators, printers, vendors, technicians and rental partners.
* Coordinate event elements such as stages, stalls, branding, signage, backdrops, displays and other installations.
* Prepare production checklists, timelines and material requirements.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely delivery and quality.
* Review designs, measurements and specifications before production.
* Assist with venue setup, installation, event\-day execution and dismantling.
* Coordinate with the internal Design, Marketing and Project teams.
* Identify production issues early and find practical solutions.
* Maintain basic records of quotations, requirements, materials and vendor details.
* Support multiple projects and manage deadlines effectively.



  





**Requirements** 



* 1–3 years of experience in event production, event management, exhibitions, activations or a related field.
* Practical understanding of fabrication, printing, branding and event setups.
* Good vendor coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Strong organisational and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work under tight timelines and handle last\-minute changes.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to work on\-ground during events and extended hours when required.

 Someone who is organised, proactive and hands\-on, takes ownership of assigned work, communicates clearly and is comfortable solving problems in a fast\-paced event environment.

* Independently handle production requirements for assigned events.
* Build dependable vendor relationships.
* Deliver assigned work within timelines and specifications.
* Minimise last\-minute production issues through effective planning.
* Confidently support on\-ground event execution.

 Event Production Manager → Senior Production Manager → Production Lead → Event Operations Manager

 Candidates will undergo an interview and a practical assessment focused on event production planning, coordination, problem\-solving and execution. There will be two interview rounds and hiring will be finalised within a total 2 week process.
 


* Overtime will be compensated as per company policy. Benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

title: Alpha Business Process Engineer, Officer
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are seeking a hands\-on process and knowledge engineer to join Alpha Intelligence, State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations. You will help transform complex processes end to end — understanding how work is done today, designing simpler future\-state processes, and enabling automation and AI solutions that improve speed, control and client outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is analytical, structured and delivery\-focused, comfortable working directly with subject\-matter experts, and able to own a workstream of process discovery and documentation end to end with limited supervision.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes — we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future\-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
 Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front\-to\-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go\-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
   

  

 We operate as one global team across the US, UK, Europe, India and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible\-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Conduct process discovery through interviews, shadowing, walkthroughs and system observation with implementation and operations subject\-matter experts.
* Own end\-to\-end process transformation for assigned workstreams, from discovery and future\-state design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Map and assess current\-state processes, including handoffs, systems, data, controls and exceptions, to identify root causes, effort, risk and friction.
* Design simpler, standardized future\-state processes that improve controls and use the right mix of people, process, data, automation and AI.
* Structure and tag content for search, RAG and agent use, ensuring knowledge assets are discoverable, accurate and maintainable.
* Validate process and knowledge assets with subject\-matter experts, manage signoffs and maintain version control.
* Prioritize redesign, automation and AI opportunities, and define the expected benefits and success measures.
* Turn approved future\-state designs into clear requirements and implementation plans, working with automation, AI, technology, operations and change teams.
* Support rollout and adoption, track results, and use feedback to improve the process over time.
* Maintain accurate status, progress and delivery reporting for your assigned workstream, escalating risks and blockers early.
* Coordinate across regional teams and time zones to enable seamless handoffs and effective dependency management.


**What We Value**
* Strong structured thinking and attention to detail — precision matters in process and knowledge engineering.
* Curiosity and persistence in getting to the real process, not just the documented one.
* Self\-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow\-up.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject\-matter experts and global stakeholders.


**Experience And Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed**
* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, process documentation, operations, transformation or automation delivery within financial services.
* Working knowledge of investment management or capital markets operations across front, middle and back office and the trade lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with process mapping and documentation methods and tools, exposure to BPMN, Visio, UiPath Task Capture, ARIS or comparable platforms is beneficial.
* Familiarity with automation platforms such as UiPath and an understanding of what makes a process automatable.
* Good understanding of AI and GenAI concepts, including how structured knowledge and content quality drive RAG and agent performance.
* Strong analytical and documentation skills, with proficiency in relevant collaboration, data and presentation tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel or PowerPoint; equivalent tools and transferable experience are welcome.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and deliver milestones in a fast\-moving programme environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with regional teams, occasional participation outside local working hours may be required for planned handoffs or critical discussions.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Process excellence or automation certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, BPM, UiPath) are an advantage.


**Interested but do not meet every qualification?** 
 If your experience and transferable skills align with the overall role, we encourage you to apply. We value different paths to building relevant expertise and will consider the full picture of what you can bring to the team.
   

  

**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Operations Associate/Account Manager
description:
Who are we?
 



  





 We are among India's largest education consulting companies, serving over 4000 customers annually from over 19 countries. We operate as a mentorship platform that brings students aiming to pursue their master's degrees abroad in touch with current or past students at top universities all over the world.
 



  





 Applying for a master's degree at foreign universities can be a daunting process. Gradvine's mentors ensure students have access to well\-informed and unbiased advice while writing their essays and shortlisting universities for their profiles.
 



  





 In the last 6 years, we've mentored close to 10,000 students to the Ivy League and other top universities in the U.S., Canada, and Europe through our mentor network of 1200 students and professionals at the top universities and companies in the world. Our top admits include Stanford, MIT, The University of Pennsylvania, UC Berkeley, CMU, Dartmouth College, Duke, Purdue, Georgia Tech, University of British Columbia, Columbia and many more.
 



  





 Role: Account Manager \- Operations
 



 Full\-time \| Hyderabad, Telangana (On\-site)
 



  





 We are a rapidly growing organization that is dynamic and young. Needless to say, the Operations and Quality Control team is a critical factor in our Year\-On\-Year growth. This team ensures that the company remains operationally efficient while coordinating between our brilliant mentors and customers.
 



  





 The Account Manager will handle the end\-to\-end process for each one of the students that subscribe to our Undergraduate and Masters service offerings. This includes working with individual stakeholders \- Mentors, University selection team, students, and parents \- on the application process.
 



  





 The work is demanding and will require dedication to the company and client. Hustle is the name of the game, and you will find yourself talking to customers from over 19 countries (and possibly more) every day, understanding their needs and helping them make it to their dream universities.
 



  





 You are a great fit if you have:
 



  





 \- Excellent organizational, project, and time management skills.
 



 \- Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially email communication.
 



 \- Ability to effectively coordinate with various stakeholders and senior management.
 



 \- Good writing skills, with experience in content editing/writing (not mandatory).
 



 \- Intermediate to advanced Google Workspace proficiency.
 



 \- Team\-oriented mindset and the ability to coordinate with team members and other departments.
 



 \- Proven ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
 



 \- Flexibility, self\-assurance, and innovative problem\-solving aptitudes.
 



 \- Ability to gather feedback from customers and incorporate it for continuous process improvement.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who is highly detail\-oriented, diligent, and organized in their style of work. Since we interact with a large number of customers and mentors, we need you to take ownership and have a careful and systematic approach. Salary will be commensurate with experience.
 



  





 Please send in your resumes to info@gradvine.com with an appropriate subject line.
 



  





 Thanks,
 



 Gradvine

We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent two decades building embedded memory IP that actually ships in products, not just passes tape\-out reviews, and you know the difference between a circuit that works in simulation and one that survives process variation at 3nm. Leading teams is not about org charts for you, it is about knowing when to step into a schematic review because the bit cell leakage numbers do not add up, and when to step back because your engineer has the answer but needs space to find it.
   

  

 You think in full flows. Architecture decisions ripple into layout constraints, layout choices show up in characterization data, and characterization data feeds back into compiler automation. You have debugged enough memory compiler issues to know that the problem is rarely where it first appears, and you ask the kind of questions that get to root cause without wasting three days.
   

  

 Managing multiple projects across FinFET nodes does not rattle you. You prioritize without drama, communicate blockers before they become crises, and keep your team focused on what actually moves the schedule. When a customer escalates a timing model issue, you do not deflect, you own it, pull in the right people, and drive it closed.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will lead a team that builds the memory IP behind the semiconductors powering AI, automotive, and mobile products worldwide.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Lead a team of memory design engineers developing SRAM, Register File, TCAM, and ROM architectures and circuit implementations for advanced process nodes including FinFET
* Own the full memory design flow from bit cell analysis and architecture through schematic entry, simulation, layout planning, characterization, verification, and model generation
* Drive low\-power, area\-efficient embedded memory circuit design and supervise layout activities, interfacing directly with CAD teams on verification and compiler automation
* Manage project timelines, prioritize tasks across multiple concurrent projects, and resolve technical and scheduling issues proactively to ensure on\-time delivery
* Build and maintain relationships with cross\-functional teams including characterization, verification, and customer\-facing engineering to align on deliverables and resolve escalations
* Apply and expand expertise in memory compiler development, transistor\-level circuit design, and variation\-aware design techniques for deep submicron technologies
* Mentor engineers, facilitate technical problem\-solving, and foster collaboration across multi\-site teams in Hyderabad and globally


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Deliver embedded memory IP that powers leading\-edge semiconductor products across AI, automotive, mobile, and high\-performance computing markets
* Enable Synopsys customers to meet aggressive area, power, and performance targets by providing robust, scalable memory solutions that work in silicon
* Reduce time\-to\-market for memory compiler releases by streamlining design flows, improving automation, and catching issues earlier in the development cycle
* Strengthen Synopsys reputation as a trusted memory IP partner by resolving customer escalations quickly and delivering high\-quality timing and power models
* Build a high\-performing team culture where engineers grow technically, take ownership, and consistently deliver complex projects on schedule
* Drive process improvements that increase team productivity, reduce characterization cycles, and improve compiler quality metrics
* Shape the technical direction of embedded memory IP development at Synopsys by contributing expertise in advanced node challenges and circuit innovation


 What You'll Need
   

  

* BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech/MS in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from a recognized university
* 20\+ years of hands\-on experience in embedded memory design including SRAM, Register File, TCAM, and ROM architecture and circuit implementation
* Deep expertise across the full memory design flow: architecture, schematic design, layout planning, characterization, timing analysis, and model generation
* Proven experience leading and managing engineering teams, delivering complex projects on schedule, and resolving technical and project issues across multiple priorities
* Strong proficiency in transistor\-level circuit design for deep submicron and FinFET technologies, including variation\-aware design techniques
* Mastery of Perl and Python for design automation and scripting
* Experience with memory compiler development and automation is a strong plus


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a schematic review, spot a leakage path or timing violation in minutes, and explain the fix in a way that helps the engineer learn, not just comply
* When a project is slipping, you do not wait for the weekly status meeting, you pull the team together, identify the real blocker, and adjust the plan that day
* You know how to say no to a customer request that will derail the schedule without burning the relationship, and you can explain the tradeoff in terms they actually care about
* Debugging a characterization mismatch across process corners does not frustrate you, it engages you, because you know the answer is in the data and you will find it
* You build trust by doing what you say you will do, owning mistakes when they happen, and giving your team credit when things go right
* You are comfortable working across time zones and geographies, and you adapt your communication style to make sure nothing gets lost in translation


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will lead a team within the Embedded Memory and Logic group at Synopsys, part of the Solutions Group. This team is responsible for developing standard and custom embedded SRAMs, ROMs, and TCAMs, delivering both functional and physical memory views through advanced memory compilers. The team covers the full spectrum of memory IP development, from bit cell analysis and architecture design to characterization, verification, and model generation. Your team will work closely with CAD, verification, and customer\-facing engineering teams across Synopsys global sites to deliver memory IP that enables the design of complex integrated circuits for leading\-edge semiconductor products.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As the Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN\-based execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Channel Payments, Channel Analytics, contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS administration, scorecard validation, payment package governance, product launch support, operational controls, reconciliations, reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Pricing, Market Access, Trade Operations, Finance, Information Systems, Commercial Operations, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready Channel execution. The role will lead AIN Associates and Analysts to support Channel operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for strategic decisions, complex contract interpretation, customer\-facing engagement, approvals, and risk management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Channel Operations Leadership*
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of Channel operations including contract update processing, CDP management, GCPS administration, scorecard generation, payment processing, waiver governance, analytics support, reconciliations, and payment package readiness.
* Manage workloads, operational calendars, payment cycles, quarter\-close deliverables, issue inventories, exception management, and execution readiness across Channel processes.
* Ensure repeatable and scalable execution of standard\-state activities transitioning to AIN while maintaining proper escalation pathways for complex decisions and approval requirements.
* Establish operational discipline through KPI management, workload balancing, service expectations, quality reviews, readiness gates, and issue escalation frameworks.


*CDP, Contract \& GCPS Governance*
* Oversee Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update processes, Conga review activities, contract amendment assessments, and operational implementation of approved contract changes.
* Lead GCPS setup, maintenance, strategy updates, tracker governance, and program configuration activities.
* Ensure CDP\-to\-GCPS alignment, execution quality, peer\-review effectiveness, and appropriate documentation retention.
* Partner with NAMs and retained ATO stakeholders on contract interpretation, amendment impact assessments, and complex operational decisions.


*Payments, Validation \& Financial Controls*
* Oversee scorecard generation, DOH validation, net sales reconciliation, payment package readiness, waiver processing, and payment calculation activities.
* Lead review of performance reports, scorecards, payment packages, trend reporting, and reconciliation outputs.
* Ensure SOX\-aligned controls, documentation standards, review evidence, decision logs, and audit readiness requirements are consistently maintained.
* Drive operational governance across payment approvals, exception resolution, reconciliation reviews, and control execution.


*Analytics, Reporting \& Operational Insights*
* Lead Channel analytics support including net sales reconciliations, inventory reporting, compliance reporting, DOH analysis, 852/867 validation activities, and operational dashboards.
* Review variances, trends, recurring exceptions, payment drivers, and operational metrics to improve execution quality and transparency.
* Ensure reporting outputs support decision\-making, payment approvals, audit requirements, and operational planning activities.
* Drive reporting standardization, KPI adoption, and analytics maturity across the Channel organization.


*Product Launch \& Continuous Improvement*
* Oversee AIN execution support for product launch readiness, MMDS activities, approved WAC maintenance activities, master data coordination, and launch documentation governance.
* Partner with ATO launch SMEs on transition planning, launch support activities, SOX documentation requirements, and process readiness.
* Drive automation, simplification, AI\-enabled opportunities, reporting improvements, issue reduction initiatives, and workflow optimization.
* Support system enhancements, UAT execution, defect management, access readiness, and digital transformation initiatives across Channel operations.


*People Leadership \& Transition Readiness*
* Lead, coach, and develop AIN\-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution.
* Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign\-off before independent ownership expands.
* Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step.
* Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance.
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts.
* Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 8 to 13 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, Gross\-to\-Net, Channel operations, revenue management, contract operations, commercial finance, analytics, or related areas.
* 3\+ years of experience leading people, operational teams, or complex cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience partnering with U.S.\-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Pricing, Contracting, Commercial Operations, Compliance, IT, or Revenue Management organizations.
* Experience leading process execution, reporting, controls, documentation, reconciliations, or operational transformation initiative


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fees and rebates, inventory management rebates, DOH methodologies, scorecards, net sales reconciliations, payment package governance, and Gross\-to\-Net operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting SOX controls, operational audits, access governance, issue management, UAT activities, and system enhancements.
* Demonstrated success leading transitions, KT programs, process standardization, automation, reporting modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive\-ready communication, people leadership, analytical, and change\-management skills.

title: SAP SD
description:

title: QA Lead (Copado Robotic testing)
description:
**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
 **Amgen is seeking a QA Lead – Salesforce \& Copado Robotic Testing** 
 to lead quality engineering and testing capabilities for enterprise Salesforce platforms, including OneCRM and its integrated ecosystem. This role will be responsible for ensuring high\-quality, reliable, and compliant application releases through a combination of
 **manual, functional, integration, regression, and automated testing using Copado Robotic Testing (CRT)** 
 .
   

  

 The QA Lead will own the end\-to\-end testing strategy and execution, lead cross\-functional QA teams, and partner closely with business, product, engineering, architecture, and production support teams to ensure releases meet functional, technical, and quality expectations while supporting Amgen’s mission to serve patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**QA \& Testing Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end QA activities for Salesforce applications and their integrated ecosystem, ensuring high\-quality releases with minimal production defects.
* Define and drive the overall test strategy, test planning, execution, defect management, and reporting across releases.
* Lead testing activities across functional, integration, system, regression, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing phases.
* Ensure appropriate test coverage based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and integration specifications.
* Serve as the primary QA point of contact for product, business, engineering, and technology stakeholders.


**Manual \& Functional Testing**
* Lead comprehensive manual testing of Salesforce applications, including business processes, workflows, validations, security, profiles, permission sets, and user experience.
* Design, review, and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results.
* Ensure adequate coverage of positive, negative, boundary, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Validate complex Salesforce business processes spanning multiple objects, personas, applications, and integrations.
* Drive exploratory and risk\-based testing for business\-critical capabilities.


**Copado Robotic Testing \& Test Automation**
* Lead adoption and implementation of Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Design and maintain reusable, scalable, and maintainable automated test suites using Copado Robotic Testing.
* Identify appropriate manual regression scenarios for automation based on business criticality, repeatability, and ROI.
* Establish and continuously improve the automated regression test suite to increase coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD and release pipelines wherever applicable.
* Monitor automation execution results, investigate failures, and ensure timely maintenance of automated test scripts.
* Define standards and best practices for Copado Robotic Testing development, execution, and maintenance.


**Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**
* Lead end\-to\-end testing across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms, including MuleSoft APIs, Databricks, and other upstream/downstream applications.
* Validate API integrations, data transformations, interface processing, error handling, and data reconciliation.
* Coordinate testing dependencies across multiple application and technology teams.
* Ensure critical business journeys are validated across the complete application and integration landscape.


**Defect Management \& Quality Governance**
* Establish and enforce standardized defect management, triage, prioritization, and closure processes.
* Lead defect triage sessions with business, development, and product teams.
* Ensure defects are appropriately categorized based on severity, priority, business impact, and release risk.
* Track defect trends, leakage, reopen rates, and recurring quality issues.
* Drive root cause analysis for escaped production defects and implement preventive actions.
* Establish appropriate quality gates and release\-readiness criteria before production deployment.


**Test Planning \& Release Management**
* Develop comprehensive test plans and testing schedules aligned with sprint and release timelines.
* Estimate QA effort and determine appropriate testing capacity based on release scope and complexity.
* Coordinate QA activities across Agile sprints, major releases, hotfixes, patches, and production maintenance releases.
* Assess testing risks and proactively communicate potential impacts to release timelines.
* Provide clear QA sign\-off and release\-readiness recommendations based on test results, open defects, and residual risks.
* Support post\-production validation and hypercare testing following major releases.


**Quality Engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive the transition from traditional testing toward a quality engineering and automation\-first approach.
* Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing through automation.
* Improve test efficiency through reusable test assets, automation, standardized processes, and optimized test data management.
* Establish QA standards, templates, metrics, and best practices across the delivery organization.
* Leverage defect and production incident trends to continuously strengthen regression coverage.
* Promote shift\-left testing, enabling early QA involvement during requirements, refinement, and solution\-design activities.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, Scrum Masters, and Production Support teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Participate in requirements and user\-story refinement to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and complete.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to coordinate integration and end\-to\-end testing.
* Act as the bridge between business and technology teams for quality\-related discussions.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, defects, dependencies, and release readiness to leadership and key stakeholders.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and mentor onshore/offshore QA and test automation teams.
* Drive appropriate allocation of QA resources based on release priorities and workload.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to manual and automation testers.
* Establish standards for test documentation, traceability, automation, and defect management.
* Drive knowledge sharing, cross\-skilling, and capability development within the QA team.
* Mentor team members on Salesforce testing, Copado Robotic Testing, quality engineering, and testing best practices.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 9–13 years of overall experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or Quality Engineering.
* Significant experience leading QA activities for large\-scale enterprise applications and complex releases.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong experience in Salesforce functional and manual testing.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, preferably including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Health Cloud.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated regression test suites.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations, MuleSoft APIs, REST/SOAP services, and data interfaces.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks is preferred.
* Experience with end\-to\-end, integration, regression, API, and data validation testing.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and CI/CD practices.
* Familiarity with Copado, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise delivery and ticketing platforms.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
* Strong understanding of test automation strategy, quality gates, and release\-readiness criteria.
* Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences.
* Understanding of GxP, compliance, data privacy, and validation requirements is preferred.
* Proven experience managing distributed onshore/offshore QA teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality and customer experience.
* Ability to prioritize multiple testing activities and deliver effectively under tight release timelines.
* Strong ownership and accountability for application quality.
* Team\-oriented with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
* Ability and willingness to mentor QA engineers and promote testing and automation best practices.
* Ability to challenge requirements and solutions constructively from a quality and end\-user perspective.
* Adaptable to changing business priorities, project requirements, and evolving technology.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well\-being.
   

  

 Together, we live the Amgen values as we continue advancing science to serve patients.
