title: Project Management Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an organised, detail\-oriented and proactive individual to manage small projects end to end and to support Project Managers and Project Analysts in the day\-to\-day coordination, tracking and governance of larger Change, Transformation and Transition (Lift\-Out) projects across Global Client Delivery (GCD) locations. The ideal candidate will independently run small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives using the team's SWAT and Transition frameworks, while acting as the operational backbone of the Projects team – keeping plans, trackers, action logs and evidence current; scheduling and minuting governance forums; chasing actions to closure; and ensuring the team's tools and templates are consistently used. This is an individual contributor role in the Projects team with no direct reports, reporting to the Head of Projects, and is the foundation for a career in project and programme management at Alter Domus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Small Project Management**
* Independently manage small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives (e.g. single\-team process changes, small work transfers or Transition Lite items, tooling or reporting roll\-outs, remediation actions) from kick\-off to closure, applying the SWAT and Toll Gate frameworks proportionately
* Define scope, success criteria, timeline and stakeholders for small projects with the Business / CD Lead, publish a simple plan and run regular check\-points to drive the actions to completion
* Identify and log risks, issues and dependencies for own projects, resolve them at working level and escalate to the Head of Projects or a Project Manager where a decision or intervention is required
* Provide status updates on own projects into the team's weekly reporting and governance forums and complete closure and lessons\-learnt documentation


**Project Coordination \& Tracking**
* Maintain project plans, trackers and checklists for assigned projects – including the Transition Checklist, recruitment / onboarding tracker, access and IT tracker, training completion records and impacted\-teams register – ensuring they are accurate and up to date at all times
* Track actions, owners and due dates from all project meetings and proactively follow up with owners across Business, Tech, Client Delivery and cross\-functional teams to drive closure
* Support the Project Manager / Project Analyst in preparing detailed plans, timelines and milestone schedules and in updating them as the project evolves
* Own defined workstreams within larger Transition and Transformation projects under the guidance of a Project Manager


**Governance Forums \& Toll Gate Support**
* Organise and support governance forums – schedule Tier 2 (weekly) and Tier 3 (operational) meetings, bi\-weekly transition reviews and toll\-gate (TG1/TG2/TG3\) reviews; prepare agendas, circulate pre\-reads, capture minutes, decisions and actions and distribute them promptly
* Collect, file and index toll\-gate evidence (sign\-off emails, approved plans, acceptance forms, training and access confirmations) in the designated SharePoint / Confluence locations and keep the evidence checklist current
* Chase pending sign\-offs from LoB, CD Leads, GPOs, Academy, IT and Control Tower ahead of toll\-gate dates and flag anything at risk to the Project Manager
* Maintain the decision log and action log for assigned projects


**Risk, Issue \& Dependency Logging**
* Capture risks, issues and dependencies raised in meetings and by stakeholders into the RAID log with clear descriptions, owners and target dates
* Monitor open items for ageing and overdue status and highlight them to the Project Manager / Project Analyst for escalation
* Support the preparation of escalation notes and mitigation trackers


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Prepare first drafts of status reports – weekly project updates, the consolidated GCD Projects weekly update and governance packs – by collecting inputs from Project Managers, Tech PMO and stakeholders and populating the standard templates
* Update KPI trackers and dashboards (hiring progress, onboarding, training completion, KC/KT scorecards, milestone status) with validated data from source teams
* Maintain project documentation – charters, stakeholder lists, RACI, communication plans, SOP / process documentation packs received from LoBs – with correct version control
* Ensure all project artefacts are stored in the agreed structure on SharePoint / Confluence and are easy for stakeholders to find


**Stakeholder Coordination \& Communication**
* Act as the day\-to\-day point of contact for routine queries, data requests and scheduling across global delivery locations and time zones
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams – Talent Acquisition, Academy (KC/KT), IT / Access, Risk, Legal \& Compliance, Facilities and Control Tower – to obtain inputs and confirm completion of their actions
* Draft clear and professional meeting invites, minutes, follow\-up notes and status communications for review by the Project Manager
* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders and represent the Projects team professionally


**Tools, Templates \& PMO Administration**
* Administer Jira boards, Confluence spaces and SharePoint libraries for assigned projects – creating and updating items, maintaining workflows and access lists and ensuring data hygiene
* Apply the team's standard templates (Transition Acceptance Document, Transition Checklist, SWAT templates, status report and RAID templates) and suggest practical improvements based on usage
* Support onboarding of new project stakeholders to the team's tools and ways of working
* Support post\-project reviews by collating feedback, lessons learnt and closure documentation


**PROFILE**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations or related field
* Project management foundation certification (CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, Agile / Scrum fundamentals) or willingness to obtain within the first year
* Overall 3\-7 years' experience in back office, BPO or Financial Services domain
* 2\-5 years of project coordination and execution experience – supporting or running projects, workstreams or process changes in a project, PMO or operations role
* Exposure to transitions, process migrations, change initiatives or working with global / multi\-location teams an advantage


**Technical Skills**
* Proficient in Excel (pivots, lookups, basic charts), PowerPoint and Outlook; exposure to Power BI an advantage
* Working knowledge of collaboration and project tools – SharePoint, MS Teams, Jira, Confluence or equivalent
* Familiarity with basic project management concepts – plans, milestones, RAID logs, action tracking, minutes


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

 Risk and Compliance Monitoring team (RCMT) is the centralized, architectural subject matter expert for Amazon Surface Transportation, including ROC, Amazon Transportation Services (ATS), and Amazon Logistics (AMZL).This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations.

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**

* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience

* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**

+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)

title: Electrical and Instrumentation Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dhanlakshmi Packaging Industries Pvt. Ltd. (DPIPL) is an India\-based manufacturer providing high\-quality, sustainable packaging solutions across corrugated packaging, labels, sleeves, and paper\-based products. Established in 2002, the company has grown into a multi\-location organization with advanced European and Taiwanese machinery, serving sectors such as FMCG, food and beverages, e\-commerce, electronics, paints, cosmetics, solar, and agriculture. With manufacturing facilities in Hyderabad and Nellore, DPIPL offers end\-to\-end capabilities from packaging design and R\&D to production and quality assurance. The company operates fully automatic corrugators, high\-end converting lines, multi\-colour flexo printing, advanced label and shrink sleeve systems, and paper\-based lollipop stick production. DPIPL maintains strict quality, safety, and compliance standards through certifications including ISO 9001, ISO 22000, BRCGS, SEDEX, FSC\-CoC, and FSSC 22000, and is committed to responsible, innovative, and sustainable packaging solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for an Electrical and Instrumentation Manager based at DPIPL’s Hyderabad facility. The role involves overseeing electrical and instrumentation systems across the plant, including installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of machinery and equipment. The manager will lead a team of electrical and instrumentation technicians, ensure adherence to safety and compliance standards, and coordinate preventive and predictive maintenance activities to minimize downtime. The position includes planning and executing electrical and instrumentation projects, managing budgets and timelines, and collaborating with production, quality, and engineering teams to support operational efficiency and process improvements. The manager will also maintain documentation, supervise inspections, and drive continuous improvement initiatives in alignment with organizational goals.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Electrical Engineering skills, including design, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of industrial electrical systems.
* Candidates should possess solid Instrumentation skills, with experience in process control instruments, automation systems, sensors, PLCs, and calibration practices.
* Candidates should possess effective Supervisory Skills, including team leadership, task allocation, performance monitoring, and training of technical staff.
* Candidates should possess Project Management and Project Control skills for planning, scheduling, budgeting, and controlling electrical and instrumentation projects.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field.
* Experience in manufacturing or packaging industries, preferably with automated production lines and advanced machinery.
* Knowledge of industrial safety standards, compliance requirements, and best practices for electrical and instrumentation systems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

title: Manager Central Monitoring
description:
**Build Our Future Together**
 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.
   

  

 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Manager, Central Monitoring, Data Analysis to join our Global Clinical Trial Services team. In this role, you will oversee centralized monitoring activities for global and complex clinical trials and support the configuration, execution, and maintenance of Risk\-Based Quality Management (RBQM) platforms. You will leverage your programming and analytical expertise to create customized analyses, automate workflows, integrate data systems, and deliver actionable insights that support informed decision\-making and optimize clinical trial performance. You may also oversee multiple studies within an assigned therapeutic area, lead process\-improvement initiatives, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams and industry partners to advance central monitoring capabilities.
   

  

**When \& Where**
 Hyderabad, India (hybrid)
   

  

**Discover Your Role**
* Act as a subject\-matter expert for the configuration, implementation, and execution of Central Monitoring RBQM platforms across studies.
* Maintain Regeneron Central Monitoring Key Risk Indicator and Quality Tolerance Limit libraries to ensure consistent deployment across studies and alignment with regulatory requirements.
* Configure studies within an RBQM platform by partnering with functional and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop Central Monitoring configuration specifications.
* Provide operational expertise, training, and guidance, serving as an escalation point for issues related to the Central Monitoring RBQM platform.

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
 As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift.
   

  

 You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last\-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority.
   

  

 Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 (Requirements 10 and 12\.10\). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift\-level owner for cross\-function coordination and evidence continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
**Shift Command and Team Coordination**
* Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift.
* Assign work at shift start and re\-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity.
* Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence.
* Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross\-functional coordination.
* Track and report shift\-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close.


**Shift Handover Discipline**
* Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations.
* Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps.
* Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice.


**Incident Management Coordination**
* Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA.
* Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on\-call Tier 3 engineer.
* Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step).
* Ensure joint NOC\-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over.


**Cross\-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation**
* Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI.
* Route security\-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context.
* Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol.
* Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority.


**Compliance Evidence and Documentation**
* Ensure shift activities produce audit\-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12\.10, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.24\-A.5\.28 and A.8\.15\-A.8\.16\.
* Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close.
* Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation.


**Continuous Improvement Contribution**
* Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers.
* Participate in post\-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice.
* Recommend changes to shift\-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities.


**General Duties And Responsibilities**
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated and able to work unsupervised.
* Methodical and attentive to detail.
* Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required.
* Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization.
* Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.


**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
**Essential:**
* Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment.
* Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control.
* Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols.
* Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1\-3 tiered model.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management.
* Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations.
* Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real\-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations.
* Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations.
* Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records.
* Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.


**Desirable:**
* Familiarity with PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11\.5, and Requirement 12\.10\.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A.8\.15\), monitoring activities (A.8\.16\), and incident management (A.5\.24 to A.5\.28\).
* Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0 (NIST CSWP 29\) Detect and Respond Functions.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira.
* Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice.
* Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries.


**Qualifications**
**Essential:**
* Must be able to work on\-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern.
* Minimum 5\-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1\-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid).
* At least 3 years’ experience managing shift workers.
* Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real\-time operations setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover.
* At least 3 years’ experience working in an ITIL 4 operation.


**Desirable:**
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred.
* CompTIA Security\+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification.
* Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real\-time operations environment.
* Experience with global follow\-the\-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones.

 Successful outcome of a National Police Check

title: Program Manager, Manufacturing & Supply AI Transformation
description:
**Job title** 
 : Program Manager, Manufacturing \& Supply AI Transformation
   

  

* Location: Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

 As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to drive the execution of Opella’s Manufacturing \& Supply Data and AI Transformation. This role focuses on translating strategy into action — coordinating cross\-regional initiatives, accelerating delivery, and embedding AI\-enabled capabilities across the global Manufacturing \& Supply network.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strong operator who brings a passion for AI and technology advancement, thrives in complex environments, and excels at orchestrating large\-scale transformation programs with speed and focus. Operating at the heart of the MS.AI Factory, you will convert strategy and a live use\-case pipeline into adopted, value\-generating solutions across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Program Execution \& Delivery
* Lead the end\-to\-end execution of Data \& AI initiatives across Manufacturing \& Supply — from use\-case intake and feasibility assessment through delivery, deployment, and adoption.
* Manage the project portfolio, ensuring alignment with transformation priorities and milestone achievement.
* Drive a high speed of execution through active issue resolution, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
* Operational Leadership
* Translate strategic direction into clear implementation plans and structured execution frameworks.
* Partner across functions — Manufacturing, Supply, IT, Data Science, Quality, and Finance — to ensure operational readiness and cohesion.
* Maintain disciplined governance across risk management, reporting, and resource planning.
* Challenger Mindset \& Innovation
* Challenge existing processes constructively and introduce innovative, data\-driven ways of working.
* Advocate for modern digital solutions and emerging technologies — including AI, agents, and automation — to drive meaningful improvement.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management
* Engage stakeholders across Europe and India to ensure alignment, collaboration, and adoption.
* Lead change efforts to embed AI, automation, and analytics into operational processes — including Copilot enablement and the AI Champions network.
* Provide clear communication to leadership on progress, risks, and realized benefits.


**About You**
 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

* Software \& AI Engineering: Strong hands\-on development skills (Python), with production\-ready software engineering practices — OOP, coding standards, version control, testing, and CI/CD.
* Agentic AI \& GenAI: Experience designing and deploying LLM\-powered and agentic solutions (RAG, autonomous and multi\-agent systems), with MCP\-based integrations, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
* System Integration: Proven ability to integrate solutions directly into enterprise systems via APIs; exposure to MES / QMS / ERP (SAP) and manufacturing / supply chain data.
* MLOps / AgentOps: Experience operationalizing models and agents — automated build / test / deploy, monitoring, and observability (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow or similar; GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
* Cloud \& Data: Comfortable in cloud and high\-performance environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) and building data pipelines.
* Business Understanding: Familiarity with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality processes and KPIs, and the ability to translate business problems into deployable agents.
* Experience: \[Add required years] of hands\-on experience building and deploying production AI / software solutions; life\-sciences or regulated (GxP) manufacturing experience is a strong plus.
* Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, Engineering, Data/AI) preferred.


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience managing large\-scale transformation or digital programs.
* Strong exposure to Manufacturing \& Supply environments, preferably global or regulated.
* Demonstrated experience deploying data, analytics, automation, or AI capabilities at scale.


**Leadership Requirements**
* Passion for AI \& Technology Advancement: demonstrated enthusiasm for new digital technologies and their application in operational environments.
* Speed \& Agility: proven ability to simplify, prioritize, and deliver rapidly.
* Challenger Mindset: constructively challenges historical norms and introduces innovative alternatives.
* Influence \& Collaboration: effective working across diverse teams, functions, and geographies.
* Execution Excellence: strong structure, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Comfort with Ambiguity: navigates shifting priorities and complex environments confidently.


**Technical Requirements**
* AI/ML Lifecycle: understanding of model development, deployment, and monitoring.
* Frameworks \& Tools: familiarity with machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and data engineering tools (SQL, Python, Spark).
* Cloud \& Governance: experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise data governance.
* Business Translation: ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and operational outcomes.


**Soft \& Behavioral Skills**
* Challenger Mindset: proactively questions the status quo and drives innovation and pace across the transformation portfolio.
* All In, Together: builds strong, collaborative relationships across global, cross\-functional, and partner teams.
* Outcome\-Obsessed: relentlessly focused on delivering measurable business impact and realized benefits, not just activity.
* Courageous: takes ownership, makes decisions in ambiguity, and drives initiatives through to completion.
* Radically Simple: brings clarity and simplicity to complex programs, stakeholders, and reporting.


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

* This role is critical to accelerating Opella’s digital capability across Manufacturing \& Supply. The Program Manager will ensure strategic direction is executed effectively, driving measurable improvements across Europe, India, and the broader global network.


 Why us?
   

  

 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.
   

  

 www.opella.com/en/careers

 Skills and Knowledge Required

title: ADMS Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As an ADMS Delivery Manager you will be a pivotal contributor to the successful delivery of ADMS Series 3 (DMS / OMS / SCADA) implementations and upgrades for electric utility customers across the MENAT and APAC regions. You will own the technical delivery of assigned projects across the full post\-sales lifecycle – from requirements and design through configuration, network model build, testing, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – working directly with customers and with cross\-functional GE Vernova teams.
   

  

 This role is dedicated to the Distribution GSL Series 3 delivery portfolio and operates under the direction of the regional ADMS Lead in MENAT as well as the HTC GDC leader . It combines deep ADMS technical expertise with customer\-facing delivery ownership, and contributes to building regional capability and reducing reliance on single points of expertise. Requiring a high level of operational and technical judgement, the expectation for this role is moderate autonomy.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Project Delivery Ownership
+ Act as the technical delivery lead for assigned ADMS Series 3 implementations, upgrades and installed\-base engagements across MENAT and APAC.
+ Own technical deliverables throughout the entire project lifecycle – requirements, functional and technical design, system configuration, distribution network model (DNAF) build and validation, integration, FAT/SAT, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – ensuring projects stay on track in terms of budget, time and customer expectations.
+ Plan and track delivery activities, effort and milestones for assigned projects; report progress, risks, issues and change requests to the regional Delivery Manager and project stakeholders.
+ Help to lay out proper staffing to cover all regional ADMS S3 deliveries and coordinate GE Vernova, HTC and partner resources assigned to the project to ensure all projects are successful.
+ Manage defects, change requests and technical actions through GE Vernova project tracking tools, maintaining accurate and auditable delivery records.

* Client Collaboration
+ Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer on assigned projects, explaining difficult or sensitive information and working to build consensus.
+ Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored delivery strategies through site assessments and workshops.
+ Make standard recommendations on workflow, application, interface, reports, testing and data uploads to customers during the implementation process.
+ Ensure go\-live readiness and provide support, including post\-live checkups, to guarantee customer satisfaction.
+ Travel to customer sites in the regions as required by project phase, including extended on\-site presence during testing, cutover and go\-live windows.

* Technical Expertise and Installed Base Support
+ Provide hands\-on technical support and troubleshooting across the ADMS Series 3 stack (Habitat / SCADA, DMS applications, OMS / Enterprise OMS, DNAF and system interfaces), including production issue resolution for installed\-base customers.
+ Support upgrade planning and execution for the regional ADMS S3 installed base, including version assessments, configuration re\-verification and migration activities.
+ Contribute to solution design, sizing and effort estimation for change orders and new opportunities, supporting the regional sales and bid teams as required.

* Leadership and Mentorship
+ Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience; mentor regional engineers and support structured knowledge transfer to build redundancy and reduce reliance on a small number of senior SMEs.
+ Ability to work across all GEV silos – Product, Support, Sales, HTC and delivery partners – with a OneTeam mentality.
+ Ability to grow and mentor staff, understanding that not everyone learns and grows the same way.
+ Develop persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.

* Best Practice and Quality Assurance
+ Develop specialized knowledge in your discipline and serve as a best practice / quality resource for the regional ADMS team.
+ Stay abreast of the latest technical developments in ADMS Series 3 and the GridOS platform, and contribute to delivery standards, runbooks and reusable assets.
+ Ensure delivery excellence within your area of responsibility.

* Decision\-Making and Problem Solving
+ Use judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of delivery, technology or engineering.
+ Take a new perspective on existing solutions and use technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations.
+ Utilize multiple internal and limited external sources outside of your own function to arrive at decisions.

* Market Awareness and Integration
+ Possess in\-depth knowledge of best practices and understand how your area integrates with others.
+ Have a working knowledge of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience implementing, upgrading or supporting ADMS / DMS / OMS / SCADA solutions for electric utilities, with significant hands\-on experience on GE Vernova ADMS Series 3\.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on utility software projects, including direct customer\-facing responsibility.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally to customer sites across MENAT and APAC as required by project phase.
* Based in Hyderabad, India, and aligned with HTC workplace guidelines.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Masters degree in electrical engineering / Power systems
* Deep experience with distribution network model (DNAF) build, validation, migration and data quality management.
* Experience with OMS / Enterprise OMS, Habitat / SCADA, eFEP and ADMS integrations (GIS, CIS, AMI, IVR, SCADA).
* Experience with ADMS Series 3 version upgrades and installed\-base support.
* Exposure to the GridOS platform is a plus.
* Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across time zones with regional customers and distributed GE Vernova teams.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Oracle Eloqua - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle Eloqua \- Manager, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by implementing and configuring Oracle's suite of applications. Your role will involve managing the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization, confirming seamless integration and utilization of business applications. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on delivering strategic solutions that align with client objectives and enhance their business processes.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will be responsible for supervising and developing teams, managing client service accounts, and driving client engagement workstreams. You will leverage your leadership skills to inspire your team, navigate complex situations, and deliver quality outcomes. Your role will involve strategic planning, mentoring junior staff, and maintaining accountability for project success. You are expected to embrace technology and innovation, using these tools to enhance delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to deepen your understanding of business contexts and develop your personal brand. You will be instrumental in building meaningful client relationships and delivering solutions that meet their strategic needs.
   

  

**Experience**
* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud and enterprise marketing automation solutions.
* Experience leading multiple end\-to\-end Oracle Eloqua implementations, enhancements, integrations, and campaign transformation initiatives.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, campaign automation, CRM integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, campaign specialists, administrators, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Marketing Automation, CRM, Lead Management, Customer Journeys, Campaign Management, Analytics, Data Integration, and enterprise marketing technology ecosystems.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, enhancement, and support of Oracle Eloqua marketing automation solutions.
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of marketing automation initiatives including demand\-generation programs, lead\-nurturing journeys, event campaigns, audience segmentation, email campaigns, landing pages, forms, and automated customer and prospect journeys.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into scalable and reusable Eloqua solution designs and automation strategies.
* Lead requirement\-gathering workshops and solution\-design sessions with Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Data, Analytics, and Operations teams.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and marketing stakeholders and recommend appropriate campaign designs, segmentation strategies, personalization approaches, lead\-management processes, and marketing automation capabilities.
* Own technical and functional design decisions and ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data\-governance, and marketing\-technology standards.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution designs, campaign specifications, integration mappings, testing strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Eloqua projects, campaigns, and workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, integration issues, campaign\-processing challenges, and platform limitations and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support, internal technology teams, application owners, and third\-party vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, integrations, and technical escalations.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and ensure clear communication on scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, CRM, Technology, Data, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Eloqua solution architecture and define scalable, reusable, secure, and maintainable solution patterns.Design end\-to\-end integrations and data flows across Eloqua, CRM, CDP, middleware, analytics, and third\-party applications.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and capability showcases to present Oracle Eloqua features and proposed solutions.Present architecture, campaign flows, integrations, and implementation approaches to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define suitable solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, and resource requirements
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Eloqua projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Eloqua Technical Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of complex Eloqua Campaign Canvas and Program Canvas solutions.
* Design and manage campaign orchestration involving segmentation, decision rules, personalization, lead nurturing, lead scoring, routing, and automated communications.
* Oversee the creation and management of:
* Email campaigns
* Landing pages
* Forms
* Progressive profiling
* Segments
* Shared filters
* Contact fields
* Custom objects
* Campaign Canvas
* Program Canvas
* Lead\-scoring models
* Campaign reporting and dashboards
* Establish reusable campaign templates, design standards, naming conventions, folder structures, and asset\-management practices.
* Define and govern audience segmentation and personalization strategies based on customer, prospect, campaign, behavioral, and CRM data.
* Lead implementation of lead\-nurturing programs and automated journeys across different stages of the customer and prospect lifecycle.
* Design and manage lead\-scoring models and lead\-management processes, including qualification, routing, and hand\-off to CRM or sales teams.
* Ensure effective synchronization of contacts, leads, campaigns, responses, opportunities, and other marketing data between Eloqua and CRM applications.
* Establish campaign quality\-assurance processes covering configuration review, end\-to\-end testing, integration testing, data validation, deployment readiness, and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Monitor campaign processing, integration jobs, CRM synchronization, and data flows and proactively resolve failed\-processing or configuration issues.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for complex campaign, data, integration, synchronization, and platform issues and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Review overall Eloqua platform usage and recommend improvements related to scalability, performance, usability, and operational efficiency.


**Integration and Data Management**
* Lead and govern integrations between Oracle Eloqua and CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of campaign, contact, lead, opportunity, response, consent, and marketing\-preference data flows across integrated applications.
* Design and manage integrations between Eloqua and:
* Salesforce CRM
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Event\-management platforms
* Webinar platforms
* Websites
* Analytics platforms
* Data warehouses
* Customer Data Platforms
* Third\-party marketing applications
* Experience with REST APIs, web services, SFTP/file\-based integrations, middleware, batch integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Define source\-to\-target mappings and ensure appropriate data transformation, validation, synchronization, and error\-handling mechanisms.
* Promote data\-quality standards across Eloqua and connected marketing applications.
* Ensure appropriate management of customer consent, subscriptions, preferences, and marketing communication eligibility.


**Campaign Analytics and Optimization**
* Lead analysis of marketing and campaign performance, including:
* Email deliverability
* Open and click engagement
* Campaign responses
* Conversion performance
* Audience and segmentation effectiveness
* Lead\-nurturing performance
* Lead\-scoring effectiveness
* Campaign operational metrics
* Work with business and analytics teams to define campaign KPIs, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Translate campaign and engagement data into actionable recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness and customer engagement.
* Identify automation and optimization opportunities to reduce manual campaign activities and improve scalability.
* Evaluate new Eloqua capabilities, third\-party applications, and marketing technologies and recommend adoption based on business value.


**Platform Governance and Administration**
* Define and maintain Eloqua platform\-governance standards including:
* Naming conventions
* Folder structures
* Campaign standards
* Templates
* Asset\-management standards
* Documentation standards
* Access controls
* Environment housekeeping
* Oversee Eloqua user provisioning, role\-based access, permissions, and periodic access reviews.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of responsibilities and alignment with security and governance requirements.
* Establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), campaign checklists, solution documentation, reusable templates, and best\-practice frameworks.
* Drive platform\-health reviews and identify opportunities for cleanup, optimization, and standardization.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Amazon Freight
description:
**Description**
 We are building a large tech organization for Amazon Freight from scratch. Amazon Freight is now part of Amazon Supply Chain Services and is building an innovative transportation network with the vision of redefining shipping for its customers. To grow our Less\-Than\-Truckload (LTL) and Truckload (TL) business continues, we are looking to building state of the art and brand new (1\) network capabilities (2\) shipper/seller facing capabilities (3\) science capabilities execution optimization.
   

  

 The new team will be building foundational core capabilities around (1\) Shipment Execution\- Quoting and Booking, Carrier/Driver Workflow , Shipper Workflow ,shipper signals, Driver/Shipper Handoffs, 3P Site Intelligence, demand side Disruption Mgmt (2\) Trailer Operations \- Trailer Pool Mgmt. , Equipment Assignment, Quality \& Prep (3\) Scheduling \& Optimization \- Shipper Scheduling workflow, Cost\-Optimal Demand shaping, Cancellations/Reschedules (4\) Cost, Demand \& Volume Planning \- Cost Planning \& Prediction , Forecasting.
   

  

 This position requires strong business judgment, exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, is comfortable making data\-driven decisions in ambiguous environments and has experience translating complex transportation economics into scalable network execution strategies. If you are passionate about solving complex transportation problems, influencing cross\-functional partners, and building innovative supply chain capabilities that create value for customers while driving sustainable business growth, we'd love to speak with you
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and deliver large\-scale, cross\-organizational programs by identifying gaps between architectures, services, and organizations, decomposing complex problems into clear solutions, and driving alignment across engineering teams toward coherent technology strategies.
* Own technology roadmaps for broad sets of systems or manage a portfolio of programs, applying deep technical knowledge to evolve, improve, and simplify technologies while minimizing recurring engineering effort.
* Drive business and system\-level reviews, assess risk, and represent complex decisions and trade\-offs clearly to senior leadership, enabling informed decision\-making up to three levels above your role.
* Create, optimize, and drive adoption of mechanisms that ensure long\-term program success, proactively steering teams away from prior failure patterns and identifying when additional technical guidance is needed.
* Amplify impact across the organization by mentoring other program managers, sharing best practices, and contributing to talent development through assessments and community events.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You might start your morning reviewing a technical design document alongside senior engineers, asking pointed questions to uncover hidden dependencies. By midday, you could be facilitating a cross\-team alignment session to resolve competing priorities across multiple service owners. In the afternoon, you may draft a narrative for a VP\-level review, distilling weeks of analysis into a clear recommendation with well\-defined trade\-offs. Throughout it all, you balance strategic thinking with hands\-on problem solving, ensuring that the programs you lead move forward with the right urgency and quality.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is focused on solving some of Amazon's most complex technical and organizational challenges. We work across business and engineering boundaries to deliver programs that have lasting impact on how Amazon builds and operates at scale. We value collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to raising the bar for everyone around us. If you are excited about defining strategy in uncharted territory and partnering with leaders across the company to bring it to life, this is the team for you.

* 7\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical or complex topics clearly in business terms for management, business users, vendors, and technical teams.
* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.
* Proactively identifies risks, dependencies, constraints, and execution challenges, and drives mitigation with relevant stakeholders.
* Effective in planning, tracking, organizing, and coordinating deliverables across project phases, support activities, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Works effectively with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, vendors, business users, and technical teams.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, customer focus, business understanding, and delivery discipline.
* Builds trust through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow\-through on commitments.


 Supports a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and team development.
   

  

**Working Experience**
* Over 8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in application delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, production support, vendor coordination and team management. Prior lead or manager\-level experience is preferred.
