description:
**Job Description**
 As a Direct Materials Productivity Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for driving productivity improvements and cost efficiencies in the direct materials supply chain. Your role will focus on optimizing procurement strategies, enhancing supplier performance, and ensuring the seamless flow of materials to support manufacturing and operational objectives. You will leverage your expertise in supply chain management and data analytics to identify opportunities for cost reduction and process enhancement, contributing directly to Honeywell’s competitive advantage and profitability.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Senior Director Procurement for Process Automation and you’ll work out from one our India locations (Bangalore/Hyderabed/Pune) on a Hybrid work schedule.
   

  

 In this role, you will impact Honeywell’s operational efficiency by leading initiatives that improve material cost productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen supplier partnerships. Your leadership will ensure that material availability aligns with production demands while maintaining cost targets and quality standards, thereby supporting the company’s overall business goals.
   

  

 Your role also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end to end processes and project for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on task to be performed; and monitoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skills development, professional growth, and overall success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement direct materials productivity strategies aligned with business objectives to drive cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Responsible for execution of productivity projects and achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets
* Responsible for developing a pipeline of productivity projects working cross\-functionally with strategic sourcing, factory operations, engineering, offering management and suppliers globally
* Responsible for achieving the productivity targets for all the levers i.e. Negotiations, Value Engineering, Component Engineering, Rebates and Deflation with the objective of achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity targets
* Analyze procurement data and supplier performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
* Analyze spend receipts data and find opportunities for cost savings working closely with supplier sourcing leaders and procurement operations
* Collaborate closely with procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to optimize material specifications, sourcing strategies, and inventory management.
* Lead supplier engagement initiatives to improve cost competitiveness.
* Manage cross\-functional projects focused on waste reduction, process improvements, and supply chain optimization.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to direct materials productivity and cost savings to senior leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain processes.
* Support the development and deployment of procurement tools and technologies to improve data visibility and decision\-making.
* Mentor and develop team members to build capabilities in materials productivity and supply chain excellence.


**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in direct materials productivity or supply chain management roles.
* Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to driving change.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional team environment.


**WE VALUE**
* Proven experience in managing direct materials procurement and productivity within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and drive actionable insights.
* Expertise in supplier management, contract negotiation, and cost reduction strategies.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, procurement software, and data analysis tools.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and managing projects that deliver measurable productivity improvements.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**Vanguard India**

This role involves developing strategic project plans, mitigating risks and influencing key stakeholders to drive seamless execution.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with leadership to ensure project objectives align with overall company strategy and industry trends, driving long\-term business impact.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, effectively communicating key project updates, resolving roadblocks and influencing decision\-making.

* Oversee resource planning and budget management, ensuring optimal utilization of manpower, tools and financial resources for successful project execution.
* Track key project metrics, prepare detailed reports and provide leadership with data\-driven insights for informed decision\-making.
* Provide expert recommendations on critical business challenges, ensuring timely resolution of escalated project issues.
* Lead organizational change management initiatives, training teams on new processes and ensuring seamless adoption of business strategies.


**Qualifications And Skills**

**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

**Our mission**
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

**Our commitment to you**
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. **Physical wellness**
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

**Personal wellness**
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

 Streamliners is a management consulting firm specialized in rapid efficiency improvements, operational excellence, and fast turnaround. We help manufacturers and private equity owned portfolio companies in North America and Europe solve complex operational challenges to maximize profit margins and gain competitive advantage. description:
**Job title** 
 :
 **Project Manager CPMO tools \& AI enablement**
* Location: Ind\- Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and
 **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by
 **making self\-care as simple as it should be** 
 . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our
 **100 loved brands** 
 , our
 **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** 
 and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

**B Corp certified in multiple markets** 
 , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Opella Digital is executing a multi\-year transformation program (Butterfly: 56 programs, 205\+ projects) supported by an integrated PMO \& OCM unit. The tooling landscape underpinning this transformation — Planisware, Jira, Confluence, PowerBI, and the ELITEA, OpellaGPT AI platforms — has been designed and initially built by our implementation partner EPAM.
   

  

 We are now internalizing this capability. The PMO \& CMO Tools and Enablement Lead will act as the Product Owner and Project Manager of the full tooling ecosystem. You will not build the tools yourself — dedicated tech teams handle Planisware, Jira/Confluence, PowerBI, and OpellaGPT implementation. Your job is to gather requirements from all stakeholders across the Digital organization, translate them into actionable specifications, prioritize them, and project\-manage their implementation by the right tech teams.
   

  

 You are the bridge between business needs (what PMO, programme streams, OCM, and project teams need to see and do) and the technical teams that make it happen. You need a strong understanding of the underlying technology — not to code, but to know what’s possible, what’s feasible, and how systems connect. You think in data flows, integration patterns, and user requirements — then you drive delivery.
   

  

 A defining requirement of this role is to be an AI champion. Beyond running the tooling ecosystem, you are expected to actively drive the conversion of manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool ways of working toward AI\-assisted and automated workflows — using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected platforms — and to make AI and automation the default way the PMO and OCM operate. This expectation is weighted heavily in the recruitment process: candidates without a demonstrable AI\-automation track record are not a fit.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Requirements Gathering \& Product Ownership
* Act as the single Product Owner for the PMO \& CMO tooling ecosystem — own the backlog, prioritize features, and define what gets built and in what order
* Gather and consolidate requirements from multiple stakeholder layers: PMO dashboards, Butterfly stream dashboards, OCM/change management needs, project\-level dashboards, programme\-level reporting, DLT/SteerCo views
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and user stories that tech teams can implement
* Manage the requirements lifecycle: elicitation, documentation, validation, prioritization, change control
* Facilitate workshops and requirement sessions with stakeholders across PMO, OCM, programme streams, and leadership to understand their reporting, tracking, and tooling needs
* Maintain a prioritized product backlog for the tooling ecosystem — balancing competing demands from PMO, OCM, and programme stakeholders
* Define acceptance criteria and validate delivered solutions against requirements before release
* AI Enablement \& Automation (Core Mandate)
* Champion AI and automation across the PMO and OCM — set the ambition, build momentum, demonstrate quick wins, and convert sceptics into adopters.
* Audit current ways of working and identify manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool processes that are candidates for automation.
* Drive the conversion of those processes to AI\-assisted and automated workflows using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected tooling — automated reporting and status roll\-ups, AI\-enabled change analytics, document and template generation.
* Embed AI into standard operating practice rather than leaving it as an optional add\-on; make automation the default, not the exception.
* Define and track AI\-adoption and conversion metrics (e.g. share of manual reports automated, hours saved, adoption rates) and report progress to the Head of PM Practice.
* Stay ahead of emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, ELITEA, PowerBI AI features) and translate them into practical improvements for the delivery and change teams.
* Project Management of Tooling Implementations
* Project\-manage the implementation of requirements across multiple tech teams: Planisware team, Jira/Confluence team, PowerBI team, OpellaGPT/ELITEA team, and any future platform teams
* Coordinate delivery across tech teams — manage dependencies, timelines, and integration points between platforms
* Track delivery progress, manage risks and issues, escalate blockers, and ensure on\-time delivery of tooling features
* Own the release management process — coordinate deployments across platforms, ensure regression testing, and manage rollout communication
* Manage the phased evolution of the reporting pipeline: from Phase 1 (manual) to Phase 2 (MCP/OpenAPI connectors) to Phase 3 (Planisware\-Jira synchronization)
* Coordinate with the Solution Architect on technical feasibility, platform evolution roadmap, and integration architecture
* Data Architecture Understanding \& Integration Design
* Understand where every datapoint lives across the ecosystem — Planisware (portfolio, schedules, budgets), Jira (project tracking, status), Confluence (governance), Snowflake (analytics), LMS (training completion), Veeva (content), knowledge platforms
* Design integration requirements: specify what data needs to flow between systems, in what direction, at what frequency, and in what format — then hand off to tech teams for implementation
* Understand the three\-layer reporting architecture: Data Layer → Orchestration Layer (ELITEA/OpellaGPT) → Presentation Layer (dashboards, PowerBI, Confluence) — and ensure requirements are correctly placed in the right layer
* Define data quality requirements and validation rules for the tooling ecosystem — ensure a consistent data baseline across the global portfolio
* Evaluate and recommend integration patterns (MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL) based on technical feasibility and business priority
* Ensure portability of data pipelines and workflows to future platforms (OpellaGPT) as those platforms mature
* CMO Tooling — Requirements \& Delivery
* Gather requirements from the OCM/Change team for the CMO tooling layer — understand what they need for change readiness tracking, adoption measurement, training management, and stakeholder engagement
* Understand enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms at a functional level — know what data they produce and how to specify integrations with the reporting ecosystem
* Translate CMO requirements into specifications for the relevant tech teams (PowerBI for dashboards, Confluence for templates, OpellaGPT for AI\-enabled change analytics)
* Project\-manage the build of CMO tools: change saturation heatmaps, adoption dashboards, training completion tracking, readiness assessments — as specified by the Central Change Manager
* Ensure CMO data feeds into the existing PMO dashboards — change readiness metrics, training completion, and adoption data visible alongside delivery data
* Unlock the benefits of AI solutions for OCM (OpellaGPT) — gather requirements for AI\-enabled change enablement, reporting, and analytics
* Stakeholder Management \& Training
* Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders (PMO, OCM, programme streams, PMs) and the tech teams that implement tooling solutions
* Manage expectations across stakeholders — communicate priorities, timelines, trade\-offs, and delivery status
* Train project teams on how to use PMO and CMO tools — where to find them, how to use them, how to submit data at stage gates (the OCM team owns the content; this role owns the tooling how\-to)
* Develop self\-service training materials: guides, video walkthroughs, quick\-reference cards for both PMO and CMO tools
* Lead Communities of Practice sessions focused on tooling best practices and adoption
* Support new PM onboarding with tooling setup and orientation (coordinated with the Delivery Facilitation Lead)
* Continuous Improvement
* Continuously improve the tooling landscape based on user feedback, emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, PowerBI, ELITEA), and evolving programme needs
* Monitor tool adoption rates and flag under\-utilization to the Head of PM Practice
* Conduct periodic reviews of the tooling ecosystem with key stakeholders to identify gaps, redundancies, and improvement opportunities


**Technical Environment**
**This Role Requires Understanding Of The Following Platforms**
**Portfolio Management**
 Planisware (schedules, budgets, dependencies, milestones) — dedicated Planisware team implements
   

  

**Project Tracking**
 Jira Cloud Enterprise (epics, stories, status, RAG) — dedicated Jira/Confluence team implements
   

  

**Collaboration \& Docs**
 Confluence Cloud (governance pages, templates, documentation)
   

  

**Data Warehouse**
 Snowflake (analytical data, portfolio ingestion)
   

  

**AI / Orchestration**
 ELITEA Platform, OpellaGPT — dedicated AI team implements
   

  

**Reporting / BI**
 PowerBI, self\-contained HTML dashboards, Confluence publishing — dedicated BI team implements
   

  

**CMO / Change Platforms**
 LMS (Learning Management Systems), Veeva, knowledge platforms — data integration, not content creation
   

  

**Integration Patterns**
 MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL — understand and specify, tech teams implement
   

  

**About You**
* 6\+ years of experience in business analysis, project management, or product ownership in an enterprise IT/Digital environment
* Demonstrable track record of driving AI and automation adoption — converting manual, template\-based, or legacy\-tool processes into AI\-assisted or automated workflows, with evidence of results. This is an essential, defining requirement of the role.
* Proven ability to gather, translate, and prioritize requirements from multiple business stakeholders with competing needs
* Experience project\-managing implementations across multiple technical teams working on different platforms simultaneously
* Strong understanding of enterprise project/portfolio management tools (Planisware, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) — not as a developer, but as someone who understands their capabilities, data models, and integration possibilities
* Ability to think in data flows and system integration — understand where datapoints live, how systems connect, and what’s technically feasible without being the one who codes it
* Good understanding of enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms — at a functional level, not as a content creator
* Experience with reporting and BI tools (PowerBI, HTML dashboards, or similar) — understand what’s possible and specify requirements for BI teams
* Experience writing functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills — ability to facilitate workshops, manage expectations, and communicate trade\-offs across business and technical audiences
* Ability to train non\-technical users on enterprise tools — create training materials, deliver sessions, provide ongoing support
* Comfortable working across time zones with distributed teams (India, Paris, Barcelona, global)
* Fluent English (written and spoken) — all documentation and training materials are in English


**Preferred**
* Experience working as Product Owner for an enterprise tooling or platform team
* Understanding of AI/ML platforms or agentic AI frameworks (OpellaGPT, LangChain, ELITEA, or equivalent) — at a functional level
* Experience specifying data integration requirements (MCP, OpenAPI, ETL, webhooks) for technical teams to implement
* Experience with Planisware\-Jira integration or cross\-platform synchronization projects
* Experience with Veeva Vault, Veeva CRM, or similar life sciences platforms


**Transition \& Onboarding**
 This role internalizes capability currently delivered by EPAM. The onboarding plan includes:
   

  

* Weeks 1\-4: Shadow period with EPAM team — understand the current tooling landscape, data flows, platform capabilities, and stakeholder requirements
* Weeks 3\-6: Begin gathering requirements independently; start building the product backlog; establish relationships with all tech teams
* Weeks 5\-8: Take over project management of ongoing tooling implementations; begin CMO tooling requirements gathering with Brent (OCM Lead)
* Month 3\+: Full autonomous ownership of the tooling backlog and delivery roadmap. EPAM engagement ends for tooling scope.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Butterfly program is one of the largest digital transformations in the FMCH industry — 56 programs, 205\+ projects. Every Program Manager, every SteerCo, and every leadership review depends on the dashboards and reporting this role delivers. On the change side, the tools you specify and drive to implementation will determine whether OCM is embedded in how projects are actually run, or stays as a theoretical framework.
   

  

 You will own the infrastructure that makes delivery visible and change trackable — with direct impact on global decision\-making.
   

  

 Why us?
   

  

 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.
   

  

 You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in\-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Project Leadership: Spearhead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, expansions, and special projects.
   

  

 Financial Management: Direct multi\-million\-dollar security project lifecycles including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budgeting, change orders, and documentation.
   

  

 Technology Innovation: Apply knowledge of emerging physical security technologies to enhance the AWS physical security program.
   

  

 Strategic Advisory: Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) guidance to leadership for technology and procedural decisions.
   

  

 Operational Excellence: Prioritize tasks effectively and operate seamlessly across organizational boundaries
   

  

 Maintenance Oversight: Execute and coordinate preventative maintenance and repairs for security system equipment
   

  

 Compliance Assurance: Ensure adherence to physical security standards, project scopes, budgets, and timelines
   

  

 Solution Development: Design and implement solutions for system installations, upgrades, repairs, and change management
   

  

 Quality Control: Support security system commissioning, testing, acceptance, and project handoff
   

  

 Knowledge Transfer: Develop and deploy comprehensive training programs for all physical security system users.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Mission: Deliver physical security infrastructure by working vigorously and collaborating with various stakeholders to earn and keep customer trust; providing a safe and secure environment for our people, assets, and customer data.
   

  

 Vision: Develop exceptional security infrastructure delivery professionals, consistently apply security processes, and pioneer new technologies that effectively balance security requirements with operational needs.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. **Description**

In most cases, our work starts even before customer purchases: in providing information about return policies on detail page/search \& during check\-out. and developing products to support end to end post purchase support needs.  Amazon Returns policies \& experience are foundational to Amazon’s e\-Commerce and one of the primary reasons why customers love shopping on Amazon. Returns policy communication on the detail page is among the top detail\-page features that increases Customer confidence and the Customer Trust Perception Index (CTPI) for purchase decision. This team has revolutionized the returns for customers through simplest possible experience with no need to print label \& do packaging and quickest refund time. Providing Great Returns Experience is complex due to negative customer sentiments while returning the product. Our team has been very successful in ensuring the lowest return rates and best in class return experience for Amazon as against other E\-commerce competitors.

**Job Description** 




 Technical Program Manager – AWS \& AI\-First Engineering Delivery
 



*Level: Senior Program Management (12–15 years)* 




  





**Technical Program Manager – AWS \& AI\-First Engineering Delivery** 




**Location:** 
 Offshore (Hyderabad, India) – Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 12–15 years
 



**Scope:** 
 AWS, Distributed Systems Engineering, Data/BI \& Integration (AWS Glue, Power BI, Message Broker/ACE), Cloud DevOps, AI\-First Engineering Delivery
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery across the engineering teams supporting our health plan technology platform, spanning software engineering (Junior through Architect levels, working in Go, Python, Node.js, and AWS\-based distributed systems), Data \& Integration Engineering (AWS Glue, Power BI, Message Broker/ACE), and DevOps \& Cloud Engineering (AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS/OpenShift). This is a techno\-functional leadership role: you will own the program plan, translate customer and business requirements into clear technical direction, and track delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams and onshore/offshore teams. Just as important, you will be the driving force behind an AI\-first mindset across every team and every solution, setting the expectation that AI\-assisted engineering is the default way of working, not an exception.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end program and project delivery across engineering teams spanning software engineering, data/BI \& integration engineering, and DevOps/cloud engineering
* Partner directly with customer and business stakeholders to understand business priorities, constraints, and success criteria within the health insurance/payer domain
* Translate business and customer requirements into clear technical requirements, epics, and stories, ensuring shared understanding across product, architecture, and delivery teams
* Build, maintain, and track detailed program plans, schedules, dependencies, RAID logs, and status reporting across all workstreams
* Drive sprint/iteration planning, backlog grooming, and delivery governance (Agile/Scrum/Kanban) across distributed onshore/offshore teams
* Champion and drive an AI\-first engineering mindset across all teams, ensuring AI\-assisted coding, testing, documentation, and operations practices are adopted consistently across every solution delivered
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to accelerate delivery, improve quality, or reduce operational cost, and drive adoption plans together with engineering and architecture leads
* Manage cross\-team dependencies across software engineering, data/BI/integration, and DevOps/cloud engineering roles, proactively resolving blockers
* Own stakeholder communication: executive status updates, steering committee reporting, and risk/issue escalation
* Partner with architects on technical roadmap alignment with business priorities
* Ensure delivery quality, compliance, and security requirements, including HIPAA\-aware practices, are embedded into program execution
* Mentor and guide engineering leads on program management fundamentals and on driving AI\-first delivery within their teams



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; PMP, PMI\-ACP, CSM, or SAFe certification is a plus
* 12–15 years of experience in technical program or project management, including delivery of complex, multi\-team software engineering programs
* Strong working knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture concepts, sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and architecture teams on technical trade\-offs
* Proven experience managing programs spanning distributed systems/backend engineering, data engineering/BI, and DevOps/cloud engineering disciplines
* Strong command of program/project management tools and methodologies (Agile/Scrum/Kanban, JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, or similar), including building and tracking project plans, RAID logs, and status reports
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer and business context and translate business requirements into actionable technical direction for engineering teams
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to track progress, surface risks early, and drive resolution across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders and clients
* Experience managing and coordinating distributed onshore/offshore delivery teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills across business, engineering, and executive audiences



**AI\-First Leadership (Required)** 



* A genuine AI\-first mindset: able to identify, champion, and drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices (AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, AI\-assisted testing and documentation) across every team and every solution under their management
* Practical, hands\-on familiarity with AI coding/assistant tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), sufficient to credibly set expectations and coach teams on effective, responsible usage
* Able to define and track AI\-adoption goals and metrics across engineering teams (e.g., proportion of AI\-assisted work, cycle\-time improvement, quality impact) as part of program governance
* Understanding of responsible and compliant AI usage in a health\-insurance context, including data\-privacy safeguards such as never exposing PHI or sensitive member/client data to external AI tools, and the ability to enforce these standards across teams
* Able to evaluate where AI can be applied across the full solution lifecycle, requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, documentation, and operations, and build these expectations into program plans
* Comfortable partnering with architects and engineering leads to embed AI\-first practices into technical roadmaps and solution designs



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in the US health insurance or payer domain: claims, eligibility, enrollment, provider/member data, and HIPAA\-aware program delivery
* Experience managing programs supporting health plan clients in a consulting or professional services environment
* Familiarity with the specific technologies used by the teams under management: Go, Python, Node.js, AWS EKS/OpenShift, AWS Glue, Power BI, IBM Message Broker/ACE, and cloud DevOps toolchains (Terraform, CI/CD)
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate)
* Experience establishing AI governance frameworks or an AI center\-of\-excellence function within an engineering organization

The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, takes their work seriously, values the opportunity, and is comfortable working with flexibility in a fast\-paced startup environment. You should be highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of keeping multiple stakeholders aligned. A basic understanding of website development and technology projects is preferred. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding requirements, coordinating with technical teams, tracking progress, and identifying and escalating issues.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and manage projects from planning and execution through completion.
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.

* Identify project risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate them appropriately.

* Track bugs and ensure they are assigned, prioritised, followed up on, and closed within agreed timelines.
* Ensure projects are delivered with the expected quality and attention to detail.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on project status, risks, timelines, and key decisions.
* Help establish and improve project management processes and ways of working as the company scales.
* Be flexible in handling changing priorities and take ownership of urgent or high\-priority requirements when needed. Required Skills \& Qualifications
* 3\+ years of experience in Project Management, Program Management, Operations, Product Operations, or a similar role.
* Strong project planning, coordination, execution, and follow\-up skills.
* Experience working with technology or software development teams.
* Basic understanding of website development and the overall software development lifecycle. ● Ability to understand requirements and convert them into clear tasks and timelines.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving blockers.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of deliverables.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Strong working knowledge of project management and collaboration tools.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience working in a B2B SaaS, AI, technology, or startup environment.
* Experience managing website development or software implementation projects.
* Basic understanding of APIs, frontend/backend development, QA/testing, and product releases.
* Experience coordinating with external vendors, developers, designers, or agencies.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and a bias toward action.



  





  





**What We Value** 




  





 At Holmes AI, we are looking for someone who sees this as more than just a job.
 



  





 We value someone who:
 



  




* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Takes the job seriously and is committed to delivering high\-quality work.
* Values the opportunity to work in an early\-stage, high\-growth company.
* Is dependable and follows through on commitments.
* Is comfortable working with flexibility when business priorities require it.
* Is proactive, resourceful, and willing to go beyond their defined responsibilities when required.
* Communicates openly and takes accountability for outcomes.
* Is comfortable working in an environment where things are being built, changed, and improved continuously.



  





  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
 


* Projects delivered on time and within agreed scope
* Project milestone and deadline adherence
* Timely coordination and follow\-up across teams
* Bug resolution and release readiness
* Project execution quality
* Stakeholder satisfaction and communication
* Timely identification and resolution of project blockers
* Documentation and project tracking accuracy
* Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and changing priorities
* Overall contribution to improving project execution and operational efficiency

description:

 The Program Manager leads hardware and software development projects. They are responsible for enforcing best practices within the teams, ensuring delivery of customer\-centric products while enforcing adherence to company policies and procedures, and compliance requirements, while mentoring and growing the skill set of the team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Provide leadership and umbrella guidance to an interdependent family of programs and projects.
   

  

* Work with product management, sales, marketing, and clinical teams to understand the needs of our customers.
* Manage product requirements, functional specifications, schedules, and risk analyses for programs and projects.
* Work with product management and the Change Review Board to prioritize features and technical improvements and build these into the planned product.
* Program Planning \- Collaborates with stakeholders (engineering and test teams, product managers, and senior leadership, etc.) to define the scope, objectives, and deliverables of the projects/program. Develop detailed project plans (MS Project and Microsoft Azure DevOps), taking into account resource availability, timelines, and budget constraints.
* Manage and continually improve the process for planning, execution, and refinements for Program Increments, Sprints, and the overall project schedule.
* Manage the development of required plans and documentation for all development activities.
* Lead 3rd party vendors for manufacturing of medical devices.
* Lead teams to deliver on the plan, with a constant focus on delivering high\-quality products that meet customer expectations; follow the Spacelabs QMS; and are fully compliant with government regulations across our customer base, including FDA, CSA, EU, CFDA, and others.
* Build, drive, and support teams through the development process. Set expectations and lead project delivery skill\-building among team members.
* Eliminate barriers, escalate issues as appropriate, and provide visibility into development status for other stakeholders. Provide frequent communications and formal project reviews with program team, and others as required.
* Negotiate schedule, risk, product features, and resource trade\-offs with project and program teams.
* Uphold the Company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork.
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with the Company’s Code of Ethics and Conduct.
* Ensure that direct report(s) are trained and evaluated on their knowledge and adherence to the company’s values, Code of Ethics and Conduct, and applicable compliance policies.
* It is the responsibility of every Spacelabs Healthcare employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid the recurrence of the problem.

* Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar related degree. Master’s degree is desirable.

* 5\+ years’ experience in program management
* 5\+ years’ experience in managing complex interdependent new product development projects within demanding timeframes required. Solid understanding of the development process, including requirements gathering, analysis and design, development tools and technologies, release and version control, contemporary testing methodologies, and deployment management.
* Knowledge of FDA and medical device regulatory and registration requirements or work in a similarly regulated industry is desirable.
* Demonstrated track record of encouraging innovation and out\-of\-the\-box thinking.
* Proven ability to deliver results through others, both in direct and matrixed organizational models.
* Proven ability to lead dedicated, passionate teams, including an ability to motivate and hold others accountable – including international teams
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, for both internal and external audiences, at all levels.
* Experience in specifying and shipping software for use in cloud environments is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of and ability to work within a global corporate environment is required.
* Must travel internationally and be able to acquire all necessary travel documents. Travel up to 10%.

description:
**Job Description**
**Manager, SAP S4 Functional Team – Logistics**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of the company IT operating model, Tech centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each tech center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the EIT SCM Make Team, The Specialist, S/4 Functional Team – Logistics plays a vital role in leading global Logistics enhancements related to SAP solution within Material Handling and integration across the business including areas such as Production Execution and Environmental Health \& Safety. This role supports our global network across (NA, EU, APAC, and LA) and involves full cycle project management from scope to delivery. (Gap/requirement analyses, solutioning, testing, documentation, preparation/transition support to production, and hyper care).
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Be part of SCM (Supply Chain Management) international team of SAP Experts
* Be responsible for managing all internal logistics changes related to SAP solution including integration within other areas of the business (ex. Production Execution and Environmental Health \& Safety).
* Responsible for full cycle project management from scope to delivery expected (Gap/requirement analyses, solutioning, testing, documentation, preparation/transition support to production, and hyper care)
* Be part of live markets operational support delivering Logistics enhancements on current SAP solution within related functional areas.
* Be responsible for change management process collaborating with the appropriate technical team.
* Work with and Influence individuals across a global matrixed organization (NA, EU, APAC and LA) to realize key objectives.
* Test and troubleshoot interfaces to third\-party applications (Ex. Automated Warehouses \-MMES) in relation to respective SAP modules.
* Work on diverse projects like roll\-out of our global solution to new markets
* Document, review and approve functional specifications, user requirements specifications and formal testing.
* Work in a matrix environment coordinating with outsourced support vendors.
* Coordinate and work closely with other teams within other business areas.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, work with the Business to deliver on SAP enhancements \& projects.
* Communicate risks, issues, challenges, and technical design status/progress. Ensure issues and risks are tracked and mitigation plans are in place.


**What Should You Have**
* 3\+ years of experience in Functional and technical (SAP) expertise for SAP Production Execution Module (Preferable PP\-PI – Process industry).
* EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) \& SRM (Stock Room) experience
* knowledge of end\-to\-end Material Handling processes
+ Ex. MMES – Material Movement Automation Systems, \& Shop floor system integrations.

* Good English communication skills and the ability to interact directly with business users and stakeholders.
* Familiarity with SDLC in the pharmaceutical industry required.
* Analytical problem solving skills
* Ability to learn \& leverage the latest technology.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.
* High attention to detail and a proactive mindset to prevent issues before escalation.


 Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 We are known as Merck \& Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing for lives, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Director, Project Management
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**Brief Team/department Description**
 Azurity develops unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, to serve overlooked patients. This role is with Azurity R\&D project management team, which coordinates cross\-functional planning, development and tracking of project plans, considering time, cost, quality and strategy. As we grow and expand, we are building new capabilities to make our processes simpler, faster, and more efficient. We are looking for a dynamic, change\-inspired leader, to lead R\&D project management, and process improvement initiatives.
   

  

 This role will report to the R\&D head and act as an internal consultant operating from Azurity’s Hyderabad development center. The role holder provides input on resource (budget, headcount) strategy and support in setting the yearly product delivery KPI. This role will be responsible for managing the R\&D Project Management department, defining, and implementing R\&D Project Management processes. Holds the overall responsibility in the R\&D PM team for ensuring Project Plans, Budgets, Timelines are tracked against baseline and updated as per the Program Management process. Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.
   

  

 The role holder will lead cross\-functional initiatives to enhance R\&D productivity and streamline product development processes through targeted process improvements, tool evaluation, and vendor coordination. This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology\-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R\&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R\&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement \& simplification opportunities.
   

  

 The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross\-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.
   

  

**Principle Responsibilities**
* A) Lead project management
* Enable preparation and management of CSO\-R\&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
* Through the project managers, prepare month\-on\-month project forecasts and manage CSO\-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R\&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
* Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R\&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
* Partner with the finance leadership and co\-own the Long\-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R\&D opex, capex, and product\-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage\-wise Probability of Technical \& Regulatory success.
* B) Management systems \& processes:
* Continuously improve the contract and purchase order (PO) management process for R\&D, through a periodic review of SLA and goals with the legal and finance teams Facilitate regular and ad hoc project team meetings, ensuring documentation of agendas, minutes, and actions. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (internal/external) to track key performance indicators
* Develop/maintain collaboration and nurture relationships with internal partner functions and external entities as required, to support business and strategic goals. Serve as the point person for initial escalation, conflict resolution, project risk mitigation for issues that cannot be resolved in the Project Teams, requiring liaising with department leaders
* Oversight, mentoring, training of PM team members on policies and procedures
* Support R\&D operational planning \- Lab space management, capex \& support internal preparedness for QA audits, leadership visits.
* Responsible for drafting the R\&D sections in management presentations, working with the department heads and the Chief Scientific Officer.
* C) Digital enablement initiatives:
* Lead a small team of PMs and manage the R\&D digital budget, including annual subscriptions for off\-the\-shelf solutions as well as custom built solutions (external as well as in\-house).
* Champion the evaluation of cutting\-edge data tools and data\-enabled solutions by working alongside internal digital, data science and technical teams to ensure deliverables meeting R\&D’s strategic goals
* Lead end\-to\-end digital transformations from vendor selection to rollout, engaging with IT, cross functional teams and external vendors. Wherever optimal, lead in\-house workflow creation and execution through the IT team.
* Serve as the internal business owner to the Azurity IT team, on R\&D / laboratory systems such as E\-Lab Notebook, Document mgmt. system. Drive functional oversight on integration projects involving lab systems, ensuring alignment with R\&D workflows
* Build and manage vendor relationships through screening, onboarding and on\-premises engagements. Define and monitor service expectations from external vendors via functionally aligned SLAs based on R\&D user needs. Provide continuous feedback to vendors to ensure tools evolve with R\&D processes, without taking direct ownership of the digital systems


**Qualifications/Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* Master's degree preferred:
* MBA (Strategy, Operations, General Management, or Finance)
* MS/M.Pharm in a relevant scientific field
* Certifications (preferred, not mandatory)
* PMP
* PgMP
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt


**Preferred Experience**
 15\-20 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including:
   

  

**Project and Portfolio Management**
* At least 7\-10 years managing cross\-functional development programs.
* Experience with R\&D portfolios rather than isolated projects.
* Experience leading governance meetings and stage\-gate reviews.


**Budget Management**
* Ownership or co\-ownership of departmental budgets.
* Experience reviewing forecasts prepared by analysts or PMs.
* Experience presenting budget updates to senior leadership.


**Process and Organizational Change**
* Designing new departmental processes.
* Simplifying complex workflows.
* Implementing systems such as Veeva, TrackWise, Planisware, Smartsheet, Clarity, Microsoft Project, etc.
* Creating governance models and decision\-making frameworks.
* Driving organizational adoption of new ways of working.


 By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Program Manager II, ECR, NOC ECR
description:
**Description**
 The Executive Customer Relations Team operates within Amazon India's Network Operations Center (NOC), serving as the critical bridge between senior leadership escalations and systemic customer experience improvement. The team manages direct escalations from L10\+ leaders requiring comprehensive investigation, root cause analysis, executive\-level communications, and cross\-functional action item ownership. This team aims to transform every executive escalation into a systemic improvement opportunity by conducting rigorous root cause analysis, driving timely CAPA closures, and identifying thematic defect patterns that convert to programmatic interventions — ultimately reducing repeat defects and elevating the end\-to\-end customer experience across Amazon India's operations.
   

  

 The individual in this role will own defined workstreams within the ECR program charter, collaborating with program, product, tech, BI, and Science partners to execute, validate, and deploy customer experience capabilities. This role will coordinate with teams across IN Ops to support the launch and adoption of bespoke product solutions within their assigned scope. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing moderate complexity and ambiguity. Successful candidates will have experience in Program Management, comfort working with cross\-organizational stakeholders, and the ability to manage competing priorities with appropriate escalation.
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will own and deliver well\-defined workstreams and projects by coordinating with cross\-disciplinary teams to execute customer\-facing initiatives. You thrive by understanding the broader vision, aligning your workstream to it, and driving execution — proactively identifying risks, flagging escalations, making day\-to\-day trade\-offs, and balancing business needs against technical constraints. You must decompose assigned projects into clear deliverables with functional specifications and execute them on time with minimal oversight. Good judgment, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence peers and partner teams are essential. Working knowledge of data analysis and SQL is expected. The role will also be expected to support Generative AI adoption within ECR — including implementing automated case summarization, contributing to pattern recognition for thematic defects, and supporting predictive escalation routing — executing on identified Gen AI opportunities that augment human judgment, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution timelines.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 They will be responsible for working with all Miles (LM, MM, FC), Multiple Program teams (ACES, DSP, IHS, FC), and Multiple Product teams (ROW APEX, DEX, RCX) to identify pain points and scope out large high\-impact solutions to improve Delivery Experience.
   

  

 They will be responsible for driving VP inquiries to closure within SLA with clear articulation of issue and recommended initiatives to arrest the root cause of the defect. They will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure Action Item progress and own writing reports that detail progress to leadership on a frequent basis.
   

  

 They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.
   

  

 They will implement and iterate on Generative AI solutions (e.g., automated case summarization bots, AI\-assisted root cause analysis, intelligent response suggestion engines) to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate VP inquiry resolution timelines — executing on use cases identified and scoped by leadership
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Manager, Procurement
description:
Build a career with confidence
   

  

 Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world\-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Manager, SCM – Business Excellence will lead the “Design \& Plan” layer of the Supply Chain Business Excellence operating model, with Process Excellence \& Performance as the core focus of the role. The Manager owns end\-to\-end process design, standardization, governance, and performance management for the supply chain, ensuring processes are efficient, compliant, and continuously improving.
   

  

 Alongside this primary mandate, the Manager sets the direction for the shared Analytics and Automation \& AI capabilities that enable every execution pillar (Productivity \& Price, Vendor Master \& Working Capital, Contracts \& Resiliency). While a smaller portion of the role, the Manager shapes the analytics and automation/AI strategy – identifying where digital and AI solutions can reduce manual effort and strengthen decision\-making – and works with specialists to deliver it.
   

  

 The role includes leading a team of specialists/analysts, driving continuous\-improvement (Lean/Kaizen) programs, and partnering with global supply chain, finance, and operations leaders to deliver scalable and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Manages execution of processes, standards, and operational plans in support of Procurement strategy, including RFPs, negotation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution.
* Directs programs for effective vendor selection and management with a view to minimize purchasing costs without compromising quality or reliability of supply.
* Reviews changes in price trends and manufacturing processes and makes recommendations to ensure successful procurement process.
* Manages resolution of client issues or problems.
* Monitors and coordinates suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries to ensure resolution of problems such as shortages and missed or late deliveries.
* Authorizes purchase orders, negotiates prices and approves payments to support the procurement process in large territories.
* Reviews and assesses request for proposals (RFP) and bid packages.
* Analyzes and monitors contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and to help determine need for changes.


**Responsibilities**
* Process Excellence \& Performance (primary focus)
* Own end\-to\-end process mapping, redesign, and standardization across supply chain processes; maintain a single source of truth for process documentation.
* Establish and run process governance \& compliance, including policy adherence, controls, and audit readiness.
* Lead the PMO for the transformation portfolio – intake, prioritization, milestone tracking, and value realization across pillars.
* Drive documentation \& training, change communication, and L1/L2 performance management to embed and sustain new ways of working.
* Own the supply chain performance framework: define KPIs, cadence, and reporting; drive process\-NPS and continuous\-improvement (Lean/Kaizen) initiatives.
* Analytics \& Performance Reporting
* Own the shared analytics layer – productivity insights, data models, and decision\-support dashboards – that serve all execution pillars.
* Lead design and delivery of Power BI/Excel analytics for executive\-level insights; ensure data integrity, standard definitions, and auditability.
* Automation \& AI Strategy (enabling, smaller portion of role)
* Set the direction for process automation and AI – identify and prioritize opportunities where automation or AI can reduce manual effort and improve decision\-making – and partner with specialists to deliver and scale them.
* Sponsor selected automation and AI pilots (e.g., workflow automation, GenAI/AI agents) and track their coverage and impact (e.g., processes automated, hours/FTE saved).
* Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of specialists/analysts across process excellence, analytics, and automation; prioritize work and assure quality of deliverables.
* Act as the primary partner to execution\-pillar leads and to global/regional supply chain, finance, and operations stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates to senior leadership on portfolio progress, risks, and business impact; facilitate workshops and steering reviews.


 Critical Skills / Function Exposure
   

  

 Supply Chain
   

  

 Quality
   

  

 Front Line Supervision
   

  

 Carrier Excellence
   

  

 TOW/Project Management
   

  

 Other: Analytics, Automation \& AI / Digital Transformation
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution (Engineering / Supply Chain / Analytics preferred).
* 12\+ years’ experience in supply chain / operations, with strong exposure to process excellence, PMO/governance, and performance management.
* Proven track record in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement (Lean/Kaizen), with measurable business impact.
* Working knowledge of analytics and automation/AI – able to set direction and partner with specialists; proficiency in Power BI and advanced Excel, with familiarity in SQL/Python and AI/GenAI concepts a plus.

title: Site Engineer - PHE - HYD123
description:
The Site Engineer \- PHE is responsible for planning, coordinating, supervising, and executing all Public Health Engineering (PHE) works in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project schedules. The role includes managing the installation, testing, and commissioning of water supply systems, domestic water distribution networks, drainage systems, sewage systems, stormwater networks, rainwater harvesting systems, sump and tank installations, pumps, water treatment systems, and associated piping infrastructure. The engineer shall review shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, hydraulic calculations, and construction schedules to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable codes and standards.
   

  

 Responsibilities include coordinating with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and other disciplines such as Civil, Architectural, Electrical, and Mechanical teams to ensure smooth execution of works. The engineer shall monitor site progress, manage manpower and resources, conduct site inspections, verify installation quality, resolve technical issues, and ensure timely completion of project milestones. Additional duties include preparing quantity requirements, monitoring material deliveries, conducting pressure testing, leak testing, flushing, disinfection, and system commissioning activities. The Site Engineer shall maintain daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, inspection records, testing documentation, and as\-built drawings while ensuring compliance with quality and HSE requirements.
   

  

 The role also involves supporting authority inspections, assisting in project handover documentation, and ensuring all systems are installed and commissioned in accordance with local regulations and client requirements. Experience in Data Centre, Commercial Building, Industrial, Infrastructure, Healthcare, or Mission Critical Facility projects is preferred. The candidate should possess strong knowledge of potable water systems, drainage networks, plumbing installations, water treatment systems, pump systems, hydraulic principles, testing and commissioning procedures, and relevant standards such as IPC, UPC, IS Codes, and local authority regulations. A Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical/Civil Engineering with 3\+ years of relevant experience is required. Strong technical, planning, coordination, problem\-solving, and communication skills are essential for successful project execution and delivery. Project is HYD123\&124\.

title: Sr. Program Manager, ECR, NOC ECR

 The individual in this role will collaborate across a team of program, product, tech, BI and Science leaders to plan, execute, validate, and deploy complex customer experience capabilities. This role will partner will partner with teams across IN Ops to launch and drive impact through bespoke product solutions. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a proven track record of delivering results while managing high level of complexity. Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management, have experience working with a variety of cross\-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities.
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will identify, scope, and deliver large end\-to\-end programs by engaging cross\-disciplinary teams to design innovative customer\-facing initiatives. You thrive by creating a vision, building consensus, and driving results — anticipating bottlenecks, managing escalations, making trade\-offs, and balancing business needs against technical constraints. You must break down complex projects into manageable deliverables with clear functional specifications and execute them on time. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, and the ability to influence are essential. Self\-sufficiency in data analysis and working knowledge of SQL are critical. The role will also champion Generative AI adoption within ECR — including automated case summarization, pattern recognition for thematic defects, and predictive escalation routing — identifying opportunities where Gen AI can augment human judgment, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution timelines.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

They will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure Action Item progress and own writing reports that detail progress to leadership on a frequent basis.
* They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.

* They will help define the Gen AI product roadmap for ECR in partnership with Science and Tech teams — establishing success metrics, conducting A/B testing of AI\-assisted workflows, and ensuring responsible AI deployment with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop guardrails.

* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
